items.description: Wer wir sind Gestalte mit uns die datengetriebene Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft Daten sind für Dich mehr als Zahlen in einem Reporting? Du möchtest Unternehmen dabei unterstützen, aus Daten echte Erkenntnisse, bessere Entscheidungen und nachhaltigen Geschäftswert zu schaffen? Dann bist Du bei promantis genau richtig. Als SAP- und IT-Beratungsunternehmen begleiten wir seit 2008 führende Unternehmen der Energiewirtschaft bei ihrer digitalen Transformation. Neben unseren etablierten Schwerpunkten rund um SAP Utilities, S/4HANA, Integration und Transformation bauen wir unsere Kompetenzen in den Bereichen Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Cloud Data Platforms und Artificial Intelligence konsequent aus. Unsere Mission: Die digitale Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft gestalten. Dabei verbinden wir technologische Innovation mit fachlicher Expertise, pragmatischem Vorgehen und einer Kultur, die auf Vertrauen, Eigenverantwortung und Zusammenarbeit setzt. Deine Herausforderung und Aufgaben Analytics befindet sich im Wandel: Klassische Data Warehouses entwickeln sich zu intelligenten, cloudbasierten Datenplattformen. Reporting wird durch Predictive Analytics ergänzt. Künstliche Intelligenz eröffnet völlig neue Möglichkeiten der Unternehmenssteuerung. Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Als Senior SAP Analytics & AI Consultant unterstützt Du unsere Kunden dabei, moderne Data-&-Analytics-Landschaften aufzubauen, bestehende SAP-BW-Umgebungen zu transformieren und neue Technologien wie SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud oder Artificial Intelligence sinnvoll nutzbar zu machen. Dabei agierst Du nicht nur als technischer Spezialist, sondern als vertrauensvoller Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden. Deine Aufgaben: Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung moderner Data-, Analytics- und BI-Lösungen. Du entwickelst zukunftsfähige Datenarchitekturen auf Basis von SAP BW/4HANA, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud und SAP Business Technology Platform. Du konzipierst und implementierst Reporting-, Dashboarding-, Planungs- und Forecasting-Lösungen mit SAP Analytics Cloud. Du entwickelst Datenmodelle, Datenflüsse sowie ETL- und ELT-Prozesse und integrierst SAP- und Non-SAP-Datenquellen. Du unterstützt bei der Modernisierung bestehender BW-Landschaften und begleitest Transformations- und Migrationsprojekte. Du entwickelst analytische Lösungen im Umfeld von S/4HANA Embedded Analytics, CDS Views und Analytical Queries. Du identifizierst sinnvolle Einsatzmöglichkeiten für Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Predictive Analytics und intelligente Automatisierung. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Kunden konkrete Analytics- und AI-Use-Cases für Forecasting, Planung, Anomalieerkennung oder datengetriebene Entscheidungsprozesse. Du führst Workshops durch und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in tragfähige technische Konzepte. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Arbeitspakete, Architekturentscheidungen und die fachliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Analytics-Kompetenzen. Das bringst Du mit Fachlich Mehrjährige Erfahrung im SAP Analytics-, BI- oder Data-Warehouse-Umfeld Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SAP BW oder SAP BW/4HANA Erfahrung mit Datenmodellierung und Reporting-Lösungen Gute Kenntnisse in SAP HANA, SQL und idealerweise SQLScript Erfahrung mit Datenintegration, Schnittstellen und modernen Analytics-Architekturen Verständnis für S/4HANA und dessen Analytics-Möglichkeiten Persönlich Du denkst analytisch, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert. Du hinterfragst Anforderungen und bringst eigene Ideen ein. Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verständlich vermitteln. Du arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich und übernimmst Verantwortung. Du begeisterst Dich für neue Technologien und möchtest Dich fachlich weiterentwickeln. Du teilst Dein Wissen gerne mit Kunden und Kolleg:innen. Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft? Umso besser. Besonders spannend sind Kenntnisse in Bereichen wie: SAP IS-U bzw. SAP S/4 Utilities Energiedatenmanagement (EDM) Marktkommunikation Smart Metering Abrechnung & Fakturierung Regulatorisches Reporting Transformations- und Migrationsprojekte bei Energieversorgern Keine Sorge: Branchenerfahrung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Viel wichtiger sind Neugier, Lernbereitschaft und Freude an komplexen Datenlandschaften. Das erwartet Dich Dein Technologie-Stack Dich erwartet ein modernes und vielseitiges Umfeld, in dem klassische SAP-BI-Kompetenzen auf Cloud-Technologien und Zukunftsthemen wie AI treffen: SAP Data & Analytics SAP BW & BW/4HANA SAP Datasphere SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) SAP HANA & SAP HANA Cloud SAP Business Data Cloud SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) S/4HANA Embedded Analytics CDS Views & Analytical Queries Datenintegration & Entwicklung SQL & SQLScript ABAP & ABAP Objects ODP OData & REST APIs ETL- & ELT-Prozesse BW Modeling Tools Zukunftsthemen Artificial Intelligence & Generative AI SAP Joule Predictive Analytics Data Fabric & Data Mesh Lakehouse-Architekturen Data Governance & AI Governance Optional Microsoft Fabric Databricks Snowflake Power BI Python & Machine Learning Deine Benefits bei promantis Wir glauben daran, dass die besten Lösungen dort entstehen, wo Menschen ihre Potenziale entfalten können. Deshalb erwarten Dich bei uns nicht nur spannende Aufgaben, sondern auch Rahmenbedingungen, die Flexibilität, Weiterentwicklung und Lebensqualität fördern: Beratung ohne klassischen Beratungsdruck Ca. 90 % Remote-Arbeit Planbare Reisetätigkeit statt permanenter Kundeneinsätze Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Vertrauensarbeitszeit Gehalt je nach Erfahrung und Qualifikation (ca. 80.000 100.000€ p.a.). Analytics, Cloud & AI mit Zukunft SAP Datasphere SAP Analytics Cloud SAP Business Data Cloud Artificial Intelligence & Generative AI Data-Driven Transformationen in der Energiewirtschaft Weiterbildung, die wirklich stattfindet Individuelle Schulungen und Zertifizierungen Raum für Innovation, Forschung und neue Technologien Mitarbeit beim Aufbau neuer Themenfelder Kultur, die gelebt wird Menschlichkeit & Vertrauen Echte Zusammenarbeit statt Einzelkämpfertum Offene Feedback- und Lernkultur Gestaltungsspielraum und kurze Entscheidungswege Weitere Benefits 30 Tage Urlaub Workation-Möglichkeiten Epassi - Deine Fitness- und Wellbeingplattform E-Bike-Leasing Betriebliche Altersvorsorge Zusatzkrankenversicherung Transparente Karriere- und Gehaltsmodelle Regelmäßige Team-Events Klingt nach Deinem nächsten Karriereschritt? Du möchtest Analytics neu denken, moderne Datenplattformen gestalten und Artificial Intelligence dort einsetzen, wo sie echten Mehrwert schafft? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen. Bewirb Dich als Senior SAP Analytics & AI Consultant (m/w/d) und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns die datengetriebene Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft. Falls Du Fragen hast, kontaktiere mich gerne via XING, LinkedIn, klassisch per Mail unter ----- oder Telefon +49 173 452 9770. Noch mehr zu uns erfährst Du über unsere Karriereseite oder auf Kununu. items.summary: ARIZONA GOVERNOR'S OFFICEGOVERNOR’S OFFICE OF STRATEGIC PLANNING & BUDGETING GRANTS & FEDERAL RESOURCES SENIOR BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE & DATA ARCHITECTThis position is currently grant funded with a salary range of $96,000-$109,000, dependent on experience.
items.description: ARIZONA GOVERNOR'S OFFICE GOVERNOR’S OFFICE OF STRATEGIC PLANNING & BUDGETING GRANTS & FEDERAL RESOURCES SENIOR BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE & DATA ARCHITECT This position is currently grant funded with a salary range of $96,000-$109,000, dependent on experience. A wide salary range is posted for this position and any job offer is based upon a salary analysis which considers relevant experience, education, certifications, and state seniority as compared to others doing substantially similar work. There is no guarantee an offer will be at the top of the posted range based on the salary analysis. Job Location: 1700 West Washington Street Phoenix, Arizona 85007 Posting Details: Annual Salary Range: $96,000 - $109,000 This position will close on Friday November 6, 2026 Job Summary: The State seeks a Senior Business Intelligence & Data Architect to serve as the authoritative technical expert for the State’s enterprise grants business intelligence (BI) ecosystem. Operating at the intersection of state grant policy, cloud database engineering, and interactive analytics, this role manages the end-to-end data architecture and reporting strategy for the statewide grants management SaaS platform. The Architect will integrate data across Arizona's Grants Management System (AzGMS), the state accounting system (AZ360), legacy databases, and federal exports to build automated reporting pipelines. Working collaboratively with the Technical Integration team, SaaS vendor, ERP/AZ360 team, Security, and Agency Leads, this role empowers state agencies with custom reporting and executive compliance dashboards. Additionally, the Architect leads the data mapping and migration strategy and authors technical Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure long-term state self-sufficiency, data integrity, statewide audit readiness and informed decision-making. Job Duties: Key job responsibilities will include: Manage Azure Data Factory (ADF) orchestration, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Azure SQL DB indexing, Azure Key Vault secrets management, and Entra ID Service Principals Design and publish high-level executive, multi-page, interactive Power BI dashboards providing OSPB leadership with organization-wide visibility across all state agencies Agency Grant Profile & Compliance Dashboards: Develop and manage detailed Agency Grant Profile dashboards capturing agency self-assessments, internal risk scores, active corrective action plans, and real-time compliance monitoring flags Author comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and technical runbooks detailing report maintenance, dashboard configuration, and ETL pipeline management Establish statewide metrics tracking federal grant seeking, application pipelines, award obligations, revenue/expenditure drawdowns, and program performance measures Lead the technical review and validation of Data Management and Migration Strategies, Data Inventory & Quality Assessments, and Data Mapping Workbooks Ensure rigorous financial reconciliation, data mapping, cleansing, and duplicate management during agency data onboarding from legacy systems Incorporate interactive features such as global search slicers, split-screen operational views, granular drill-through capabilities, and deadline countdown visuals Support records-retention, legal-hold, archival, and defensible-deletion requirements in coordination with State Legal and Compliance teams Work with the vendor support team to provide technical support to agency data leads on custom report creation and complex filter queries Maintain data governance documentation, data dictionaries, data-flow diagrams, data-quality metrics, and reconciliation procedures Ensure backend data structures effectively support statewide reporting, audit requirements, public records, and future analytics Build, publish, and maintain custom tabular, summary, and matrix reports in the native Grants Management Report Builder Develop and maintain automated reporting pipelines for mandatory annual federal filings (e.g., SEFA, FFATA, GFR) Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs): Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: • Technology Stack SQL Scripting (Stored Procedures, Indexes, Complex Joins) Relational Data Warehousing & SQL Schema Design SQL ServerDimensional Modeling (Star Schema) Azure SQL Database & Microsoft ETL / ELT Pipeline Architecture Power BI (DAX, Power Query) JSON / REST API Parsing Azure Data Factory (ADF) Azure Data Lake Storage Azure Key Vault Microsoft Fabric Strong analytical problem-solving skills for complex financial reconciliations, combined with the ability to translate technical data structures into clear executive visuals and user-friendly documentation Public Sector & Grants Domain: Direct experience working with state/federal grant data and administration, SEFA reporting, or subrecipient compliance monitoring. Knowledge of full-lifecycle grant financial flows Certifications: Microsoft Certified - Power BI Data Analyst Associate, Azure Data Engineer Associate, or Enterprise Data Analyst Associate System Familiarity: Experience supporting SaaS grants management platforms and integrating with ERP systems Selective Preference(s): Education A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, or a related field with 9+ years of progressive hands-on experience developing enterprise data architecture, Power BI dashboards and semantic models, and ETL/ELT pipelines Pre-Employment Requirements: Employees who drive on state business are subject to driver’s license record checks, must maintain acceptable driving records and must complete any required driver training (see Arizona Administrative Code R2-10-207.12.) Requires possession of and ability to retain a current, valid state-issued driver’s license appropriate to the assignment If this position requires driving or the use of a vehicle as an essential function of the job to conduct State business, then the following requirements apply: Driver’s License Requirements. Benefits: The State of Arizona offers a comprehensive benefits package to include: Optional employee benefits include short-term disability insurance, deferred compensation plans, and supplemental life insurance Life insurance and long-term disability insurance Vacation plus 10 paid holidays per year • Health and dental insurance • Retirement plan • Sick leave Learn more about the Paid Parental Leave program here. For a complete list of benefits provided by The State of Arizona , please visit our benefits page Retirement: Positions in this classification participate in the Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) Note that enrollment eligibility will become effective after 27 weeks of employment Contact Us: If you have any questions please feel free to contact Ariel Gonzalez at for assistance Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Product Analyst
items.summary: StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry.
items.description: StellarTech is a rapidly growing company at the forefront of innovation in the EdTech industry. Our team is focused on building scalable products and sustainable business models that shape the future of education. We are looking for a Product Analyst to join our Platform Development Team. Working hand-in-hand with the Product Manager, you will build product analytics for our core platform from the ground up - and become the person who understands user behavior on the platform better than anyone else. What You'll Do: Build product analytics for the core platform together with the Product Manager: define key metrics, events, funnels, and approaches to evaluating user experience. Design and maintain the event tracking framework - ensuring data is complete, consistent, and trusted across product and technical teams. Identify insights across user journeys, segments, and platform usage scenarios - and automate their regular discovery. Create and evolve dashboards, alerts, and analytics infrastructure used by product and engineering teams for day-to-day decisions. Support product hypotheses with data: validate ideas, evaluate feature impact, and help prioritize the roadmap with evidence. Translate user behavior into clear, actionable recommendations and help teams across the company make data-driven decisions. We're Looking For: 6-8 years of experience as a Product Analyst / Data Analyst in a product IT company (B2C platforms, SaaS, or marketplaces are a plus). Strong SQL skills and confident work with large datasets. Hands-on experience with product analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4, or similar) and BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar). Solid understanding of product metrics: activation, retention, conversion, funnels, cohorts, and unit-level user behavior. Experience designing event taxonomies and setting up tracking from scratch or significantly evolving an existing setup. Experience with A/B testing and a working knowledge of statistics for experiment evaluation. Ability to turn ambiguous product questions into structured analyses and clear recommendations. Nice to Have: Python or R for analysis and automation of recurring insights. Experience working with platform/infrastructure products or technical stakeholders (engineers, architects). Experience building analytics processes in a team where analytics did not exist before. Strong communication skills: ability to articulate findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proactive, problem-solving mindset - comfortable with ambiguity in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Why You'll Love Working With Us: Innovative Environment: We're all about trying new things and pushing the envelope in EdTech. We are global remote. Health: company-provided medical expense compensation. AI solutions: AI subscription and other tools. Balance: Flexible paid time off - 21 days of annual leave + 10 bank holidays. Collaborative Culture: Work alongside passionate professionals who are as driven as you are. --- Hiring Process: 1. Recruiter screen 2. Technical Interview 3. Hiring Manager Interview Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Lead Data Engineer- Healthcare Interoperability We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Engineer to join our healthcare technology team with a primary focus on healthcare interoperability.
items.description: Lead Data Engineer- Healthcare Interoperability We are seeking an experienced Lead Data Engineer to join our healthcare technology team with a primary focus on healthcare interoperability. This role will be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining our Azure-based data infrastructure, including databases, data pipelines, analytics platforms, and business intelligence solutions — with an emphasis on integrating with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and healthcare data exchange standards (FHIR, C-CDA, HL7). The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in the Microsoft data stack, strong architectural thinking, and experience with healthcare data compliance requirements. This senior-level position will also provide technical leadership, mentorship to the broader engineering team and reports to the Director of Data Engineering. Duties & Responsibilities: Design and implement scalable, secure data architectures on Azure to support business intelligence, analytics, and operational systems Build and maintain data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse and related services Contribute to database designs across multiple platforms (Azure SQL Database, SQL Managed Instance, PostgreSQL, CosmosDB) Optimize data storage strategies across Azure Blob Storage, Data Lake, and structured databases Design data models and structures that enable efficient analytics and reporting Design, develop, and maintain complex stored procedures, functions, triggers, and views Implement database DevOps processes including schema versioning, deployment automation, and rollback procedures Perform database performance tuning, indexing strategies, and query optimization Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance with HIPAA/HITRUST requirements for PHI data Manage database lifecycle across development, pre-production, and production environments utilizing RedGate Flyway Design and implement ETL/ELT processes to integrate data from multiple sources Build event-driven data processing solutions including message producers, consumers, and workers using Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and related messaging services Integrate with external REST APIs for data ingestion and develop internal data APIs using Python (FastAPI/Flask) on Azure Container Apps or Functions Develop data transformation logic and orchestration workflows Ensure data quality, consistency, and lineage across the data platform Integrate with Azure AI services and machine learning endpoints as needed Review designs of Power BI solutions including semantic models, reports, & dashboards Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions Optimize data structures for reporting and analytics performance Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior developers and engineers Contribute to data engineering best practices, standards, and patterns Participate in architecture reviews and technical decision-making Collaborate with DevOps and Infrastructure teams on platform improvements Drive continuous improvement in data quality, performance, and reliability Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including data dictionaries, architecture diagrams, and process flows Document data lineage, transformation logic, and business rules Ensure all data handling practices meet HIPAA/HITRUST compliance requirements Maintain audit trails and documentation for compliance purposes Troubleshoot and resolve complex data-related issues across the platform Provide escalation support for production incidents Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support business parsing/transformation Support HL7 v2/MDM/ADT message flows where needed, including message parsing and acknowledgment handling Define and maintain OpenAPI specifications and API versioning; write contract tests to prevent breaking changes Lead the document templating framework and server-side rendering pipeline for HTML-to-PDF output; ensure accessibility and compliance requirements Experience & Qualifications: Required: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience 8+ years of experience in data engineering, database development, or related roles Expert-level proficiency in T-SQL and Microsoft SQL Server Expert-level proficiency of Python Experience building REST APIs and background workers in Python (FastAPI/Flask) Understanding of event-driven architectures and asynchronous processing patterns Strong experience with Azure data services (Azure SQL, Data Factory, Synapse, Blob Storage, etc.) Hands-on experience building and maintaining data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes Knowledge of Power BI development skills including DAX, data modeling, and performance optimization Solid understanding of database design principles, normalization, and data modeling Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD practices Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a team environment Microsoft certification (Azure Data Engineer Associate, Azure Database Administrator, Power BI Data Analyst) Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates) Knowledge of additional Azure services (Container Apps, Functions, Logic Apps) Experience with other database platforms (PostgreSQL, CosmosDB) Understanding of HIPAA/HITRUST compliance requirements for healthcare data Experience PowerShell for automation and scripting Experience with Azure DevOps or similar platforms for CI/CD Experience with data governance, cataloging, and metadata management Background in healthcare technology or regulated industries Experience with OpenAPI/Swagger specification design and contract testing Proficient in advanced usage of AI development tooling (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) Azure API Management and private networking patterns Travel up to 15%. Preferred: Practical experience with FHIR (resources, search parameters, OAuth2/SMART on FHIR) and C-CDA parsing/transformation Experience integrating with Epic, Cerner, Athena, or other EHR/EMR systems Experience with HL7 v2 (MLLP/MDM/ADT) message handling Originally posted on Himalayas

More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of member
items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Remote About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our BI function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is an executional role providing essential analytics support across the company: you will gather requirements, field ad hoc and recurring data requests, and build the reporting dashboards that leaders across Carrot rely on to make decisions. You will work hands-on with modern data tooling, including SQL, dbt, and enterprise BI platforms, and partner with teams across the business to translate their questions into clear, trustworthy answers. The BI team is highly cross-functional and sits alongside Data Engineering, making this a strong opportunity to sharpen technical skills while building broad business context in a mission-driven environment. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Design and build data models in SQL with a focus on correctness, clarity, and reusability Build and maintain dashboards and reports that track key business metrics and inform decision-making across the company Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer high-priority business questions from stakeholders across the organization Collaborate with teams across Carrot to understand their data domains, reporting needs, and success metrics Contribute to data quality, documentation, and self-service BI capabilities as the function scales What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Delivered accurate, well-documented dashboards and reports that stakeholders across the company trust and use regularly Fully ramped on Carrot's data stack and core data domains, independently owning recurring and ad hoc reporting requests Built strong working relationships with cross-functional partners and established yourself as a reliable analytics resource Improved turnaround and consistency of reporting by creating reusable data models and reducing manual work About You You likely have: A Bachelor's Degree Intermediate-to-advanced SQL experience: ability to write advanced queries using joins, common table expressions, and window/analytic functions Experience with data visualization software (e.g., Tableau, Looker, DOMO, or Power BI) to bring data insights to life for broad audiences Basic statistics proficiency: experiment design, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, probability, and distributions Ability to translate business intelligence needs from a variety of stakeholders into technical execution and clear presentation Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical information to non-technical audiences Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Experience using dbt to transform, test, and document data Experience working with healthcare industry data or in other complex, regulated data environments Experience in a high-growth environment Familiarity with version control systems (Git preferred) Understanding of effective data modeling strategies and implementations Why This Role Matters Data is central to how Carrot operates and grows. Leaders across the company depend on accurate, timely reporting to serve members, support customers, and make sound business decisions. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will be the connective tissue between raw data and those decisions, ensuring the organization runs on insights it can trust. Your work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Better data means better decisions for the members and customers who rely on Carrot every day. Interview Process We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Performance Task — 60 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $98,000.00- $125,000.00. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/carrot-business-intelligence-analyst

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote Poland At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most. We’re looking for a curious, driven professional to join our Revenue Analytics team. This builds and owns the data products, reporting infrastructure, semantic foundations, and analytical systems that power Affirm’s Revenue organization. As a Senior Analyst, Revenue Analytics, you’ll build scalable data products that power day-to-day decision-making - owning end-to-end work across data modeling, metric definitions, dashboards, automation, and enablement. You’ll also help strengthen our semantic layer and data governance, laying the foundation for reliable AI. The ideal candidate combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested data infrastructure. What you'll do Develop dbt data models, dashboards, metrics, and automation processes for the revenue field team and revenue analysts Build and maintain critical reporting data models that power external merchant reporting Build the semantic, metadata, and context layers that allow AI systems to accurately understand Revenue data, metrics, and business definitions Partner with Business Systems, engineering, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data products Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows) Develop processes, governance, and foundations to scale the impact of analytics within Revenue. What we look for 3+ years of work experience in an analytics engineering or business intelligence role Strong working knowledge of SQL, dbt, Python, data modeling, and data visualization Hands-on experience with BI tools (Sigma/Looker/Tableau), Databricks, and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake) Understanding of the data foundations required for reliable AI, including semantic layers, metadata, evals, metric definitions, documentation, and data quality Demonstrated experience integrating AI tools into day-to-day analytics engineering workflows to improve development speed, quality, and scalability Familiarity with Salesforce and experience supporting commercial areas of the business Ability to identify user needs and translate them into robust, scalable data products Ability to start with an ambiguous problem, deconstruct it into tangible steps, and work toward an impactful solution Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Total rewards We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That's why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being, and future. In service of our mission, we reward employees through a combination of base pay, equity (from parent company), and comprehensive benefits. Base Pay Grade - K 226 000 zł - 346 000 zł Base pay ranges and placement within those ranges are determined based on several factors, including role, experience, and job-related skills. In addition to base pay, all employees in this role are eligible to receive equity from the parent company each year. This means as Affirm’s parent company grows, employees have the opportunity to share in that growth financially. Equity Grade - 2 (awarded in US Dollars) Affirm Holdings, Inc. Equity Grade example Equity grade: 2 New hire equity: $16,000-$24,000 Annual Refresh: $5,000 Reward equity: $0-$75,000 Affirm also provides flexible spending wallets to all employees for technology and wellbeing related needs, which are reimbursable up to 1390 zł per month. In addition to your compensation, our comprehensive benefits are designed to support you and the people who matter most. Benefits include: Competitive paid time off, paid public holidays, and additional paid Away Days to rest and recharge. Comprehensive private healthcare through Lux Med's Platinum package. A MultiSport card to support your health and well-being. Learning and development programs to help you grow professionally. Family healthcare support through Maven and parental leave support through Parentaly. Mental well-being support through Lyra, including up to 12 confidential counseling or coaching sessions each year for you and your household members. Financial well-being support through Northstar, with unlimited access to Certified Financial Advisors and planning tools at no cost to you. Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) that foster connection and inclusion. Eligibility for creative tax benefits, subject to applicable law, role, and company policy. Location - Remote Poland The majority of our roles can be located anywhere in Poland. **This job description is not a contractual document, and is not intended to have binding force.** #LI-Remote Remote-first with flexibility built in Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience. Benefits designed for you Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights: Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents. Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you. Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to. Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount. We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help. For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/affirm-analytics-engineer-ii-full-stack-revenue-analytics

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote - United States Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com . We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base. Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas. Responsibilities: Be a key contributor and collaborator to the success of data quality, performance, reliability, and automation initiatives. Manage a portfolio of data products that deliver high-quality, trustworthy data Develop and maintain robust data pipelines and workflows for data ingestion, processing, and transformation. Work closely with engineering to ensure the quality and reliability of these data pipelines. Develop and implement data quality checks, conduct QA and implement monitoring routines Create and manage new data integrations across internal and external systems Create tools and applications for internal use that streamline data analysis and reporting. Drive widespread adoption of these tools and applications with a relentless focus on automation, consistency, and reliability. Serve as a thought partner for data scientists, engineering managers, and leadership on data foundations, communicating and shaping the data foundations roadmap and strategy for Reddit. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in computer science or a quant educational field 3+ years of experience working with large-scale ETL systems (implementation, strategy, and maintenance), building clean, maintainable code and systems (Python preferred) in a production environment. Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc. Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data. Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering. Experience in data analysis and dashboard design. Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases. Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration. Agentic AI-assisted development experience. Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen. Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team. Check out our r/RedditEng post to learn more about the team, and what we do: https://www.reddit.com/r/RedditEng/comments/1mnmf71/analytics_engineering_reddit/ Benefits: Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs 401k with Employer Match Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support Family Planning Support Gender-Affirming Care Mental Health & Coaching Benefits Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off Generous Paid Parental Leave #LI-Remote Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ . To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below. The base salary range for this position is: $164,200 — $229,990 USD In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/reddit-analytics-engineer

items.title: Senior Data Analytics Engineer
items.summary: SUMMARYThe Senior Data Analytics Engineer is responsible for developing and maintaining analytical models, dashboards, and data products that surface meaningful intelligence across the organization.
items.description: SUMMARY The Senior Data Analytics Engineer is responsible for developing and maintaining analytical models, dashboards, and data products that surface meaningful intelligence across the organization. Additionally, this role partners closely with application development, data engineering, and business teams to deliver scalable, well-governed analytics solutions aligned with regulatory and client requirements in the financial services industry. TECHNOLOGY STACK Snowflake Data Cloud. Microsoft SQL Server and advanced SQL. Power BI (report development, data modeling, and deployment). ETL/ELT frameworks and data pipelines. Microsoft Azure. Data governance, security, and access control tooling. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Designs, develops, and maintains Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic data models that support operational and executive decision-making. Builds and maintains statistical models, trend analyses, and forecasting tools to support fund administration workflows and client reporting. Ensures data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across reporting outputs by partnering with governance and quality initiatives. Documents analytical methodologies, data definitions, report logic, and model assumptions to support transparency and auditability. Monitors and optimizes Power BI and Snowflake query performance to ensure efficient, reliable report delivery. Stays current with emerging trends and capabilities in data science, analytics engineering, and business intelligence tooling. WORKING RELATIONSHIPS Provides analytical guidance and mentorship to internal teams consuming data products. Partners with business stakeholders to gather requirements, defines KPIs, and translates analytical needs into scalable data products. Collaborates with technology team members to influence the design of data pipelines and structures that support analytics and reporting use cases. Mentors associates through instruction, coaching, providing real-time on-the-job experiences, modeling effective practices, and advising on methods used. May perform other duties as required and assigned. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE 3+ years of experience in data science, analytics engineering, or business intelligence, with strong hands on development and deployment of Power BI reports and data models in production environments. Experience querying and working with data in Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms, along with Power BI Service administration, low level security, and enterprise scale deployment. Financial services experience, ideally supporting fund administration or asset management platforms. KNOWLEDGE ETL/ELT tools and modern data engineering frameworks. Regulatory and compliance considerations related to financial data. Statistical analysis, data wrangling, and exploratory data analysis techniques. Machine learning or predictive modeling techniques applied to business use cases. Microsoft Office Suite. Adobe Acrobat. SKILLS AND ABILITIES Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong attention to data accuracy, with experience implementing data validation and quality checks. contributing to or defining enterprise analytics standards and data strategy. Aligns associates with company values and goals. Plans and delegates the work of others. Motivates and inspires others. Assesses the performance of self and associates to make improvements or take corrective action. Plans and develops systems and procedures to improve operating quality and efficiency of department in accordance with company policies and procedures. Troubleshoots issues utilizing creative and critical thinking skills. Multitasking, analytical, and organizational skills. Initiative-taking, strategic, and meticulous approaches with a strong commitment to quality, efficiency, and effectiveness. Demonstrates personal integrity, responsibility, and accountability. Effectively uses resources such as time and information in conjunction with associates. Participates in solving problems and making decisions. Presents and expresses ideas and information, written and oral, clearly, and concisely. Actively listens to others to achieve understanding and supports an open exchange of ideas and information. Identifies needs, arranges for, and obtains resources to accomplish individual and department goals. Establishes and develops effective working relationships with associates and clientele during both favorable and unfavorable situations. Modifies team and individual priorities and deadlines in response to added information, changing conditions, or unexpected obstacles and ensures completion. Equivalent education, experience, and KSA’s will be considered. Ultimus is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of the applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran or military status, genetic information, citizenship or any other status entitled to protection under federal, state or local anti-discrimination laws. No questions on our employment application are intended to secure information that is to be used for impermissible purposes. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Product Manager - Data & Insights
items.summary: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate.
items.description: Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate. Our team is made up of 400+ energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies. We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big! Meet the team! Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic ’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team. As a Product Manager, Data & Insights, you will lead the development of both customer-facing dashboards and internal reporting systems. This role sits at the intersection of product management, data engineering, and analytics, responsible for delivering intuitive, reliable, and scalable reporting experiences for both external users and internal stakeholders. You will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for reporting capabilities—from customer research and data modeling through to delivery, governance, and continuous improvement. You will partner closely with data engineers, analysts, UX teams, and business stakeholders to build a robust data ecosystem that enables self-service analytics, supports compliance requirements, and delivers meaningful insights for executive decision-making. You will also champion and lead data compliance initiatives across all Unifonic products, ensuring that data is managed responsibly, securely, and in alignment with organizational and regulatory requirements. Help us shape the future of communication by: Defining and executing the roadmap for customer-facing analytics, reporting portals, and internal reporting infrastructure. Align reporting solutions with business goals and customer needs. Collaborate with leadership to prioritize initiatives based on impact, complexity, and business value. Be an advisor for other Product teams in data strategy and design. Collecting business and technical requirements from cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Operations, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering. Developing detailed feature requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and data contracts for reporting systems. Translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined reporting needs and KPIs. Partnering closely with data engineers to co-develop data models and data marts in the data warehouse (e.g., Snowflake, Qlik, Vertica). Understand schema design and how it impacts performance, usability, and extensibility of data reporting systems. Influence architectural decisions around extract-transform-load (ETL/ELT) processes and dimensional modeling. Owning and enforcing data governance standards, including data definitions, taxonomy, lineage, and version control. Defining processes for data quality verification and anomaly detection in collaboration with engineering and analytics teams. Be an advocate for data accuracy and a watchdog for misleading or incomplete insights. Owning the product experience and lifecycle for reporting and BI platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or Mode). Defining self-service analytics capabilities for internal teams. Create feedback loops to continually improve dashboard usability and relevance for both internal and external users. Acting as the bridge between technical and non-technical teams, translating business needs into technical requirements and vice versa. Present product updates, reporting insights, and metrics to executives and cross-functional teams. Facilitate decision-making on trade-offs related to data availability, accuracy, and reporting timelines. Requirements What you’ll bring: 5+ years of experience in product management, data, analytics, or reporting platforms, with a strong focus on data-driven products. Proven experience delivering customer-facing reporting products, dashboards, and internal analytics solutions. Strong understanding of data privacy, governance, and compliance frameworks, including GDPR and PDPL. Experience working cross-functionally with data engineers, analysts, product teams, UX, and business stakeholders. Hands-on experience with data warehouses such as ClickHouse, Vertica, or Snowflake, and BI tools such as Metabase, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or Sigma. Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of data modeling concepts, including fact and dimension tables and star schemas. Familiarity with ELT pipelines, dbt, and data orchestration tools is a plus. Understanding of data quality, data integrity, scalability, and performance considerations when building reporting solutions. Ability to define business KPIs and translate business and reporting needs into clear data and product requirements. Experience contributing to data governance, data integrity, and compliance initiatives. Ability to balance performance, usability, scalability, and cost when designing data and reporting solutions. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex data concepts into clear business requirements and insights. Proven ability to lead cross-functional discussions, align stakeholders around data strategy, and communicate reporting goals and insights effectively. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field AI Proficiency: Minimum Level:L4 (Proficient). Applies AI across product discovery, specification, prototyping, and stakeholder communication. Expected : Uses AI to speed up research, specs, and prototyping, and personally owns the accuracy of every output. Hands-on experience with Claude and Lovable. Writes structured prompts (role, context, constraints, format) and refines the prompt rather than patching outputs by hand. Synthesizes interviews, tickets, and reviews into themes and testable insights, and validates every insight against source data before sharing. Drafts PRDs, user stories, and executive updates with AI as a first-draft partner, then verifies every claim and number before it reaches leadership. Builds clickable prototypes in Lovable to validate ideas with stakeholders, and is clear that a prototype is not production-ready. Understands how AI agents are built (prompts, tools, memory, guardrails) and proactively identifies workflows worth automating. Flags AI risks (hallucination, bias, data privacy, over-reliance) and knows what should and shouldn't be AI-assisted. Craft and Toolkit: Strong SQL and data analysis skills. Experience with data warehouses such as Snowflake, ClickHouse, or Vertica. Knowledge of data modeling, dimensional modeling, data marts, and data pipelines. Experience with BI and reporting tools such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or Metabase. Understanding of ETL/ELT, dbt, and data orchestration. Knowledge of data governance, quality, lineage, and compliance. Understanding of GDPR, PDPL, and data privacy principles. Ability to define KPIs, data requirements, data contracts, and reporting specifications. Understanding of scalable, performant, and cost-effective reporting architectures. Character Traits: Analytical thinking and problem-solving – approach problems clearly, use data, and find solutions. Ownership and accountability – take responsibility and follow projects through to completion. Communication – explain ideas clearly and listen to others across teams. Collaboration – work well with others and support team goals. Adaptability and learning – adjust to change and keep learning new skills or tools. Mentorship and knowledge sharing – help others grow and share what you know. Resilience – stay calm under pressure and handle setbacks constructively. Quality and attention to detail – do work carefully and strive for improvement. Advocacy and innovation – encourage best practices, efficiency, and new ideas As a Unifone you’ll receive a range of benefits: Competitive salary and bonus Unifonic share scheme (we are all owners!) 30 holiday days after the first anniversary Your Birthday off! Spend up to 25 days per year working from anywhere in the world! Paid leave for new parents Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: Risk Analyst / Risk Manager â Remote Enterprise Risk | Compliance | Governance | Financial & Operational Risk Position Type: Full-Time, Remote Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (with flexibility for reporting cycles, audits, and incident response) About the Role At Pavago, weâre hiring on behalf of one of our clients for a Risk Analyst / Risk Manager to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate financial, operational, compliance, and enterprise risks across the organization. This is a high-impact role where youâll help safeguard the business by developing risk frameworks, analyzing emerging threats, strengthening internal controls, and delivering actionable insights that support strategic decision-making. Youâll work closely with Finance, Operations, Compliance, Legal, IT, and Executive Leadership to ensure the organization remains compliant, resilient, and prepared for evolving business risks. If youâre analytical, detail-oriented, and enjoy translating complex risk data into practical business recommendations, this role is built for you. What Youâll OwnEnterprise Risk Assessment Conduct enterprise-wide risk assessments across: Financial risk Operational risk Compliance risk Market risk Cybersecurity risk Maintain and update: Risk registers Control matrices Risk assessments Remediation trackers Identify emerging risks and prioritize mitigation activities. Partner with business leaders to strengthen proactive risk management practices. Risk Modeling & Analytics Build and maintain quantitative risk models using: SQL Excel Python R SAS Perform: Stress testing Scenario analysis Sensitivity analysis Regression analysis Monte Carlo simulations Value at Risk (VaR) modeling Analyze trends, anomalies, and key risk indicators (KRIs). Deliver data-driven recommendations to leadership. Compliance & Regulatory Oversight Support compliance with applicable frameworks such as: SOX Basel III Dodd-Frank GDPR HIPAA PCI-DSS Industry-specific regulations Prepare quarterly and annual compliance reports. Support internal and external audits. Maintain audit-ready documentation and evidence. Track remediation activities and regulatory deadlines. Internal Controls & Governance Test and evaluate internal controls. Monitor incidents, exceptions, and risk events through Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) platforms. Support governance committees with reporting and documentation. Partner with IT and Security teams on: Cyber risk Vendor risk Operational resilience Recommend improvements to governance processes and internal controls. Reporting & Executive Communication Build dashboards and reports using: Power BI Tableau Looker Excel Present risk trends and mitigation recommendations to leadership. Translate technical risk findings into clear business insights. Maintain accurate documentation for executive reporting and audit purposes. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with: Finance Operations Compliance Legal IT & Security Executive Leadership Embed risk awareness into business processes. Support continuous improvement of enterprise risk management frameworks. RequirementsMust-Have QualificationsExperience 3+ years of experience in: Risk Management Enterprise Risk Compliance Audit Governance Experience working within regulated or compliance-driven environments. Core Skills Strong proficiency in: SQL Microsoft Excel Data analysis Experience using Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) platforms such as: Archer ServiceNow LogicManager Or similar solutions Strong understanding of: Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Internal controls Regulatory compliance Experience creating executive dashboards and risk reports. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Nice to Have Professional certifications such as: FRM CFA CPA CCEP Experience with: VaR Monte Carlo simulations Stress testing Background in: Financial Services Healthcare SaaS Enterprise Technology Experience supporting board reporting or executive governance committees. Knowledge of: Cyber risk Vendor risk Operational resilience Experience using: Tableau Power BI Looker What Makes You a Strong Fit Strong analytical and quantitative mindset. Exceptional attention to detail. Able to simplify complex risk concepts for business stakeholders. Proactive in identifying issues before they become significant risks. Strong balance of technical expertise and business judgment. Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Tools & Technologies SQL Microsoft Excel Python R SAS Power BI Tableau Looker Archer ServiceNow LogicManager Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) platforms What a Typical Day Looks Like Review dashboards for emerging operational, financial, or compliance risks. Run quantitative risk analyses and stress tests. Update risk registers and remediation trackers. Test internal controls and validate governance processes. Prepare executive reports and compliance documentation. Collaborate with business teams to strengthen risk mitigation strategies. Track remediation progress and regulatory deadlines. In short: You serve as the organizationâs early-warning systemâidentifying, assessing, and mitigating risks before they impact the business. Key Metrics for Success (KPIs) Timely and accurate risk reporting. Internal controls tested and validated on schedule. Early identification and mitigation of business risks. Zero missed regulatory or audit deadlines. High-quality executive reporting and dashboards. Positive audit outcomes and leadership confidence. Why Join Us? Make a direct impact on enterprise risk strategy. Work closely with executive leadership and cross-functional teams. Influence governance, compliance, and operational resilience. Build scalable risk management frameworks. Fully remote role with long-term growth opportunities. Clear career progression into: Senior Risk Manager Enterprise Risk Lead Director of Risk & Compliance Chief Risk Officer (CRO) Interview Process Application Review Spark Hire Intro Video (3â5 minutes) Recruiter Interview Practical Assessment (Risk Analysis & Recommendations) Client Interview Offer & Background Verification What Happens After You Apply Right after you apply, youâll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the final step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever itâs convenient for you. Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, youâll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps hiring managers evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful and reducing unnecessary interview rounds. Donât overthink itâyou can record your video as many times as youâd like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed. Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application. Apply Now If youâre a Risk Analyst or Risk Manager who enjoys identifying business risks, strengthening governance, improving compliance, and helping organizations make informed decisions, weâd love to hear from you. Apply today and play a key role in protecting and strengthening a growing business. Please mention the word **IMPRESSIVENESS** and tag RMjAuOTguMTQwLjExOQ== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuOTguMTQwLjExOQ==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.summary: Headquarters: Remote About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of member
items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Remote About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is seeking a Sr. Manager, Data Engineering to lead our Business Intelligence data engineering function as it scales to meet, and anticipate, the needs of the organization and its clients. This is a senior player/coach role with a strong emphasis on strategic leadership, technical excellence, and organizational impact. You will lead and grow a high-impact team while remaining deeply hands-on in architecting and building Carrot's data infrastructure. You will set technical vision, drive cross-functional data strategy, and ensure our data systems are reliable, scalable, secure, and aligned with business priorities. You will influence and execute on the long-term roadmap for Data Engineering within the Data Team, defining how we ingest, transform, govern, and expose data across the company, and partner closely with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics, and Go-To-Market functions. Given the small-but-mighty nature of the team, this role requires someone who is comfortable operating at multiple altitudes: setting multi-year architectural direction, shaping team and org design, and still rolling up their sleeves to build production-grade pipelines when needed. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Own the technical vision and roadmap for BI data engineering, aligning it with company strategy and analytics needs. Design, build, and review scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and workflow orchestration systems, contributing hands-on production code in Python and SQL . Architect and optimize data warehouse models that support advanced analytics, self-service BI, and operational reporting. Establish and enforce standards for reliability, observability, testing, and performance across all data systems. Drive improvements in data quality, lineage, and governance , including documentation and metadata practices. Partner with backend product engineering teams to co-design production database schemas and event models with analytics and reporting in mind. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data engineers , fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and collaboration. Own team-level planning and execution , including capacity planning, prioritization, and delivery across concurrent workstreams. Translate ambiguous business and analytics needs into a clear, prioritized engineering roadmap with measurable outcomes. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Security, and Legal to align on priorities, ensure compliance, and remove cross-functional blockers. Evaluate and influence build vs. buy decisions , vendor selection, and tool adoption across data platforms, ingestion, and transformation. What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Elevated the maturity and consistency of data engineering practices across the BI function, with clear standards for reliability, testing, and observability. Built and retained a high-performing data engineering team recognized as a trusted partner to stakeholders across the business. Delivered a prioritized data engineering roadmap aligned with company strategy, with measurable progress on scalability and platform modernization. Strengthened the accuracy, recency, and security of enterprise data, meeting the requirements of regulated healthcare contexts. Enabled advanced analytics, self-service BI, and data products that drive meaningful business outcomes and influence Carrot's long-term data architecture strategy. About You You likely have: 8-10+ years of experience in data engineering or a closely related field, including 3-5+ years leading and managing data or software engineers. 5+ years of advanced SQL and 5+ years of Python development experience in production environments, including unit and integration testing. Strong, hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines in production. Proficiency with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS) and modern ingestion, transformation, and orchestration tools (e.g., Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, Airflow). Strong understanding of relational modeling and warehouse design principles , plus version control (Git preferred) and modern CI/CD practices. Demonstrated ability to define technical strategy and standards while remaining capable of direct technical execution. Excellent written and verbal communication skills , with strong knowledge of data governance, security best practices, and compliance protocols. Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Direct experience with Carrot's current tech stack : Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Prefect, and AWS. Experience with enterprise BI platforms and enabling self-service analytics. Experience integrating batch and event-streaming or real-time ingestion systems . Prior experience leading data engineering teams in a startup or high-growth environment , ideally including managing other leads or senior-level ICs. Healthcare industry experience , including familiarity with healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR) and privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR). Why This Role Matters The reliability, scalability, and usability of Carrot's data systems directly power decision-making across the organization and for our clients. Data Engineering plays a foundational role in enabling the broader Business Intelligence function, and this role serves as the senior-most manager directly responsible for that capability. The Business Intelligence team at Carrot is highly cross-functional and central to the company's long-term success. Led by our Vice President of Data and Business Intelligence, the team includes data engineers, data scientists, and business intelligence analysts. In this role, you will build and nurture a high-performing team, ensure the accuracy and security of enterprise data in a regulated healthcare context, and influence the long-term data architecture and platform strategy at Carrot. Interview Process We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation: Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $170,000-$210,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/carrot-sr-manager-data-engineering
