items.summary: Headquarters: Remote About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of member
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote About Carrot: Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide. Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com . The Opportunity Carrot is seeking a Sr. Data Engineer to lead the evolution, reliability, and scalability of our modern data infrastructure across analytics, reporting, and business intelligence. In this role, you will architect, build, and maintain robust, automated data pipelines, orchestrate workflows, integrate diverse data sources, and partner with stakeholders across the business to deliver secure, compliant, high-quality data solutions. Your work will span the full data lifecycle, from architecting resilient ETL/ELT pipelines and developing real-time and batch data integrations to automating reporting, reducing technical debt, and enabling advanced analytics. Sr. Data Engineers at Carrot are operational stewards and technical mentors, driving improvements in system maturity, cost efficiency, automation, and collaborative practices. You will join our Data Engineering team, which develops and optimizes scalable data pipelines and cloud infrastructure to enable secure, automated reporting and analytics across Carrot. The team collaborates closely with Business Intelligence, Product, Finance, Legal, and Commercial partners to deliver reliable integrations and self-serve solutions that drive business insights and operational efficiency. What You’ll Own In this role, you will: Architect, build, test, deploy, and maintain scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, dbt, and orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow Administer and optimize cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud, integrating new sources and tuning for performance and cost Orchestrate data workflows with custom scheduling, alerting, dependency management, monitoring, and error resolution Design and maintain secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance Automate manual reporting and operational tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components that reduce operational overhead Partner with backend product engineers to optimize production database schemas with analytics use cases in mind Strengthen data quality, lineage, governance, and documentation practices across key data domains Mentor teammates and reinforce best practices in version control, code review, and structured workflow management What Success Looks Like In your first 12–18 months, you will have: Taken end-to-end ownership of core pipelines and integrations, with measurable improvements in reliability, data recency, and cost efficiency Automated high-effort manual workflows, reducing operational risk and freeing capacity for higher-value engineering work Delivered secure, compliant data integrations that stakeholders across the business trust for decision-making Strengthened observability across the platform, including monitoring, alerting, and incident response for critical data workflows Established yourself as a technical mentor and a go-to partner for Business Intelligence, Product, and cross-functional teams About You You likely have: Expert-level proficiency in Snowflake, dbt, and Python for data modeling, transformation, pipeline development, and advanced analytics Advanced SQL skills for complex querying, large-scale data model design, and database optimization Proven experience architecting, building, testing, deploying, and maintaining scalable, automated ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools such as Prefect and Airflow Hands-on administration of cloud-based data warehouse and lake platforms, including Snowflake, AWS (S3, Redshift), and Google Cloud A strong understanding of secure external data flows through SFTP, Files.com, and APIs, with a focus on reliability and compliance Mastery of version control (Git, GitHub) and structured workflow management (Jira) for code review, audit trails, and operational transparency A demonstrated ability to automate and simplify complex manual tasks, building robust, reusable pipeline components Dependability, adaptability, and a collaborative approach to engineering, thriving in dynamic and ambiguous environments Nice to Have ⭐ While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring: Hands-on experience in startup or rapid-growth environments, delivering technical solutions under shifting priorities A background supporting business intelligence, analytics, and data science teams through large-scale integrations and multi-tenant reporting Familiarity with both batch and event-driven ingestion paradigms, including near-real-time pipelines built on Snowflake, dbt, and Python Experience automating operational, financial, or compliance-driven workflows within cloud data environments Exposure to audit, privacy, and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO, and SOX, particularly in data governance and secure access controls Experience in regulated industries such as healthcare, healthtech, or SaaS Why This Role Matters Reliable data is the foundation of how Carrot operates, from the analytics that guide business decisions to the reporting our customers and partners depend on. The systems this role owns determine the accuracy, recency, and security of data used across the entire company. As Carrot scales globally, the Sr. Data Engineer will make our data platform more automated, resilient, and cost-efficient, enabling teams across the business to move faster with data they trust. This work directly supports Carrot's mission of expanding access to fertility and family-building care worldwide. Interview Process We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team. For this role, candidates can expect: Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes Cross-Functional Panel Interviews — 45 minutes Executive Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes Hiring Manager Wrap-Up — 15 minutes Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role. Why Candidates Join Carrot Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission. Highlights include: A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally. A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact. Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits. Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge. Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits. A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture. The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide. Compensation: Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $145,000-$165,000. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com A Note on AI At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves. Why Carrot? Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/carrot-sr-data-engineer

items.title: PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT SPECIALIST
items.summary: DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC SECURITYYour Partner For A Stronger Arizona.
items.description: DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC SECURITY Your Partner For A Stronger Arizona. DES works with families, community organizations, advocates and state and federal partners to realize our collective vision: A thriving Arizona. DES serves more than 3 million Arizonans. Our Mission is to strengthen individuals, families, and communities for a better quality of life. PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENT SPECIALIST Job Location: Address:Division of Developmental Disabilities (DDD) 4000 N. CENTRAL AVENUE, 4th FLOOR PHOENIX, ARIZONA 85012 Posting Details: Salary: $65,000.00 - $70,500.00 Grade: 21 Closing Date: 11/4/2026 Job Summary: Would you like to be part of an amazing team that makes Arizonans thrive? At the Arizona Department of Economic Security (DES) we strengthen individuals, families, and communities for a better quality of life. DES is looking for individuals who are committed to service, community, and teamwork. To learn more about DES please visit or click here on the link to view ‘Our DES’ video. Come Join the DES Team! The Department of Economic Security, Division of Developmental Disabilities (DDD), is seeking an experienced and highly motivated individual to join our team as a Performance Improvement Specialist. DDD provides individuals with developmental disabilities, and their families, services and supports that are flexible, high quality, and member driven. These services provide individuals with opportunities to exercise their rights and responsibilities of independent decision-making and engagement in the community. Applicants for this position cannot be licensed or certified by the DDD Office of Licensing Certification and Regulation, cannot have a principal interest in or have a spouse or close family with principal interest in a DDD Qualified Vendor Agreement, and cannot be employed or subcontracted by a DDD Qualified Vendor. This position is available for remote work on a full-time basis within Arizona (including virtual office arrangements). OR This position may be available for remote work within Arizona (# days per week in the office/hoteling). OR This position may offer the ability to work remotely, within Arizona, based upon the department's business needs and continual meeting of expected performance measures. The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that affords employees flexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, and commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in offices, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona unless an exception is properly authorized in advance. Job Duties: Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to: •Gathers, organizes and verifies various data from multiple sources for various projects including data entry and data verification from source documents. •Analysis and verification of existing healthcare data sets. Experience in supporting and maintaining existing projects. Ability to develop guides and standard work instructions. •Develops new data spreadsheets, databases, and/or data gathering processes based on project needs. •Participates planning and analysis for future or anticipated data collection, analysis, and storage needs based on new requirements or new projects. •Develops and administers performance dashboards, reporting, and data visualization for healthcare data; visual representation of tracking and trending for performance improvement. • Track performance measures over time, identifying areas for improvement and assessing the effectiveness of interventions. •Develop and maintain interactive dashboards using Tableau to visualize data and support informed decision-making. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs): Knowledge in: DES Division of Developmental Disabilities functions, requirements and the needs of its members. •Data gathering, storage, and analysis principles. •Project management principles. •Medicare/Medicaid requirements. Lean/continuous improvement principles. •CMS/HEDIS measure performance. •Basic understanding of ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS and NDC codes. Skills In: •Utilizing Google sheets and other computation and data storage programs. •Excellent oral and written communication skills. •Management of multiple projects/duties concurrently. •Organizing the work of multiple projects. •Experience with Data dashboard design (Tableau preferred). •Proficiency in creating and designing presentations using Google Slides. Ability To: •Work with diverse internal/external customers. •Self-determine priorities and complete projects. •Maintain mental focus for extended periods of time. •Maintain accuracy and efficiency while performing repetitive tasks (data entry) over long periods of time. •Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail. Selective Preference(s): The ideal candidate for this position will have: •A Bachelor’s degree is preferred; work experience of one year within the Division may substitute for a degree. Experience with healthcare data, extracting, transforming, and cleaning data. Experience with developing/managing Google sheets tables as source data for BI dashboards. Experience with Microsoft Excel/Google Sheets formulas, pivot tables & charts, data analysis, and reporting. Pre-Employment Requirements: All newly hired State employees are subject to and must successfully complete the Electronic Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E-Verify). • Valid Arizona Driver’s License. Travel may be required for State business. Employees who drive on state business must complete any required driver training (see Arizona Administrative Code R2-10-207.12.) AND have an acceptable driving record in accordance with DES Fleet Management-Safety Program policy and procedures (DES 1-07-26 & DES 1-07-26-01). Employees may be required to use their own transportation as well as maintaining valid motor vehicle insurance and current Arizona vehicle registration however, mileage will be reimbursed. If this position requires driving or the use of a vehicle as an essential function of the job to conduct State business, then the following requirements apply: Driver’s License Requirements. All newly hired State employees are subject to and must successfully complete the Electronic Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E-Verify). Benefits: The Arizona Department of Economic Security offers a comprehensive benefits package to include: • Affordable medical, dental, life, and short-term disability insurance plans • Participation in the Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) and long-term disability plans • 10 paid holidays per year • Paid vacation and sick time Paid Parental Leave-Up to 12 weeks per year paid leave for newborn or newly-placed foster/adopted child. • Deferred compensation plan • Wellness plans • Tuition Reimbursement • Stipend Opportunities • Infant at Work Program • Rideshare and Public Transit Subsidy • Career Advancement & Employee Development Opportunities By providing the option of a full-time or part-time remote work schedule, employees enjoy improved work/life balance, report higher job satisfaction, and are more productive. Remote work is a management option and not an employee entitlement or right. An agency may terminate a remote work agreement at its discretion. Retirement: State employees are required to participate in the Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS), the State sponsored retirement contribution plan and the Long-Term Disability (LTD) program after a 27-week waiting period. The ASRS defined benefit plan provides for life-long income upon retirement. You will also have the option to participate in a voluntary deferred compensation program to take advantage of tax-deferred retirement investments. On, or shortly after, your first day of work you will be provided with additional information about the available insurance plans, enrollment instructions, submission deadlines and effective dates. Contact Us: For questions about this career opportunity, please contact us Alyssa Figueroa at 602-653-9837 or . The State of Arizona is an Equal Opportunity/Reasonable Accommodation Employer. Persons with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation such as a sign language interpreter or an alternative format by contacting 602-653-9837 or should be made as early as possible to allow time to arrange the accommodation. Salary: $66,000.00 - $71,000.00 | Pay Scale: 21 Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Media Buyer
items.summary: Our client, Jugabet, is a brand and gaming platform accessible to players in Latin America.
items.description: Our client, Jugabet, is a brand and gaming platform accessible to players in Latin America. With a strong regional focus and localized strategies, Jugabet is quickly becoming a key player in the market. Perfect for those who aim to: Plan, launch, and scale ad campaigns on Facebook and TikTok (Google UAC is a plus) targeting relevant iGaming audiences in Mexico; Build and continuously refine the audience layer: Look-A-Like and Custom audiences based on depositors, high-value players, and in-app events; Design and run retargeting funnels across the full path (install, registration, first deposit, etc.); Launch and optimize ROAS / value-based campaigns (value optimization, tROAS); Manage ad accounts for the long run: respect the learning phase, control creative fatigue cycles, scale incrementally, and keep performance stable over months instead of restarting from scratch; Own the app acquisition funnel: deep links, in-app event mapping, and passing deposit events back to Meta and TikTok via CAPI / server-side tracking; Optimize toward cohort economics, not just front-end CPA: work with D7/D30 ROAS, retention, and player LTV together with the CRM and retention teams; Analyze campaign data, build performance reports, and identify improvement areas across every platform (experience with Tableau or Power BI is a plus); Collaborate with creative and content teams to develop l ocalized ad assets for Regulated Market — language, cultural context, and seasonality; Conduct structured A/B testing (creatives, audiences, bidding strategies) to improve performance and engagement; Stay on top ofMeta and TikTok gambling ad policies and platform updates that affect the vertical; Monitor competitors and market trends across paid social to spot new opportunities. Experience you’ll need to bring: 2+ years of hands-on media buying on Facebook and TikTok (Google UAC is a plus), with a proven track record in regulated LATAM iGaming markets; Experience promoting products on white / regulated iGaming markets — or a strong background in white niches (mobile apps, gaming) with a clear understanding of platforms compliance; Confident work with Facebook Ads Manager and TikTok Ads Manager: campaign structure, Advantage+/ASC, bidding strategies, CBO/ABO budget distribution; Hands-on experience building and testing Look-A-Like and Custom audiences, with a clear sense of which source audiences actually scale; Experience with retargeting in Facebook: funnel logic, audiences, exclusions, and creative sequencing; Experience launching and scaling ROAS-based campaigns and understanding how conversion data quality drives algorithm performance; Understanding of how FB/TikTok algorithms behave over time: learning phase, signal quality, creative fatigue, incremental scaling instead of aggressive edits; Solid setup of tracking and attribution: Pixel, CAPI / server-side events, deep links, AppsFlyer / Adjust, S2S postbacks, Voluum or similar trackers; Comfortable with app-based acquisition: WebView / iOS / Android apps, MMP configuration, in-app event tracking; Understanding of core metrics: CPM, CPC, CTR, CPI, CPR, CPD, CPA, ROAS / ROMI, plus retention and LTV of acquired players; Experience working with budgets from $50,000+ per month, with a demonstrated ability to scale while keeping CPA profitable; Working knowledge of Meta and TikTok gambling policies: licensed advertiser setup, whitelisting, and healthy ad account structure; Upper-Intermediate level of English. It's a perfect match if you have those personal features: Analytical & Data-Driven mindset: enjoys diving into numbers, spotting trends, and making performance-based decisions; Detail-Oriented: carefully monitors campaign metrics, budgets, and compliance to avoid costly mistakes; Proactive & Results-Oriented: takes initiative, owns performance, and is constantly looking for ways to improve ROMI; Strong Communication & Collaboration Skills: able to clearly communicate ideas, strategies, and results within the team, works well with cross-functional teams (creative, product, CRM, compliance) to hit shared goals. Our clients offer competitive benefits to support your professional and personal growth, including: Health & Wellness Focus; Global Medical Coverage; Growth Opportunities; Benefits Programs (compensation for the gym/stomatology/psychological service Performance-Driven Rewards; Dynamic Work Environment. Apply, and let your growth journey begin. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Solutions Engineer
items.summary: Consequential Work. Dedicated People. About Onebrief Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination. Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real. We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world. Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth. Why This Role Exists As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet. You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production. Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real. You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment. What You'll Do Core responsibilities: Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments. Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments. Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline. Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables. Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards. Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options. Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales. Turn field experience into patterns . Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering. Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises. Minimum Qualifications Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility. Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503) Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL) Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion Preferred Qualifications Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash) Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible) Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System Presales experience, including building and delivering demos Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief. items.description: Consequential Work. Dedicated People. About Onebrief Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination. Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real. We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world. Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth. Why This Role Exists As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet. You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production. Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real. You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment. What You'll Do Core responsibilities: Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments. Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments. Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline. Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables. Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards. Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options. Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales. Turn field experience into patterns . Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering. Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises. Minimum Qualifications Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility. Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503) Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes) Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL) Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion Preferred Qualifications Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash) Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible) Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System Presales experience, including building and delivering demos Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. items.summary: Our Mission: 6sense’s mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our People: People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Th
items.description: Our Mission: 6sense’s mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential. Our People: People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career. About the Role At 6sense, we believe exceptional people experiences are powered by great technology, trusted data, and meaningful insights. As the Sr. Manager, People Technology & Analytics, you will lead the strategy, governance, and evolution of our People technology ecosystem while transforming workforce data into actionable insights that drive business outcomes. Reporting to the Chief People Officer, this role sits at the intersection of People strategy, technology, analytics, and operational excellence. You will own the vision and roadmap for People systems, data governance, workforce analytics, reporting, and AI enablement, ensuring our People organization can scale effectively while delivering an exceptional employee and manager experience. You will partner closely with leaders across People, Finance, IT, Payroll, Legal, and the broader business to build a modern, data-driven People function that supports growth, improves decision-making, and creates operational efficiency. This is a highly visible role for a strategic leader who is equally comfortable shaping long-term direction, influencing senior stakeholders, and working directly in Workday to configure, test, troubleshoot, and optimize the system. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with the willingness and technical depth to solve complex operational challenges hands-on. What You’ll Do People Technology Strategy & Operations Own the strategy, governance, and continuous improvement of the People technology ecosystem, including Workday, Greenhouse, Pave, and related platforms. Serve as a hands-on leader who directly configures, tests, troubleshoots, and maintains business processes, security, reports, integrations, and functionality across the Workday modules in use. Develop and execute a multi-year People Technology roadmap aligned with business priorities and organizational growth. Ensure the scalability, effectiveness, security, and reliability of People systems and processes. Partner with IT, Security, Legal, and key business stakeholders to evaluate, implement, and optimize People technology solutions. Lead technology enhancements, vendor management, system upgrades, integrations, and new platform implementations. Drive process standardization and automation to improve efficiency and the employee experience. Establish strong governance practices for system configuration, change management, documentation, and compliance. People Analytics & Workforce Insights Serve as the organization’s trusted leader for workforce analytics, reporting, and People data strategy. Develop executive-level dashboards, reporting frameworks, and workforce metrics that enable informed decision-making. Translate complex workforce data into clear insights and recommendations for business leaders. Partner with Finance and business leaders on workforce planning, headcount management, organizational health, and talent investment decisions. Advance predictive and forward-looking analytics capabilities that help anticipate workforce trends and business needs. Ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and data integrity across all People systems. Data Governance & Compliance Establish and maintain best-in-class People data governance practices. Champion data quality, data management standards, and system integrity across the employee lifecycle. Ensure compliance with applicable employment, privacy, and data protection regulations. Create processes and controls that support audit readiness and operational excellence. Partner closely with Legal, Finance, and Security teams on compliance requirements and risk mitigation. AI, Automation & Innovation Lead the People organization’s approach to AI-enabled productivity and automation. Identify opportunities to simplify work, improve employee experiences, and enhance decision-making through emerging technologies. Evaluate new tools and capabilities that support recruiting, talent management, workforce planning, employee engagement, and People operations. Establish responsible AI governance and adoption practices within the People function. Educate and enable People team members on practical applications of AI and automation. Leadership & Capability Building Build and develop a high-performing People Technology and Analytics function. Create a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Establish clear priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations. Mentor and develop team members while fostering technical expertise, business acumen, and strategic thinking. Serve as a thought partner and trusted advisor to People leadership and business stakeholders. What You’ll Bring Required Experience 8+ years of progressive experience in HR Technology, People Analytics, Workforce Planning, HRIS, or related disciplines. 3+ years of people leadership experience. Deep hands-on Workday configuration and administration expertise across HCM, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, US Payroll, Talent Optimization, and Advanced Compensation, including business processes, security, reporting, testing, troubleshooting, and production support. Working knowledge of Workday integrations, including Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, Workday Studio, Reports as a Service (RaaS), REST APIs, and SOAP APIs. Experience leading Workday release planning and regression testing, including assessing release impacts, coordinating end-to-end testing, resolving defects, documenting changes, and ensuring production readiness. Familiarity with AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP), including their role in designing and orchestrating secure, scalable workflows that connect AI capabilities with enterprise systems, data, and People processes. Strong understanding of workforce analytics, data management, and reporting practices. Experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing decision-making through data and insights. Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives and technology implementations. Experience managing vendors, software evaluations, and technology roadmaps. Strong understanding of People processes across the employee lifecycle. Preferred Experience Experience in high-growth SaaS or technology companies. Experience supporting global organizations. Workday Pro certifications in one or more relevant functional areas, demonstrating advanced platform expertise and a commitment to Workday configuration best practices. Knowledge of Greenhouse, Pave, Tableau, Power BI, and related analytics platforms. Experience with workforce planning, organizational design, and strategic talent planning. Experience implementing AI-enabled HR technologies and automation solutions. Familiarity with data privacy and compliance requirements, including GDPR and other applicable regulations. Key Competencies Strategic Thinking Project & Program Management Business Acumen Data Governance Analytical Rigor Technology Innovation Executive Communication Cross-Functional Influence Systems Thinking Process Improvement Change Leadership Talent Development Success in the First 12 Months Establish a clear People Technology and Analytics roadmap aligned with business priorities. Improve overall data quality, reporting consistency, and system governance. Modernize executive workforce reporting and self-service analytics capabilities. Streamline and automate key People processes to improve efficiency and employee experience. Develop stronger workforce planning and organizational insights capabilities in partnership with Finance. Introduce practical AI-enabled solutions that improve the effectiveness of the People function. Build a scalable foundation for future growth through technology, analytics, and operational excellence. Base Salary Range: $132,402.75 - $194,190.70. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy Our Benefits: Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces. We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds. Equal Opportunity Employer: 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com. We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com

items.title: Global Meal Coordinator
items.summary: ABOUT ECHO ECHO is a global Christian agricultural networking, training, and resourcing organization.
items.description: ABOUT ECHO ECHO is a global Christian agricultural networking, training, and resourcing organization. Our mission is to strengthen the capacity of a diverse global network to defeat hunger and improve lives through sustainable food and agroecosystem strategies. ECHO has a significant network of over 20,000 individuals and organizations built over 45 years working in more than 190 countries. These partners serve as the primary multiplier for ECHO tested options, strategies, and research. WHY JOIN ECHO At ECHO, you will join a global Christian network committed to defeating hunger and restoring hope through sustainable agriculture. Our team is mission-driven, collaborative, and deeply committed to equipping leaders around the world with practical tools that create lasting impact. If you are passionate about faith-integrated service and sustainable solutions, you will find meaningful purpose in this role. SUMMARY: The Global Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning Coordinator is part of the Global MEAL team and contributes to ECHO’s development and roll-out of a Global MEAL system to foster the growth of a learning organization. The role helps ensure timely, accurate and useful program information is collected, analyzed and communicated through ECHO’s reporting processes, with reports reviewed and approved by the appropriate directors and executives. The role will contribute to the collection of quantitative data and qualitative stories to track progress on ECHO’s Strategic Framework Logframe indicators. This role requires a curious, proactive self-starter who gets excited about supporting our organization to move beyond a compliance attitude towards reporting on what happened, to always asking more questions on why and how change did or did not happen and what that means for strategic decision-making. This is a support role with room for initiative and independent work under the direction of the Global MEAL Lead; it does not carry decision-making authority. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: Growing a Learning Organization: Assist the Global MEAL Lead in improving ECHO’s global MEAL practices. Support teams at Regional Impact Centers to implement their learning agendas by contributing to their MEAL planning, tool development and activity planning. Document emerging results, lessons and stories of change for reporting and learning. Proactively participate in the Impact Learning Circles and engage in outcome harvesting and mapping exercises on a continuous basis. Facilitate regular reflection on monitoring and evaluation findings with program and regional teams. Regular Monitoring and Reporting: Support MEAL coordinators and reporting coordinators based at Regional Impact Centers with monthly reporting. Assist in managing the ECHO Kobo Toolbox account, including projects, tools and membership. Review submissions for completeness, consistency and data quality. Consolidate regional data, analyze progress against indicators, targets and annual plans and produce regular data summaries. Format and design reports with a clear layout and visual presentation that make data and stories of change easy to read and use. Support Tracking of Progress Towards Strategic Framework Logframe: Contribute to the development of both qualitative and quantitative tools. Train and assist teams in data collection towards Strategic Framework Logframe indicators, including occasional in-person trainings on site. Contribute to dashboarding and visualization of data. QUALIFICATIONS: Core Skills and Competencies: Technical MEAL Knowledge: Basic quantitative and qualitative monitoring, reporting, data analysis, and evaluation abilities. Relational Project Management: Strong emphasis on prioritizing building relationships above completing tasks with strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to flexibly manage multiple tasks independently. Communication Skills: Ability to communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders and collaborate in a cross-cultural, team-oriented environment, making complex ideas simple and attainable. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, other languages such as Thai, French, Spanish or Kiswahili are an added advantage. Data Protection and Safeguarding: Experience with data protection and safeguarding, and a commitment to upholding the dignity of communities and community members in how data, stories, and images are collected, stored, and shared. Learning attitude: A proactive self-starter with a demonstrated commitment to long-term personal growth and professional development, and to building advanced MEAL capacity and skills through this role as a step toward broader professional aspirations. Preferred Qualifications: Technical proficiency: Experience with Microsoft Sharepoint, experience with Kobo Toolbox as a data collection tool and PowerBI as a data visualization tool. Report design: Demonstrated skill in the formatting, layout, and design of reports, so that data and stories of change are clear, accurate, and engaging for varied audiences. Contextual knowledge: Experience with approaches to community-led MEAL approaches and holistic flourishing frameworks, such as the Light Wheel. Experience in the fields of food security, nutrition, agriculture, adult learning, or training is preferred. Additional Requirements: Must adhere to the ECHO Statement of Faith and possess character traits consistent with ECHO’s Core Values. REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Education: A bachelor’s degree in a related field (e.g., social sciences or information systems) is required. Experience: A minimum of 1 year of experience in MEAL practices in an NGO or foundation organizational setting. ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS: Positions Directly Supervised: This position has no direct reports. Those Directly Supported: Regional Impact Center staff, all MEAL staff and contributors. Others to Work Closely With: Advancement, Communications, Global Support Services, Department Managers, and the directors and executives who review and approve reports. WORK ENVIRONMENT: Primarily a computer-based office or remote work environment. There are occasional times when work is conducted in an outdoor or field office (international and domestic) setting, such as during site visits and trainings, which may involve hot and humid conditions. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This position is almost exclusively computer-based and requires the ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods and to communicate effectively in person and through virtual platforms. Occasional travel and on-site, in-person trainings may require standing or walking for periods of time. POSITION TYPE AND EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK: This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work may vary based on organizational needs. Occasional evening and weekend work may be required to fulfill job responsibilities and accommodate time zone differences. WORK LOCATION: This position may be performed remotely, in a hybrid arrangement, or at an ECHO Regional Impact Center, depending on organizational needs and position requirements. Candidates may be based in various countries, with a preference for those located in the Asia region . TRAVEL: Travel domestically and internationally may involve up to 10% of time annually. OTHER DUTIES: Undertake additional tasks as assigned, demonstrating flexibility and responsiveness to the organizational needs. Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: Paid Time Off (PTO) Paid Holidays Health Insurance with Monthly Employer Contribution Retirement Plan with Monthly Matching Employer Contribution Phone Stipend AAP/EEO STATEMENT: ECHO is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe it is our moral and legal obligation to meet the responsibility of ensuring that all management practices regarding employees are conducted in a nondiscriminatory manner. In compliance with Title VII of the 1964 Civil Rights Act, and other applicable federal and state statutes, all recruiting, hiring, training, and promoting for all job classifications will be administered without regard to race, color, ancestry, age, sex, national origin, pregnancy or childbirth, disability, military veteran status, genetic information, or other applicable status protected by law, including state of employment protected classes. It is, therefore, our policy and intention to evaluate all employees and prospective employees strictly according to the requirements of the job. ECHO is a Christian religious-affiliated organization; and as such, is not subject to religious discrimination requirements. ECHO’s hiring practices and EEO discrimination practices are in full compliance with both federal and state law. Federal law creates an exception to the “religion” component of the employment discrimination laws for religious organizations and permits them to give employment practice preference to members of their own religious beliefs. #LinkedIn Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Manager, Business Performance & Analysis
items.summary: ABOUT ALUALU provides higher education for a higher purpose.
items.description: ABOUT ALU ALU provides higher education for a higher purpose. Our students declare missions, not majors.They develop the real-world skills to take on the world’s most pressing challenges. And they take ownership of their learning from day one through our peer and student-led approach – because ALU believes in the power and agency of young people to start shaping the future right now. Together with a world-class faculty and staff, our students are igniting a ripple of positive impact across Africa and the world. We are dedicated to fostering an open yet secure environment, balancing the safety of students, staff, and visitors with respect for individual rights, and safeguarding responsibilities. HOW WE WORK The ALU Team works in starkly different ways to traditional academic bureaucracies. We approach education from first principles, empower individuals to design, test, and implement creative new ideas, and work closely together to craft transformative learning experiences. We are deeply passionate about our students and excited by the challenge of building something entirely new. The African Leadership University is committed to ensuring the safety and Well-being of all students under our care. As part of this commitment , we have a comprehensive safeguarding policy in place , which outlines our Zero-tolerance approach to any violation of safeguarding. ABOUT THE TEAM The Business Performance & Analysis team is one of ALU ’s core performance intelligence functions, providing the insight, analysis and challenge required to help leaders understand performance, make informed decisions and improve institutional outcomes. Working across academic and professional functions, the team goes beyond reporting what has happened to understand why it happened, what it means, what is likely to happen next, and what action is required. It brings together performance data, analysis and external benchmarks to identify trends, risks, opportunities and areas for improvement. The team connects strategy, performance and execution by strengthening performance measurement, supporting decision-making and helping leaders translate insight into action. Its impact is measured not by the volume of reports produced, but by the quality of decisions informed and the improvements in institutional performance that follow. ABOUT THE ROLE The institution generates a great deal of information and data across campuses, programmes and systems held by functions with different definitions and different reporting rhythms. The Manager, Business Performance & Analysis will assemble it, identify what matters in it and put that in front of the people who have to decide. You are expected to find the insight inside fragmented institutional information and make it usable by the people who have to act on it. This role goes beyond producing analysis to deciding what the analysis means, what can reasonably be concluded from it, and the form in which that meaning will actually land. The role will enable the University to act on what its own information is telling it by bringing together fragmented evidence, establishing what matters and putting it in front of the right person in a form they can use. ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES Research, Economic Analysis and Insight (the core of the role) Produce quantitative and economic analysis underpinning material submitted to the Executive Committee and the Board including scenario work, unit economics, capacity and cost modelling, cost behaviour, and the baseline scenario against which a decision should be judged. Take fragmentary, inconsistent and incomplete inputs from several functions and produce one defensible view, with the areas of remaining uncertainty named rather than smoothed over. This is the central skill of the role. Interrogate the question behind the request. Where the question as asked will not produce a useful answer, clarify the decision that needs to be supported and propose the more useful analytical question. Maintain relevant external evidence, including comparator institutions, sector benchmarks, published research and precedent relevant to current analyses and decisions. Build and maintain the external evidence base: comparator institutions, sector benchmarks, published research, and precedent relevant to decisions in front of ALU . State assumptions explicitly, and state plainly what an analysis does not establish. Where required data does not exist, publish the gap rather than substituting a proxy without saying so. Review recurring analysis and underlying assumptions, identify material gaps or inconsistencies, and raise findings where further scrutiny is required. Communication and Decision-Ready Output Design data and insight presentations so the key finding is immediately visible rather than presenting the dataset in full. Treat chart selection, sequencing and emphasis as analytical choices. Determine the appropriate format for each piece of work, whether a written memo, one-page decision brief, chart, dashboard, model walkthrough or verbal briefing, based on the decision, audience and complexity involved. Write for senior readers with limited time: lead with the finding or decision required, support it with the relevant evidence, and state what remains unknown and what would resolve it. Adjust the level of detail, language and presentation across audiences including the Executive Committee, Board, departmental leaders and technical counterparts. Present analysis clearly and confidently, including the assumptions, limitations and implications of the work. Automation and tooling Support the development and maintenance of automated workflows for data extraction, reconciliation, monitoring and reporting, reducing recurring manual effort. Use AI-enabled tools, agents and scripted workflows to accelerate recurring analytical tasks, including drafting, summarisation, exception detection, data preparation and scheduled checks. Apply judgement to AI-generated outputs, validate results and identify where automation should not replace human review. Build and maintain escalation triggers within recurring analytical and monitoring processes so that exceptions, overdue actions or material changes generate timely alerts. Document analytical tools and workflows to a standard that allows another team member to operate, understand and modify them without reliance on the original author. Analytics Capability and Continuous Improvement Improve analytical methodologies, templates, reporting processes and tools used by the Business Performance & Analysis function. Identify recurring requests and manual processes that can be standardised, automated or redesigned. Establish practical quality checks for recurring analysis and reporting. Share analytical methods, tools and lessons learned across the team and support the development of analytical capability. Performance Tracking and Follow-through Maintain accurate records of key decisions, actions, owners, assumptions and review dates arising from performance and planning activities. Monitor agreed actions and escalation triggers and raise overdue or off-track items appropriately through appropriate and well suited digital tools. Maintain the document repository to support continuity, transparency and effective handover. Executive and cycle coordination Coordinate engagement requirements against the University's planning, review and reporting calendar, including committee dates, planning cycles, statutory requirements and reporting deadlines. Prepare the analysis, briefing material and supporting information required for those engagements. Track actions and commitments arising from key meetings and ensure they are reflected in the appropriate working records and follow-up mechanisms. Coordinate inputs across functions to ensure materials are complete, consistent and ready for review. Ensure the safety and well-being of all young persons and vulnerable adults with whom we deal, by adhering to ALU ’s comprehensive safeguarding policy, maintaining a zero-tolerance approach to any violations of safeguarding standards REQUIRED EXPERIENCE 6 to 8 years of relevant professional experience, with demonstrated experience producing analysis that informs decisions taken by people more senior than yourself, in a research institution, consultancy, financial institution, policy body, university, or comparable analytical function. Economic reasoning, evidenced by training or by practice. You think in terms of opportunity cost, marginal effects, incentives and counterfactuals, and you state your assumptions before your conclusions. A degree in economics or experience across consulting, policy research, financial analysis or a quantitative discipline. Demonstrated ability to turn complex analysis into concise executive communication, including decision briefs, presentations, dashboards or written recommendations. Working competence in Python or R for data analysis and evidence of having built or supported an analytical workflow that can run with limited manual intervention. Practical experience using AI-enabled tools, including large language models, agents or scripted workflows, to improve analytical productivity, automation or decision support. Demonstrated ability to take incomplete and conflicting inputs from multiple sources and produce a single defensible view. Demonstrated ability to become productive quickly in an unfamiliar subject area and build sufficient domain understanding to analyse it effectively. Experience working across functions with different data sources, priorities and perspectives is strongly preferred. Exposure to executive, Board or committee reporting is desirable. REQUIRED COMPETENCIES Functional Competencies Analytical Reasoning: Break down complex questions, identify the relevant variables and determine the analysis required to support a decision. items.title: Federated Registry Data Scientist
items.summary: Company Overview Rhythm is a global, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the lives of patients living with rare neuroendocrine diseases.
items.description: Company Overview Rhythm is a global, commercial-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to transforming the lives of patients living with rare neuroendocrine diseases. We develop medicines for previously untreatable or undertreated diseases. We recognize the courage it takes for patients and their caregivers to begin their journey of advocacy to find the answers they need. Their courage inspires us to challenge convention, ask bold questions and seek answers for them. Every day, we strive for excellence through our willingness to adapt, learn, and our tenacity to overcome barriers, together. Opportunity Overview The Federated Registry Data scientist will contribute to the design, development and operation of a multi-country federated registry platform based on the Observational Medical Outcomes Partnership Common Data Model (OMOP CDM), in collaboration with specialized vendors for Extract-Transform-Load (ETL), hosting, and federated analyses. The role will serve as a primary point of contact between Rhythm, the selected vendors, and participating registries for data-related activities. The Data Scientist will oversee the local registry data collection (mapping, transformation, quality-check) and the federated analyses specifications and outputs within a federated OMOP CDM-based environment provided and maintained by the vendors. Responsibilities & Duties Federated analyses Oversee and supervise the vendor’s technical and analytical deliverables Oversee data collection, data quality check, ETL logic and data mapping to OMOP CDM Lead preparation and review of the statistical analysis plan, cohort definitions, variable definitions, and federated query specifications supported and executed by the vendors based on research questions proposed by the Scientific Committee, the participating centers or internally Perform external research proposals’ feasibility assessment before review by the Scientific Committee Ensure analytical outputs are clear and consistent with research questions, develop report for review by the scientific committee, and support the drafting of related publications Collaboration with vendors Collaborate with the vendor on source data review, OMOP mapping, ETL logic, and data quality checks, helping to identify, prioritize, and resolve quality issues Help with data-related questions raised by the vendor and coordinate timely responses from centers when local input is required Ensure that data-related discussions remain aligned with Rhythm’s scientific objectives, project scope, timelines, and budget Collaboration with sites/registries owners Support sites in understanding project data requirements, minimum datasets, expected formats, timelines, and quality control processes Coordinate with sites and the vendor to investigate data quality issues such as missing data, inconsistent values, duplicate records, etc. Collaborate with research teams (scientific committees, internal stakeholders, participating sites) to develop insights and drive evidence generation Perform any other relevant tasks as needed to support the team and company objectives. Qualifications & Skills Advanced degree in Life Sciences, Data Science, Information Systems, or an equivalent scientific or technical discipline Strong experience with healthcare data sources, including clinical registries, electronic health records, claims databases, healthcare databases, and real-world evidence projects Strong proficiency in R and/or Python Knowledge of healthcare standards, including OMOP CDM, Fast Health Interoperability Resources (FHIR), Systemized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms (SNOMED CT), etc. Knowledge of statistical methods in real-world evidence (RWE) Strong communication and interpersonal skills, capable of engaging with senior leadership and key stakeholders. Not accepting the status quo, working with a sense of urgency to deliver results Self-starter mentality who feels comfortable working in a fast-paced environment Cross-functional mindset focused on a seamless collaboration with internal and external partners Fluent in English This role is home office based. Rhythm operates in a hybrid-work model. Candidates applying must be willing and able travel internationally. More about Rhythm We are a dynamic and growing global team spanning more than a dozen countries. At Rhythm we are dedicated to transforming the lives of patients living with rare melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R) pathway diseases by rapidly advancing care and precision medicines that address the root cause. Our team is passionate about expanding access to reach more patients and developing novel therapies for other rare neuroendocrine diseases, including congenital hyperinsulinism. At Rhythm Our Core Values Are We are committed to advancing scientific understanding to improve patients’ lives We are inspired to tackle tough challenges and have the courage to ask bold questions We are eager to learn and adapt We believe collaboration and ownership are foundational for our success We value the unique contribution each individual brings to furthering our mission Inherent in our core values is the commitment to act ethically and with integrity in all we do. Designing professional processes and frameworks, allowing efficient delivery of our agenda. Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence. Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing. Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2024, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
