In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required; your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is part of an open Data Scientist project, with a strong emphasis on clear written and verbal communication. Scope of Work Design and execute statistical analyses to uncover actionable insights from complex datasets. Develop and validate machine learning models for various business or research objectives. Apply data modeling techniques and manage large-scale data transformations using Python and Pandas. Collaborate with stakeholders to define experimentation frameworks and analyze outcomes. Document methodology, findings, and recommendations with a focus on clarity and precision. Review peer contributions and provide high-quality feedback to support knowledge sharing. Deliver reproducible code and well-organized analytical reports as part of the project deliverables. Evaluate AI model outputs on statistics, machine learning, experimentation, and quantitative problems. Create expert-level prompts, datasets, and reference solutions. Identify flawed methodology, statistical errors, and weak quantitative reasoning. Provide clear, structured feedback that improves model capability. Preferred Qualifications At least one year at a top company (tech, finance, or research). Expertise in Python, including proficiency with libraries such as Pandas and scikit-learn (sklearn). Demonstrated experience in applied statistics, experimental design, and machine learning. Proven ability to develop, tune, and evaluate machine learning models in practical settings. Strong data modeling skills and experience managing structured and unstructured data. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a passion for clear technical documentation. Experience collaborating on open or cross-functional data science projects is a plus. Advanced academic background or hands-on work in data science, applied mathematics, or related fields. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Data Scientist (AI Data & LLM Specialist)
items.summary: Join the core team at Eclipse, where we’re building an AI agent-first marketplace that connects intelligence with real-world tasks, starting with data collection and labeling.
items.description: Join the core team at Eclipse, where we’re building an AI agent-first marketplace that connects intelligence with real-world tasks, starting with data collection and labeling. We are seeking a Data Scientist to establish the foundation for how our data is labeled, processed, and prepared for consumption by next-generation Large Language Models (LLMs). Your work will be critical in transforming our raw data collections into valuable, AI-ready datasets. Qualifications Proven experience as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer with a focus on data quality and preparation. Strong understanding of data labeling methodologies and hands-on experience with data annotation platforms and workflows. Demonstrated experience preparing datasets for training and fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs), including knowledge of techniques like tokenization, embeddings, and NER. Proficiency in Python and common data science libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, spaCy, Hugging Face). Experience using APIs/SDKs to automate data annotation and active learning loops. Excellent communication skills, with an ability to create clear documentation for technical and non-technical audiences. Responsibilities Develop Data Labeling Strategies: Design and document a formal data annotation strategy, including clear, scalable, and efficient guidelines for labeling our data. Define and enforce quality metrics, including inter-annotator agreement. Optimize for LLM Consumption: Research, define, and prototype the optimal data formats, structures, and pre-processing steps required for fine-tuning and training LLMs on our datasets. Data Quality Analysis: Establish automated processes and metrics to analyze the quality of both raw and labeled data, providing feedback to improve our data collection and labeling workflows. Collaborate with Engineering: Work closely with the engineering team to guide the implementation of data processing pipelines and ensure the data infrastructure meets the needs of ML applications. Nice-to-Haves Experience with audio data processing and relevant libraries. Familiarity with data annotation platforms and tools. Knowledge of modern MLOps principles and practices. Experience with large language model data curation and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) pipelines. Join the Eclipse team! Eclipse is building the fastest Ethereum Layer 2, powered by the Solana VM. Our general-purpose L2 combines the best of the modular stack without sacrificing UX or fragmenting liquidity. On top of this foundation, we’re building apps in-house and iterating quickly to find breakout consumer and AI experiences. We’re backed by top investors including Polychain, Tribe Capital, Placeholder, and DBA. Opportunity . We believe blockchains should be fast AND highly usable. You’ll do high-impact work to enhance Ethereum’s scalability, shaping the future of crypto Flexibility . We collaborate synchronously and asynchronously, across weekly all-hands meetings, Slack messaging, and quarterly in-person meetups Team . Our founding team has experience launching and scaling blue-chip projects such as dYdX, Uniswap, and zkSync. We’re backed by leading funds and leaders including Polychain, Tribe, Placeholder, DBA, Mustafa Al-Bassam, Tarun Chitra, Meltem Demirors, and others Culture . As an early member of our team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to help shape our culture. We value intellectual honesty, bias towards action, and believe every member plays a key role in achieving our ambitious goals Compensation . You’ll receive a competitive salary + equity + benefits package. Eclipse Laboratories is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable laws or regulations. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: M&E & Communications Officer
items.organization: Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime
items.summary: Application Deadline : 6 November - 17:00 CET Contract DurationOne-year fixed term with possibility of extension or renewal Language Proficiency Fluency in spoken and written English.
items.description: Application Deadline : 6 November - 17:00 CET Contract Duration One-year fixed term with possibility of extension or renewal Language Proficiency Fluency in spoken and written English. Working knowledge of French, Spanish or Portuguese would be an asset. Location Global, remote Background The Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC) is an independent civil society organization headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, with a globally dispersed Secretariat working across 43 countries. Founded in 2013, GI-TOC brings together a global network of more than 810 independent experts and a team of over 150 staff dedicated to understanding and responding to organized crime. Through research, analysis, policy engagement and support to civil society actors, GI-TOC works to deepen understanding of organized crime and strengthen effective, rights-based responses. The GI-TOC works to: Identify, analyse and map criminal trends and patterns of regional instability, and their impact on illicit flows, governance, development, security, conflict and the rule of law. Connect and support civil society actors working on organized crime and corruption, and on their links to instability and conflict. Strengthen local monitoring and analysis of national, regional and international organized crime and insecurity trends. Job Summary GI-TOC is looking for an Monitoring Evaluation and Communications Officer to work across its two flagship environmental crime programmes. The role sits between programme administration and research, and needs both skill sets. You will set up M&E systems across major projects in Latin America, Asia and Africa, working with environmental defenders, civil society organisations, law enforcement and the private sector. You will help build a body of practice on measuring the disruption of environmental crime networks and illicit economies, a field where good methods are still scarce. And you will make sure the impact of GI-TOC’s and its partners’ work reaches key audiences. This is a growth role. Extensive M&E experience is not required, but you will be expected to upskill quickly and with dedication. Main Responsibilities and Specific Tasks Monitoring, evaluation and learning: set up M&E systems across projects; collect information to set and track baselines, targets and indicators across both programmes; review and evaluate narrative reports from partners, grantees and country teams; gather and write up stories of impact; and contribute to learning and impact reporting. Measuring disruption: help build a body of practice on measuring the disruption of environmental crime networks and illicit economies. Donor relations: support donor reporting and correspondence, and help keep commitments, deadlines and deliverables on track. International coordination: support coordination across country teams, observatories and partners in Europe, Latin America, Africa and Asia. Communications: make sure the impact of GI-TOC’s and partners’ work reaches key audiences, preparing summaries, impact stories, newsletters and briefing materials in liaison with GI-TOC’s communications team. Bridging teams: act as a connector between programme, research, data and communications colleagues, and with close GI-TOC partners, so information flows and work is coherent across projects. Required Skills and Experience Essential University degree in a relevant field. Some professional experience in programme support, research, M&E or communications. Familiarity with M&E concepts, practices and approaches, such as results frameworks, theories of change, indicators and outcome harvesting. Excellent written English and the ability to turn complex information into clear material. Highly organised, careful with detail, and able to manage several workstreams at once. Strong interpersonal skills, and able to build relationships across teams and organisations Desirable Formal M&E training or experience on donor-funded programmes, especially EU or Norad. Knowledge of environmental crime, organised crime or natural resource governance. Experience producing communications content. Working knowledge of French, Spanish or Portuguese. Personal Attributes We work best with people who take initiative, are creative but careful with detail, and have a strong drive to bring organisation and coherence to our projects and to pursue impact. You will need to be internally well networked, and comfortable working across teams, time zones and partners. GI-TOC operates a flexible working environment and encourages staff to achieve a suitable work-life balance and supports professional development and learning. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. The Global Initiatives makes use of BambooHR's ATS system to receive and review your application. All correspondence related to your application will be sent via our domain globalinitiative.bamboohr.com. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: About Leadex Systems Leadex Systems is a niche software consulting company and a long-time MuleSoft partner. We provide best-in-class API Management solutions in the Middle East and Europe. Our team of 60 like-minded professionals combines technical expertise with domain knowledge in digital banking, finance, and e-commerce. We embrace proactiveness, continuous learning, team spirit, and commitment to customer success. About the role As a MuleSoft Developer, you will work collaboratively with a dynamic team of architects, project managers, and clients to design, implement, and maintain integration solutions that drive business success. This is a unique opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies in a fast-paced and exciting industry. Responsibilities: Collaborate with Project Managers, Solution Architects, and stakeholders to design and implement MuleSoft APIs tailored to business needs. Conduct technical analyses to translate business requirements into actionable solutions. Create RAML Specifications to serve as API contracts during development. Design and develop DataWeave scripts for complex data transformation tasks. Apply API-Led Connectivity principles to create scalable and reusable integration layers. Configure and manage API policies in API Manager. Deploy APIs across diverse environments, including CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, and On-Premise workers. Proven ability to understand business requirements and implement complex integrations. Expertise in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-level solutions to meet complex business needs. Strong knowledge of Enterprise Integration Patterns and API design best practices for REST and RPC. Familiarity with Microservices architecture, including its benefits and trade-offs compared to traditional SOA. Proficiency in English (B2 or higher), with strong written and verbal communication skills. Experience working in geographically distributed teams using Agile methodologies. 3+ years of hands-on experience in OOP development/design. Expertise in profiling and troubleshooting Java applications. Knowledge of Linux container technologies such as Docker or rkt and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes or OpenShift. Experience with SSO/IDM tools (e.g., Keycloak, ForgeRock, Okta, Auth0). Familiarity with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Apache ActiveMQ, ZeroMQ). Advanced user knowledge of Linux/Unix-like systems. Hands-on experience in DevOps automation tools (e.g., Jenkins, TeamCity, Bamboo) and monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Zabbix). We offer: An exciting project with on-the-edge technology in one of the most dynamic industries. A community of professionals to work and have fun together. Flexibility in terms of location to work from: we consider applicants from all locations. Flexible work schedule. 31 days of vacation. 5 sick days. Let's get to know each other! items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: Fully Remote, Bulgaria URL: http://noviglobal.com Our client is a growing European IT services group bringing together established technology companies across Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Bulgaria. With a strong presence in the DACH market and a broad portfolio covering managed IT services, cloud, cybersecurity, digital transformation, and AI, the Group supports organisations across a wide range of industries with complex technology needs. As the group continues to grow and integrate new companies, it has reached a point where common systems, processes, and operational standards are needed to support the organisation as a whole. As part of this internal group-wide project , they are establishing a dedicated team responsible for integrating and harmonising business systems and data across the group, and are looking for a HubSpot CRM Administrator to join the team. This is a fully remote position based in Bulgaria , offering the opportunity to administer, configure and maintain HubSpot CRM as part of the group's ongoing integration activities. The role focuses on ensuring reliable system operation, maintaining data quality, managing complex CRM configurations and supporting integrations with other business systems, including Microsoft Dynamics 365. HubSpot CRM Administrator Responsibilities: Administer, configure and maintain the HubSpot CRM platform, including properties, data structures, user permissions and lifecycle stages. Develop, maintain and optimize HubSpot workflows, automation rules and lead management processes. Configure and maintain integrations between HubSpot and other business systems, ensuring reliable data synchronization and resolving integration issues. Monitor CRM data quality, troubleshoot system issues and implement improvements to ensure stable and efficient platform operation. Support marketing automation activities, including campaign workflows, lead nurturing, segmentation and lead scoring. Monitor automation and campaign performance, identify potential issues and implement improvements. Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate operational and marketing requirements into scalable CRM configurations and automated processes. Requirements: Hands-on experience administering, configuring and supporting HubSpot CRM, including workflows, properties, permissions and data management. Good understanding of CRM data models, lifecycle stages, lead management and business process automation. Practical experience troubleshooting CRM issues, maintaining data quality and managing system configurations. Experience with CRM integrations, data synchronization or API-based connectivity between business systems. Understanding of marketing automation concepts, including email automation, lead nurturing, segmentation and campaign reporting. Ability to translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions and work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. English fluency, German would be an advantage This position is for a company that fosters innovation and values collaboration. This resonates deeply with talaint’s core mission, and we believe it could be a compelling step forward for your career. In case you are interested in the position, please send your CV in English and we would be happy to discuss it further. Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our consultants. Applying for this position, you are authorizing talaint to work and process your personal information following the Law for Personal Data Protection. Agency license Number 2123 was issued on 04.10.2016. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/talaint-hubspot-crm-administrator

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Argentina Remote Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality. About the Role We’re looking for a S enior Infrastructure Engineer to improve reliability and stability of Webflow’s customer-facing, production infrastructure, serving millions of page views per hour. Our product is used by over 2 million users world-wide across 190 countries, and you’ll help ensure our platform is secure and scalable for these users as tens of thousands of projects are launched on Webflow each month. Location: Remote-first (Argentina) Permanent, full-time employee (this is not a contractor position) Application Information: Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled This posting is for a new position. As an Senior Infrastructure Engineer you will: Own and evolve the cloud platform that Webflow's product and engineering teams depend on, including our compute layer, EKS fleet, serverless infrastructure, networking, and cloud operations across AWS and GCP. Help design and maintain our infrastructure-as-code foundation, evolving the patterns and shared components other teams build on. Design and maintain the networking layer that connects Webflow's services, ensuring reliability, security, and scalability across our cloud environments. Help make observability data the foundation of how we operate, improving the dashboards, alerts, and SLOs for the infrastructure you own so that issues are caught before customers notice, and on-call pages are actionable instead of noisy. Build and maintain AI-powered automation that improves how we manage cloud infrastructure, from policy-as-code and drift detection to LLM-assisted runbook generation. Help define the culture of this growing team as it expands its international presence. About you You’ll thrive as a Senior Infrastructure Engineer if you: Have a background as an infrastructure, site reliability engineer or cloud engineer with an enthusiasm for automation and code, or a background as a software engineer with deep enthusiasm for cloud infrastructure and distributed systems. Have 5+ years of experience owning and operating cloud infrastructure in a customer-facing environment that allows for little to no downtime. Have deep hands-on experience with AWS and a strong opinion on what good cloud operations look like. Have experience managing Kubernetes clusters at scale, including upgrades, node group management, autoscaling, and cluster add-on lifecycle. Have experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Pulumi or Terraform, and a strong preference for changes made through code, not consoles. Have experience navigating multi-region or multi-cloud environments on AWS or GCP. Stay curious and open to growth, demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact. It would be a bonus if you had even one of the following: Experience with Karpenter, cluster autoscaler, or other Kubernetes-native scaling tooling. Have experience with OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Prometheus or Grafana Experience building AI-assisted infrastructure tooling, including cost optimization loops, anomaly detection, or policy-as-code with LLM assistance. Experience contributing to multi-region architecture including data residency, regional failover, or latency-based routing. You Are: Collaborative : You possess a collaborative spirit, thriving when working with both your immediate team and cross-functional partners. Strategic thinker : You're a strategic thinker, adept at defining clear business needs and evaluating solutions to make informed build-versus-buy decisions. Comfortable with ambiguity : You navigate ambiguous situations with ease, gathering data and making progress even with incomplete information or unclear requirements. If you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying . Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you meet just 50% of the role’s requirements. Our Core Behaviors: Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first. Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act. Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible. Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers. Benefits Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company. Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums. Support for every stage of family life . 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions. Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired. Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching. Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally. Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts. Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program. Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment. Remote, together At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Stay connected Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog , LinkedIn , X (Twitter) , and/or Glassdoor . Please note: We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for confidential accommodation requests will be administered. To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment. If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes. For information about how Webflow processes your personal information, please review Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice . As a team of passionate individuals working together to solve meaningful problems, there is so much more for you to discover in a career with Carousell. Our culture is made up of hiring, developing, and promoting people who embody our values of solving problems for our users; having a mission-first mindset; being relentlessly resourceful; caring deeply; and staying humble to constantly improve. Together as an organisation, we make magic happen. About Mudah.my Mudah.my is part of Carousell Group, the leading multi-category platform for secondhand in Greater Southeast Asia on a mission to make secondhand the first choice. Founded in August 2012 in Singapore, the Group has a leading presence in seven markets under the brands Carousell, Carousell Media Group, Cho Tot, Laku6, LuxLexicon, Mudah.my, OneShift, REFASH and Revo Financial, serving tens of millions of monthly active users. Carousell is backed by leading investors including Telenor Group, Rakuten Ventures, Naver, STIC Investments, 500 Global and Peak XV Partners (formerly known as Sequoia Capital India). Visit mudah.my for more information Job Description Review and manage user-submitted content (text, images, video, listings, etc.) to ensure compliance with content guidelines and platform policies, including pre/post moderation and escalation handling. Identify and take appropriate action on content that violates guidelines (e.g., removal, rejection, flagging). Maintain accuracy, consistency, and productivity while meeting defined KPIs and SLAs. Conduct research on ads to identify misleading, spam, or fraudulent content based on current market trends, market knowledge, and online behavior. Collaborate with team members to resolve ambiguous cases and escalate issues according to internal procedures. Provide feedback on recurring issues and suggest improvements to review policies or workflows. Collaborate across teams to improve user experience and address content-related issues. Participate in training, calibration, and quality improvement initiatives Qualifications Fresh graduates or candidates with 1-2 years of experience in Content Moderation are welcome to apply. You’re the person who turns rankings, AI citations, traffic and leads into a clear story of progress. You catch risk before the client feels it, and you keep every account moving toward measurable outcomes. Think of it as a marathon run at sprint pace. Relationships last for years, but you prove value every single month. What You’ll Own 1. Relationships That Fuel Retention Be each client’s trusted partner and main point of contact. Full-Funnel Performance: AI Search, SEO and PPC Explain AI search shifts in plain English, including AI Overviews, zero-click results and citations in ChatGPT and Perplexity. Content and CRO Insight Link content plans to client goals, and flag gaps for both search and AI engines. Escalate any account that stays Red for more than 30 days. Pass expansion opportunities to the growth team when clients are winning. 6. Projects, ClickUp and Automation Turn success plans into ClickUp projects with owners, milestones and deadlines, and keep HubSpot clean. Coordinate the SEO, PPC, content, web and dev teams while protecting scope and margin. Automate repetitive reporting and follow-ups with AI and workflow tools. What You Bring Must-Haves 3+ years in customer success or account management at a digital marketing agency, SEO/SaaS company or similar B2B service business. A working understanding of SEO and PPC (Google Ads, Microsoft Ads), plus curiosity and early knowledge of AI search, GEO and AEO. Comfort with numbers: you can read GA4, Search Console and dashboard data and explain what changed and why. Proven ability to turn data into a clear, persuasive story for business owners and executives. Hands-on experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini for research, reporting and communication, plus the judgment to check their output. Experience running projects in ClickUp or a similar tool (Asana, Monday) and keeping a CRM like HubSpot clean. Confidence in tough conversations, including pushback, scope creep and at-risk renewals. Professional fluency in English, written and spoken, with North American clients. Nice-to-Haves Experience with tracking and reporting tools, and reporting platforms. Basic CRO knowledge, such as landing page best practices, A/B testing and conversion tracking. Experience with workflow automation (Zapier, ClickUp automations). Background with B2B customers and an asset to know SaaS clients. Familiarity with net revenue retention, upsell motions and customer lifetime value. You are measured on customer results, relationships and expansions. Measured through customer NPS survey and retained revenue. You’re part relationship builder, part data storyteller and part project driver. You don’t wait for clients to raise concerns. You see the dip in the dashboard first, figure out why, and walk in with a plan. You use AI to move faster, but you never hand it the wheel. You’re curious about where search is heading, and you can explain it to a business owner in two minutes without jargon. Most of all, you own outcomes. Great relationships matter, but at MMR they’re backed by measurable results. How to Apply Apply through our JazzHR careers page. You’ll answer a few short questions as part of your application. They show us how you think, so give them five minutes. This is a remote role open in LATAM (Colombia preferred) and Europe, with at least 5 hours of overlap with North American Eastern Time.

items.title: GTM Product Operations Specialist II
items.summary: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference?
items.description: Are you a dreamer, innovator, thinker and a do-er who believes in contributing to something that makes difference? Make an impact. Join PMI. How will you make a difference to PMI? PMI is seeking a GTM Product Operations Specialist II who supports the operational execution of PMI’s product launch and update processes. This role focuses on documentation, deliverable coordination, asset trafficking, and cross-functional support to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent GTM execution across PMI’s product portfolio. Specialists write concise operational copy (not strategic messaging), maintain GTM materials, manage approvals, and support readiness steps once the GTM Product Marketing Strategy team has defined positioning, messaging, and value propositions. This role is foundational to keep GTM workflows moving and ensuring organizational readiness for every product change. What you’ll bring to the role: GTM Workflow Execution Execute assigned GTM tasks across launches, updates, and product lifecycle workflows. Maintain timelines, trackers, and dependency logs; escalate risks as needed. Ensure deliverables follow established templates and standards. Support launch readiness checkpoints by preparing materials and summaries. Operational Copywriting & Documentation Write concise, structured operational documentation, including: Release notes Product update summaries Internal FAQs Readiness checklists Basic product descriptions aligned to approved messaging Ensure accuracy, clarity, and alignment with the messaging hierarchy prepared by the GTM Strategy team. Maintain up-to-date documentation libraries and version control. Cross-Functional Coordination Coordinate with Brand, Product, CX, and Regional Marketing to gather required inputs. Manage asset trafficking, routing materials through review and approval cycles. Support meeting preparation, including agendas, notes, decisions, and action items. Enablement & Readiness Support Prepare internal enablement materials and documentation for downstream teams. Assist with distributing updates, training materials, or communications. Ensure relevant stakeholders understand changes, timelines, and deliverables. Operational Reporting & Process Support Update dashboards, GTM trackers, and reporting tools. Maintain accurate records of tasks, progress, and status updates. Support process improvements by capturing bottlenecks or inefficiencies. Role Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field preferred. 3+ years of experience in product marketing, marketing operations, PMO, or related roles. Experience in documentation, project coordination, or workflow management is a plus. Exposure to product marketing or GTM concepts helpful but not required. Writing: Skilled at concise, structured operational copy (not strategic content). Organization: Highly detail-oriented with strong task and time management. Project Coordination: Ability to manage multiple deliverables and follow structured workflows. Communication: Clear, consistent communicator; strong listening and documentation skills. Tool Proficiency: Comfortable with project management tools, documentation systems, and collaboration platforms. Process Discipline: Ability to follow templates, frameworks, and operational guidelines. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works well with Product, Brand, and Region teams. Quality Orientation: Ensures accuracy, consistency, and adherence to standards. Proficiency in the business language for PMI (English). Some travel, possibly up to 15%, conditions permitting. Requirements include ability to travel nationally and globally and may occur over weekends or holidays What you can expect from us We value and nurture an environment of inclusivity and diversity, and a culture of communication and collaboration. Your health, safety and well-being come first, and we believe that you should have time for your work, but you should also have time for you.. Join us and you’ll get: an excellent total package, with compensation and benefits based upon your geographic location. skill development opportunities, to help you grow now and into the future. access to a global network, to enrich your professional experience. flexible options to help balance work time and your time award and bonus opportunities. The salary offer will be based on several factors, including the candidate’s demonstrated skills, qualifications and relevant experience. Let’s help make the world work better for everyone. Apply today! Project Management Institute, Inc. is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Originally posted on Himalayas

Cross-Functional Collaboration Collaborate with marketing, operations, and sales teams to meet data needs and support campaign execution. Technical Skills: Must be familiar with excel terms and formulas (VLOOKUP, CONCAT, IFERROR, INDEX, MATCH, COUNTIF, AND, OR, SUBSTITUTE, IF) Familiarity with Insellerate, Hubspot, Go High Level, Salesforce, Jungo, Big Purple Dot, Follow Up Boss or similar CRMS Capable of organizing, refining, and analyzing data to support informed decision-making. Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, data-heavy environment. items.title: Senior Financial Analyst at RethinkFirst
items.summary: About RethinkFirst Rethink First is on a mission to inspire hope and power potential. We are a market leader in behavioral and mental health technology, serving employers, schools, government agencies, behavioral health providers, clinicians, and families worldwide. RethinkFirst is transforming the behavioral health landscape by inspiring and empow
items.description: About RethinkFirst Rethink First is on a mission to inspire hope and power potential. We are a market leader in behavioral and mental health technology, serving employers, schools, government agencies, behavioral health providers, clinicians, and families worldwide. RethinkFirst is transforming the behavioral health landscape by inspiring and empowering individuals with behavioral health challenges and those who support them. We continue to invest in data science, analytics, and technology that improve outcomes and enable value-based care. We are currently seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to join our accounting and finance team, reporting to the Director of Finance. This will be a key role in our accounting function. Key Responsibilities: Support the development and maintenance of annual budgets, quarterly forecasts, and long-range financial plans. Build and maintain financial models to evaluate business performance, forecast results, and support strategic decision-making. Partner with operational leaders to understand business performance and translate operational drivers into financial outcomes. Analyze key performance indicators related to recurring revenue, labor costs, productivity, utilization, and profitability. Participate in preparation of monthly financial reporting packages, management presentations, and board reporting materials. Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting, forecasting processes, data quality, and analytical tools, including automation. Support strategic initiatives and ad hoc financial analysis to inform leadership decisions. Communicate financial insights and actionable recommendations clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders. Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. 4–7+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, financial analysis, or a related analytical role. Experience in a SaaS business, including familiarity with recurring revenue models, ARR, revenue growth drivers, and SaaS performance metrics. Experience working in a private equity-backed company, with an understanding of PE reporting expectations, financial accountability, and operating cadence. Experience preparing monthly financial reporting packages, management presentations, and board reporting materials. Strong financial modeling skills and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Experience with budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and management reporting. Demonstrated initiative, intellectual curiosity, and a willingness to take ownership of projects and drive them to completion. Ability to communicate effectively and persuasively with members of the senior management team and others within the Company Preferred Qualifications & Skills: Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, or similar service-oriented businesses. Experience leveraging AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to improve financial analysis, modeling, reporting, research, or workflow automation. Familiarity with business intelligence or data visualization tools. Benefits Health, Dental, & Vision insurance 401(k) + company match Paid time off Parental leave Professional development assistance Location: Remote opportunities are only available to candidates who reside in the following states: AL, AZ, CT, FL, GA, HI, IA, IL, IN, KY, LA, MD, MA, MI, MN, MO, MT, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NV, OH, OR, PA, RI, TN, TX, VA, WA, WI, WY Our commitment to an inclusive workplace RethinkFirst is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. We celebrate the unique differences of our employees because that is what drives curiosity, innovation, and the success of our business. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. Accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities. Recruiting Fraud Alert: Job applicants should be aware that there are external parties posing as RethinkFirst recruiters. These scams may include fraudulent communications via social media platforms (such as LinkedIn), email, or requests to schedule interviews. Note that any recruiting related communication you receive from RethinkFirst would come from an @rethinkfirst.com e-mail address, @applytojob.com email address (via our talent acquisition system), ‘[email protected]’ email address, and/or be found on the Rethinkfirst.com website. Please also note that at no point during our recruitment process will we request any form of monetary payment. If you believe that you have been a victim of job recruiting fraud, you should file a report with your local law enforcement. JazzHR Privacy Policy JazzHR Terms of Use California Privacy Notice

items.description: Join Telaid as a Collections Specialist! Who We Are: Telaid is a leader in technology deployment solutions for multi-site enterprises. For over 40 years, we have been the trusted partner for accelerating the adoption of innovative technologies that drive positive business outcomes. Our mission is to reduce the time, effort, risk, and cost associated with implementing cutting-edge technology. Position Overview: As a Collections Specialist , you will play a vital role in ensuring the company receives timely payments from clients. This role requires strong financial analysis skills, customer service excellence, and problem-solving abilities to maintain Telaid’s financial health. If you’re a detail-oriented, results-driven professional who thrives in a collaborative environment, this is the perfect opportunity for you! Key Responsibilities: Use accounting software to generate reports and review open accounts for past-due balances. Track invoices nearing due dates and send reminders to customers proactively. Identify overdue amounts based on customer payment terms. Contact customers via phone or email in a professional manner to resolve outstanding payments while maintaining positive client relationships. Collaborate with Project Accountants and Project Managers to address billing issues and delinquent accounts. Reconcile discrepancies between customer records and company accounts. Escalate unresolved past-due accounts to the Credit & Collections Manager as needed. Provide timely follow-up on payment arrangements. Assist with generating and submitting invoices across various software platforms. Apply payments to customer accounts and review credit reports to establish credit limits for new customers. Identify trends in account delinquency and propose solutions to management. Qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent (Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred). At least 2 years of experience in billing and collections. Strong communication, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Ability to work independently and excel in a fast-paced, multitasking environment. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Experience with ERP systems and project accounting environments is a plus. Knowledge of Crystal Reports, Power BI, and SQL is desirable. Why Join Telaid? Be part of a team that values proactivity, teamwork, and service excellence. Enjoy flexibility in a supportive, growth-oriented environment. Contribute to impactful technology projects with high-profile clients. If you’re ready to advance your career and contribute to Telaid’s success, we want to hear from you! Apply today and become part of our legacy of delivering excellence in technology deployments. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Geospatial Reasoning Specialist (Senior) – AI Trainer
items.summary: Are you an experienced geospatial professional eager to shape the future of AI?
items.description: Are you an experienced geospatial professional eager to shape the future of AI? We’re developing a geospatial reasoning agent focused on Crisis Response—helping AI systems understand, assess, and predict real-world events where data is uncertain or incomplete. Your expertise will guide model development and evaluation, laying the foundation for future geospatial reasoning and forecasting applications. We’re looking for experts with deep experience in geospatial analysis, crisis response, or related domains such as damage assessment, agriculture, site selection, supply chain optimization, or forecasting. You’ll evaluate AI-generated outputs, identify analytical weaknesses, and design metrics and test cases that advance model understanding and predictive accuracy. On a typical day, you’ll review geospatial scenarios, validate model outputs, define and refine reasoning frameworks, and collaborate with our team to improve data-driven evaluations. Ideal candidates bring professional experience in geospatial analysis, GIS systems, or spatial modeling within industries such as crisis management, logistics, or environmental planning. Proficiency with geospatial tools and libraries (e.g., QGIS, ArcGIS, GDAL, PostGIS) is preferred. Strong reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate complex spatial relationships clearly are essential. Ready to apply your geospatial expertise to the frontier of AI? Apply today and help design intelligent systems capable of supporting real-time global decision-making. We offer a pay range of $24 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor, you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet connection; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. items.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
items.summary: THE COMPANY Careerminds is a leader in career transition and coaching solutions, helping organizations support employees through change while enabling workforce growth and development.
items.description: THE COMPANY Careerminds is a leader in career transition and coaching solutions, helping organizations support employees through change while enabling workforce growth and development. Our product portfolio includes market-leading Career Transition and Coaching Services as well as Progression, our application for Career Frameworks and progression planning. THE ROLE We're growing our machine learning team. We're looking for Machine Learning Engineers who own products end to end — from the problem, to production, to the metric that proves it worked. This role exists because of how we build. A small product strategy team sets direction and priorities; engineers own the work end to end — discovery, design, build, ship, and the result. You'll have the autonomy of a founder inside your domain and the accountability that comes with it. That accountability includes the unglamorous half of ML. You own the experiment that doesn't pan out and the call to kill it, not just the launch. We'd rather you run four honest experiments and ship the one that works than ship four things that all look fine on a dashboard. AI-native development isn't an aspiration here — it's the baseline. Our engineers ship with Claude Code and Claude Design as their default tools, and the leverage that creates is why one engineer can own a product end to end. We want people already working this way who want to push the ceiling higher, not people who are curious about AI. In the interview we'll ask you to show us the trail: repos, PRs, or shipped work you built this way. This is a 100% remote/work-from-home role. THE KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Depending on area of focus: Canonical data and entity resolution Canonical datasets for titles, companies, skills, and industries — the layer every application depends on. Content-addressed IDs, faceted taxonomies, alias graphs accumulated across tens of millions of rows. Rules-based resolution pipelines with LLM escalation, where the accumulated alias graph is the durable asset and escalation volume should fall over time. Nightly agent loops that adjudicate ambiguous entities, propose structural changes, and get gated by invariant checks and blast-radius limits before anything commits. Job ingestion at scale: multi-source feeds, deduplication, freshness, and the indexing economics underneath. Retrieval, ranking, and matching Job matching v2: two-tower retrieval with cross-encoder reranking, trained on outcome labels rather than clicks. Hard-negative mining, propensity weighting, impression-time logging. Mobility embeddings learned from observed career sequences — the similarity a text encoder can't recover, where Claims Adjuster and Underwriting Assistant are substitutable despite sharing no vocabulary. Pivot feasibility: given where someone is, what moves are realistic, what's missing, and which intermediate roles actually worked for peers. Applied LLMs and agents Fine-tuning where it earns its cost — against outcome labels, not for tasks a well-prompted frontier model already handles. Agentic systems in production with human approval gates: agents that analyze, propose changes as reviewable artifacts, and execute only after a human signs off. We have this pattern running against tens of millions of customer touchpoints a year and want to push it much further. Continuous skills inference from work artifacts rather than static documents — a problem several of our enterprise customers are currently solving for themselves, badly. New product surfaces where the right answer genuinely requires an LLM, and the discipline to notice when it doesn't. Across all of it Evaluation infrastructure you'd defend in a design review: time-forward splits, calibration, offline-to-online agreement, and honest handling of feedback-loop degeneration and survivorship bias. Building inside real constraints: GDPR, EU AI Act high-risk classification for employment AI, and client data commitments are design inputs here, not someone else's problem. THE MUST-HAVES 5+ years shipping ML systems into production — and you can name the system, the metric before and after, and how you knew the model caused the change. Depth in both classical ML and deep learning (PyTorch or TensorFlow) applied to live products, not notebooks and Kaggle sets. Working fluency with LLMs in production — retrieval, evals, prompt and context engineering, and the judgment to recognize when an LLM is the wrong tool. You already ship with agentic coding tools — Claude Code, Claude Design, or close equivalents — and can point to work you built with them. Software engineering fundamentals strong enough to own your own deploys — Python, Git, cloud (we run AWS), containers, and the patience for genuinely messy, human-authored, self-reported data. THE NICE-TO-HAVES Entity resolution, record linkage, or taxonomy design at scale Ranking, recommendation, or two-tower retrieval systems Sequence models on longitudinal or event-stream data Embedding and vector retrieval systems in production Experiment design, causal inference, or off-policy evaluation Warehouse-native ML (dbt, Snowflake, or similar) Labor market, HR tech, or people-data domain experience Open-source contributions or publications At Careerminds, we believe that diversity in thought and cultural background leads to better teams and stronger companies. We seek talented, qualified employees, regardless of race, color, sex/gender (including pregnancy, gender identity, and gender expression), national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under country or local law. Careerminds is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Come join our team. Together, we’ll help others tell their career stories and land their dream jobs. items.title: Community Strategist
items.summary: About UsMighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events.
items.description: About Us Mighty Networks helps people and brands build communities, online courses, memberships, challenges, and events. Through its advanced technology, called people magic, Mighty helps the members of those networks build relationships with each other by surfacing the most relevant and interesting connections. Because of this novel approach and member-centered experience, Mighty has produced the most $1M communities and helped its Hosts earn over $500M. The Role As a Community Strategist, you’ll work with our premium Mighty Pro customers to help them create deeply engaging community experiences that lead to powerful outcomes. You will lead workshops, co-create launch strategies, and shape the early member experience for some of the world’s boldest and most influential Hosts. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in both structured systems and creative problem-solving, and is excited to model excellence, mentor peers, and scale success through repeatable frameworks. What You'll Do Serve as a strategic partner to new Mighty Pro Hosts during their onboarding phase as they set up their Network in the way that leads to maximum member adoption, engagement, and retention. Facilitate impactful workshops with Hosts and their teams that establish strong foundations in community design, content cadence, and engagement strategy. Deliver targeted training on feature utilization, member onboarding flows, and tactical programming to drive adoption, activation, and retention. Provide creative input and feedback on brand elements like landing pages, welcome experiences, email sequences, and network messaging to ensure a cohesive and compelling member journey. Own the development and delivery of strategic Community Design Plans—including network architecture, monthly themes, onboarding flows, and launch programming calendars. Collaborate closely with Launch Specialists and Implementation teams, providing timely information and handling lightweight setup tasks directly where appropriate. Ensure clarity, consistency, and excellence in the execution of space configuration, access structure, and end-to-end member experience. Maintain regular updates to internal stakeholders on Host performance, needs, risks, and outcomes—contributing to visibility and cross-functional alignment. Contribute to shared knowledge across the Customer Success team by capturing and scaling best practices, identifying emerging trends, and improving playbooks. What We're Looking For 6+ years of client-facing experience, ideally working with strategic accounts or supporting 5–6 figure engagements in a SaaS, media, or creator-focused business. 2+ years experience in a consulting, business coaching, or agency role. Strategic thinker and tactical executor—you can map out long-term plans, define metrics for success, and follow through on details to deliver. Deep understanding of community-building and digital member experiences; you’re passionate about helping others create belonging at scale. Excellent communicator and facilitator, with confidence in guiding executive teams through planning, decision-making, and feedback cycles. Master of meetings—you show up with a plan, gather input with nuance, read the room, and close with clear decisions and next steps. Adaptable and proactive, energized by growth and ambiguity, and always seeking ways to streamline and improve. Highly collaborative and cross-functional, thriving when working across CS, Implementation, Product, and Strategy to elevate outcomes. Radically curious, with a growth mindset and drive to keep learning about Hosts, their businesses, and how digital communities are evolving. What We Offer A dynamic, remote-first work culture that values creativity, autonomy, and bold thinking. Comprehensive benefits, including health, vision, dental, and generous paid time off. Clear opportunities for professional growth, including leadership pathways and skill development support. The chance to shape the future of how communities, creators, and brands thrive online—with the team that’s building what’s next. Join us in shaping the future of community-driven digital businesses with Mighty Pro! Compensation: The base salary for this role ranges from $80,000–$145,000, with exact compensation based on location, experience, and cost of living. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: NYC or Remote (EST or CST) About the role: Hex’s legal function has gone from zero to a fully operating system in under a year. Now we need someone to own and scale the operating layer so it holds as the company grows. This is a builder role. You’ll run contract operations end to end: CLM administration, workflow optimization, template and playbook maintenance, enablement and training for the revenue team, and first-pass review and redlining of standard agreements against our playbook. Beyond contracts, you’ll build structured intake for every legal workstream across the company, own the legal governance record (privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars), manage outside counsel relationships, and own the legal tech stack. We sit at the nexus of data, AI, and collaboration, which means our legal operations have to be as thoughtful as our product. We use AI tooling across legal operations, and you’ll work the same way: building agents and automations to move faster, not as a side project but as the default way things get done here. If you see a manual workflow and instinctively want to build it away, you’ll feel right at home. What you will do: Drive CLM adoption and enablement so the revenue team self-serves on standard deals Own workflow optimization, templates, and playbooks as deal structures and products evolve First-pass review and redlining of standard agreements; draft from templates as volume requires Build and own structured intake for legal workstreams across the company Build AI-powered workflows, agents, and automations that replace manual processes Maintain the legal governance record: privacy registers, AI inventory, compliance calendars Train cross-functional teams on self-service tools and escalation paths Manage outside counsel relationships and the legal tech stack About You: 3-5+ years in legal operations, paralegal, or contract management, with at least 1-2 years in-house at a tech or SaaS company You’ve implemented or rebuilt a CLM (Ironclad preferred), designed intake workflows, and stood up reporting someone relied on Experience reviewing and redlining commercial agreements on both sell-side and buy-side paper You build with AI and automation as a natural part of how you work. You’re comfortable across AI-assisted legal tools, LLMs, and automation platforms, and willing to experiment with new ones as they emerge. This isn’t a nice-to-have at Hex. Comfortable operating with autonomy in a role with a lot of white space Good judgment about what you can handle and what needs a lawyer You care whether people actually use what you build Nice to have: Experience at a company navigating exponential growth Experience with corporate governance (entity management, board materials, annual filings) Has used Hex Strong opinions about the best way to organize a Notion workspace We know job posts like this can feel like a checklist, and nobody checks every box. If you’ve built legal ops infrastructure, you’re excited about AI, and this role sounds like the kind of work you want to do, we’d love to hear from you. In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness & parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process. By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy: https://learn.hex.tech/docs/trust/privacy-policy . items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Burlington, MA OR US Remote Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market? Look no further than Veracode! Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment. Learn more at www.veracode.com , on the Veracode blog , and on LinkedIn and Twitter . Veracode is seeking a Senior Website Manager to own the strategy, governance, performance, and ongoing evolution of Veracode.com. Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing and working closely with the Creative Director, this role will lead the website roadmap, improve operational excellence, and turn business priorities into high-performing digital experiences that increase traffic, engagement, lead generation, and conversions. You will own the web roadmap, lead the migration from WordPress to Webflow through launch and partner with marketing, creative, demand generation, operations, IT, and agency teams to translate business needs into scalable website experiences. You will oversee site infrastructure, reusable templates, page builds, campaign support, content publishing, and continuous optimization for speed, security, accessibility, SEO, GEO, and user experience. The Senior Website Manager will improve the full digital journey, from organic discovery and campaign landing pages to content engagement, form conversion, personalization, and post-click experiences aligned to priority personas. This role balances strategic ownership with hands-on execution. The Senior Website Manager should be comfortable setting priorities, managing stakeholders, improving governance, and jumping into the details of site updates, QA, analytics, campaign launches, and CMS operations when needed. This is a hands-on role. The manager will build and edit pages in Webflow, troubleshoot tracking and form issues, and review agency work in the code and configuration, not just in screenshots. Key Responsibilities Migration Ownership — Take ownership of Veracode’s in-flight migration from WordPress to Webflow and drive it through launch and post launch stabilization. Align stakeholders, leadership, and agency partners on scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and success criteria. Validate and lead work on content and URL audits, redirect mapping, SEO/GEO/AEO preservation, analytics, integration testing and launch planning. Day-to-Day Site Management — Manage daily website operations, intake, prioritization, page updates, QA, publishing, troubleshooting, and stakeholder requests while maintaining high standards for accuracy, usability, performance, and brand consistency. Data and Analytics — Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, heatmaps, dashboards, and campaign data to monitor traffic, behavior, conversions, attribution, and funnel performance, then translate insights into optimization priorities. Content Governance and Quality Control — Maintain site content standards, taxonomy, metadata, redirects, page ownership, review cycles, archival processes, and content hygiene so the website stays accurate, discoverable, compliant, and easy to maintain. Strategic Roadmap and Vision — Architect and execute web strategies that incorporate AI-enabled personalization, SEO, GEO, campaign performance, content experience, and conversion optimization to drive traffic, engagement, and pipeline impact. Design Strategy & Governance — Lead visual and UX evolution, ensuring designs align with brand identity; manage scalable design systems, wireframes/prototypes (e.g., Figma), and trends like micro-interactions, organic layouts, and performance-driven creativity. Own the translation of Figma designs into Webflow components and templates. Conversion-First UX & AI-Enhanced Personalization — Direct user journeys for high-stakes pages; implement AI-driven adaptive experiences and A/B testing to optimize funnels. Privacy, Consent, Accessibility and Compliance — Partner with legal, security, and marketing operations to manage cookie consent, privacy requirements, data collection standards, accessibility, and compliance needs across website experiences. As a security company, our site is held to a high bar for security hygiene, accessibility and privacy. Performance Optimization — Use Core Web Vitals monitoring, A/B and multivariate testing, heatmaps, and performance insights to balance rich visual experiences with site speed and continuously improve funnel performance. Reporting and Executive Visibility — Establish recurring website performance reporting, dashboards, insights, and recommendations that connect website activity to pipeline, campaign impact, SEO performance, conversion trends, and business priorities. SEO, GEO and Growth Management — Lead technical SEO, GEO, keyword strategy, and content performance to improve organic visibility across traditional and generative search experiences. Technical Oversight — Manage Webflow, WordPress, or similar enterprise CMS environments, and coordinate with IT and development teams on infrastructure, security, bugs, integrations, and new features. Manage WordPress through sunset and Webflow as the long-term platform, including CMS structure, permissions, hosting, and custom code. Website Release Management and QA — Own launch readiness for new pages, templates, campaigns, integrations, and site changes, including requirements intake, testing, stakeholder approvals, rollback planning, documentation, and post-launch monitoring. Cross-Functional Leadership — Partner with marketing, creative, product marketing, demand generation, marketing operations, IT, sales, agencies, and vendors to gather requirements, align priorities, manage dependencies, communicate tradeoffs, and deliver website initiatives on time. Vendor and Agency Partnership — Act as the primary liaison for web development partners and agencies. Scope projects, manage timelines and deliverables, conduct quality reviews, and ensure external teams align with Veracode standards, brand guidelines, accessibility expectations, and strategic objectives. Hold agencies accountable to defined acceptance criteria and evaluate their technical work independently. Marketing Automation Integration — Work with marketing ops to ensure seamless ties with Marketo forms, lead capture, and CRM (Salesforce). This role gathers business, technical, design, campaign, and content requirements to deliver high-performing website experiences. You will administer infrastructure, manage CMS operations, build scalable templates and interactive experiences, publish content, improve governance, and continuously optimize site performance. Required Skills & Qualifications 8–10+ years in web management, digital marketing, or web program management, with strong emphasis on strategy, design oversight, and growth. Experience leading a full CMS migration for a large B2B site (hundreds of pages or more), including redirect mapping, SEO preservation, and tracking validation. Strong experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, UTM strategies, SEO and GEO tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog), and CRO (A/B testing, heatmaps like Hotjar). Knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, MySQL; frontend literacy (e.g., CSS Grid/Flexbox, animations). Familiarity with website security, ADA/WCAG compliance (accessibility-first design), performance optimization, and 2026 trends like AI personalization and immersive interactivity. Proven project management skills (e.g., Jira, Asana); experience managing agencies, vendors, in-house teams (development/design). Strong analytical mindset; ability to present performance, design, and growth reports to executives. Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration expertise. Experience with Marketo and Salesforce form/CRM integrations. Webflow Enterprise experience is a plus. Examples of A/B Testing Strategies This Role Might Lead Headline/CTA variations on landing pages to boost conversions (e.g., testing benefit-focused vs. feature-focused copy). Layout changes (e.g., grid vs. organic/asymmetric) or visual elements (e.g., hero images/videos, micro-animations) for engagement/time-on-page. Form optimization (e.g., multi-step vs. single-page) or personalization (e.g., AI-segmented content) for lead capture. Button colors/sizes/text or navigation tweaks to improve click-through and funnel progression. Compensation Transparency: The total compensation package includes an anticipated base salary range of $125,000–$140,000, along with comprehensive benefits. The base salary offered to the selected candidate, including the candidate’s position within the salary range, will be determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related knowledge, education, skills, experience, and other business considerations. The published salary range represents the Company’s good-faith estimate of the compensation range at the time of posting. Employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Fraudulent Recruitment Alert - Be Aware and Stay Informed At Veracode, we prioritize a secure recruitment process. Unfortunately, fake recruitment and job offer scams are on the rise. They aim to deceive candidates through emails and calls to obtain sensitive information. Here’s our recruitment promise to you: Comprehensive Interview Process: We never extend job offers without a comprehensive interview process involving our recruitment team and hiring managers. Offer Communications: Our job offers are not sent solely through email, and we will never ask you to pay for your own hardware. Email Verification: Recruiting emails from Veracode will always originate from an “@veracode.com" email address. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter, or telephone communication claiming to be from Veracode, please reach out to us at careers@veracode.com before taking any further action. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/veracode-senior-website-manager

We built our platform from AI up, to catch the human-targeted attacks that legacy tools miss, and public sector organizations need that protection as much as anyone. Technical fluency across security, email, cloud, and AI, enough to hold your own in a conversation with a security or IT leader. Cybersecurity or security-adjacent SaaS sales experience, selling subscription software to CISOs and security personnel. A builder's mindset: you've thrived somewhere early-stage, an underdog, or up against bigger incumbents, and you know how to build territory with limited resources. Comfort selling within a company that's still writing its next chapter. We're growing 40%+ year over year, protecting more than 4,500 customers including over 25% of the Fortune 500, and expanding fast from email into identity, AI security, and insider threat. That means more to sell, more to learn, and more room to make your mark than a mature market leader can offer. #LI-LB2 Actual compensation will be determined based on several non-discriminatory factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location.
