This will include site selection, feasibility, budgeting, design team & contractor selection, project management, build-out, and regulatory readiness of all Gilbert Pharmaceuticals pharmacy facilities. Reporting to the Director of Pharmacy Development & Operations, this role bridges pharmacy operations expertise with construction, facilities engineering, and regulatory compliance to bring new pharmacy sites from concept through licensure and go-live. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience designing and building efficient commercial spaces and pharmacy environments including traditional 503A compounding pharmacies and FDA-registered 503B outsourcing facilities operating under current Good Manufacturing Practice (cGMP) Standards. Their thorough knowledge enables them to successfully navigate state and federal regulations required for pharmacy facility approval. At Gilbert Pharmaceuticals , every role is AI-first. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into the right tools to explore and execute, is tested with real users and stakeholders, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of how we work, not side experiments. We are looking for people who take full ownership of their work, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about building a company that meaningfully improves how healthcare is delivered. We're Looking For You think outside of the box, excel at creative problem-solving, and are comfortable taking on projects that you have potentially never done before! You are a people-person - empathetic, self-aware, low ego, and extremely positive - and are comfortable working in a small collaborative team where you'll wear many hats. You have care for performance, accessibility, and reliability as part of craft. You are passionate and proficient in written and verbal communication, and comfort pairing with designers, engineers, and marketers. Key Responsibilities Acquisition Lead market analysis and site selection to identify viable pharmacy locations nationally. Conduct feasibility assessments and due diligence on prospective sites, evaluating regulatory feasibility, build-out complexity, and operational suitability. Develop and execute entitlement strategy for new pharmacy locations in coordination with legal and operations teams. Act as liaison between landlords, brokers, and Gilbert Pharmaceuticals on your prospective sites. Coordinate with internal stakeholders to supply landlords and brokers with essential company information to secure new leases and site acquisitions. Entitlements Navigate land use and zoning requirements for each new pharmacy site. Lead master plan coordination and manage environmental compliance obligations across all facility projects. Oversee community outreach efforts and represent Gilbert Pharmaceuticals at public hearings as needed. Coordinate regulatory submissions and interface directly with operations team on state Boards of Pharmacy, DEA, FDA, and local authorities for facility inspections and approvals. Develop and maintain a facility compliance playbook for new site design and existing facility modifications. Design Lead concept and programming strategy for all new pharmacy facilities, translating operational workflows into effective, compliant physical environments. Manage design team selection and coordination, including architects, MEP engineers, and specialty consultants. Lead the architectural design and space planning for new pharmacy locations, including compounding suites, sterile and non-sterile areas, clean rooms, and dispensing environments. Develop detailed facility design standards and specifications aligned with USP <795>, USP <797>, USP <800>, applicable state Board of Pharmacy requirements, and FDA cGMP requirements for 503B outsourcing facilities. Review and approve architectural drawings, construction documents, and engineering plans for all new pharmacy projects. Design scalable production environments for 503A and 503B operations, including batch manufacturing areas, quarantine/release zones, and controlled material flow segregation. Develop HVAC, cleanroom, airflow, and environmental monitoring specifications in coordination with engineering and operating partners. Coordinate with operating partners to ensure facility design supports validated processes, environmental monitoring programs, and batch production controls. Pre-Con Develop project budgets and oversee value engineering exercises to optimize cost without compromising regulatory or operational standards. Lead GC selection processes, evaluating contractors for pharmacy build-out experience, compliance track record, and execution capability. Manage permit management across all active projects, ensuring timely approvals from local building authorities and regulatory bodies. Develop and track project timelines, procurement schedules, and risk mitigation plans across multiple concurrent site developments. Construction Serve as Owner's representative throughout construction, maintaining accountability for design intent, budget, and schedule. Provide field oversight through regular site inspections and quality walkthroughs to ensure regulatory and operational standards are met. Maintain rigorous cost control across all active build-outs, managing change orders and contractor performance. Oversee FF&E installation and commissioning of all pharmacy-specific equipment and systems. Manage QA & closeout activities including installation qualifications of critical manufacturing utilities (e.g., WFI systems, clean steam, environmental monitoring) where applicable to 503A and 503B facilities. Drive operational readiness in partnership with pharmacy operations and quality teams, ensuring facilities are inspection-ready as soon as possible. Maintain up-to-date documentation including as-built drawings, equipment lists, and SOPs for all facility environments. Support evaluation of pharmacy partners by assessing the design and regulatory readiness of their existing facilities. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering (Mechanical, Civil, or Chemical), Pharmacy, or a closely related field; advanced degree or licensure preferred. 5+ years of experience designing, building, or commissioning pharmacy facilities, healthcare environments, or regulated laboratory/cleanroom spaces. Ability to understand/learn USP <795>, USP <797>, USP <800>, and applicable state Board of Pharmacy facility requirements. Demonstrated project management experience overseeing construction projects from design through commissioning. Experience interfacing with regulatory agencies on facility approvals and inspections. Proficiency with architectural drawings, construction documents, and facility engineering specifications. Experience designing or supporting sterile manufacturing or 503B outsourcing facilities operating under cGMP environments strongly preferred. Ability to travel to pharmacy sites as needed for construction oversight, inspections, and go-live support. Preferred Licensed Architect (AIA), Professional Engineer (PE), or Certified Pharmaceutical Industry Professional (CPIP). Familiarity with digital health or telehealth-linked pharmacy models. Strong vendor management experience working with contractors, engineers, and equipment suppliers. What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months) Documented pharmacy facility design standards and a reusable build-out playbook for new sites. Streamlined project flow to maximize efficiency and completion time per project. Documented budgets for all existing and prospective sites with cost efficient suggestions to scale nationally. Successful delivery of at least three to five new 503A pharmacy facilities on time, on budget, and licensed for operation. Successful delivery of at least one 503B pharmacy facility on time, on budget, and licensed for operation. All existing partner facilities assessed and documented against Gilbert's compliance standards. Strong cross-functional relationships established with pharmacy operations, contracting, and external vendor teams. Benefits Base salary, equity, and bonus structure are open to discussion based on experience and fit. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gilbert-pharmaceuticals-head-of-design-development-construction

items.summary: Who We Are Political Asylum Lawyers is a Houston-based immigration law firm focused on asylum cases. We help immigrants all over the United States secure their futures here through asylum, combining exceptional standards with deep respect for the human reality behind every case.Â Our work changes lives. The standards we maintain, the discipline behind our work, and the way we show up every day can determine whether someone is able to stay safe and build a stable future in the United States. That is why we operate with integrity, urgency, and excellence, and why we expect every team member to take full ownership of their role. Everything we do is guided by our core values: integrity, excellence, accountability, teamwork and passion. Working here means: High-stakes responsibility: our work is of great consequence for our clients Deeply meaningful outcomes: our work changes lives for the better Emotionally demanding moments: resilience and maturity are essential High standards and constant growth: excellence and continuous improvement are expected Mission-driven teamwork: weâre passionate about helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum, and we know that meeting our high standards requires each of us to take ownership, communicate proactively, and support one another If you want a career where your skills create tangible change in the world, this is it. Learn more about what itâs like to work with us here:Â politicalasylumlawyers.com/careers The Role In this role, you'll be an integral part of our team's mission of helping immigrants secure their future in the United States through asylum. We believe that those fleeing persecution deserve expert guidance and unwavering support as they seek safety and a new beginning in the United States.Â The Accounting & Finance Manager (Hands-on) is responsible for managing the firmâs financial operations, accounting systems, billing, accounts receivable, cash flow forecasting, financial reporting, trust accounting compliance, payroll oversight, tax reporting coordination, internal controls, and finance-related operational projects.Â This role serves as the firmâs first level of financial analysis and operational financial control. The Accounting & Finance Manager ensures that financial records are accurate, timely, compliant, and useful for decisions. This is a hands-on role. The initial focus is to learn the firmâs systems, work with existing staff and providers, and establish accurate, reliable financial operations. Recurring accounting and billing work will be delegated progressively, while the manager retains responsibility for controls, review, quality, and results. As readiness and scope are agreed with leadership and current senior finance support, the manager will gradually assume selected planning and reporting responsibilities from that support. The Accounting & Finance Manager must explain complex financial information in plain English, identify financial risks, recommend corrective action, and follow approved actions through implementation and verified results. The role supports leadership decisions on budgeting, profitability, cash management, pricing, collections, and strategic planning.Â What You'll Do Your day-to-day responsibilities will vary based on the firmâs needs, but will include a combination of the following: Financial Operations ManagementÂ Perform and manage day-to-day financial operations, working with existing staff and service providers and documenting procedures so the work is completed accurately and on time. Follow financial issues through to resolution: identify who is responsible for each next step and its deadline, follow up, raise problems with recommended solutions, and confirm that the agreed actions were completed correctly. Ensure accurate execution of accounting, billing, A/R, A/P, payroll, trust accounting, collections, tax coordination, and general ledger maintenance.Â Â Maintain clean and current financial records in the accounting system.Â Â Ensure the legal team is supported with accurate financial information related to client matters, billing, retainers, and collections.Â Â Monitor daily cash balances, bank accounts, credit card activity, merchant activity, and other key financial accounts.Â Â Ensure bills, vendor payments, check requests, and reimbursements are processed accurately and on time. Financial Reporting, Budgeting, and ForecastingÂ Prepare, review, and analyze monthly financial statements and key financial reports on time. Validate supporting records, calculations, and assumptions; investigate material inconsistencies and disclose unresolved limitations.Â Â Ensure monthly financial reports are completed accurately and on time.Â Â Prepare annual and periodic budgets and forecasts as required throughout the year. Provide budget variance reports and explain the results to the Owner/CFO in clear business language, including conclusions, recommendations, and decisions needed. Support the creation, maintenance, and monitoring of the annual budget.Â Â Maintain a forward-looking cash flow forecast to help leadership anticipate shortfalls, plan distributions, and manage working capital.Â Â Track year-over-year revenue growth, gross profit, operating profit, and other key financial trends.Â Â Provide analysis that supports strategic planning, operational planning, and financial decision-making.Â Â Billing, Collections, and Accounts ReceivableÂ Own and continuously improve the firmâs billing and collections process.Â Â Supervise timely preparation and delivery of client invoices.Â Â Monitor payment plans and ensure clients comply with payment terms.Â Â Track, measure, and report accounts receivable aging.Â Â Ensure collection protocols are followed consistently and professionally.Â Â Work with billing staff and leadership to prevent A/R from accruing unnecessarily.Â Â Address client billing questions and payment concerns professionally while protecting the firmâs financial interests.Â Â Own the operational handling of chargebacks, refund requests, billing disputes, and merchant service issues through documented resolution.Â Review billing records, payment history and related correspondence to understand and resolve chargebacks, refund requests and billing disputes. Coordinate follow-up, obtain required approvals, and confirm that any approved refunds, credits or other adjustments are correctly recorded in the relevant systems and account balances. Recommend process improvements to increase collection rate and reduce financial leakage.Â Â Trust Accounting and ComplianceÂ Ensure trust/IOLTA account activity is properly monitored, reconciled, and documented.Â Â Own or review three-way trust reconciliations.Â Â Identify and resolve trust accounting discrepancies with urgency.Â Â Ensure compliance with applicable legal, ethical, and accounting requirements.Â Â Work with the Owner/CFO and CPA to correct accounting or reporting issues.Â Â Maintain strong internal controls to protect the integrity of firm financials.Â Â Internal Controls and Risk ManagementÂ Design, recommend, and enforce financial controls that protect the firm.Â Â Identify financial risks, reporting gaps, compliance issues, cash flow risks, billing breakdowns, and process weaknesses.Â Â Recommend practical corrective actions to leadership and work within approved policies and authority limits.Â Â Support audits, tax preparation, financial reviews, and outside accounting reviews.Â Â Ensure balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liability reconciliations, and bank reconciliations are completed accurately.Â Â Monitor payroll taxes, tax liabilities, vendor obligations, debt obligations, and compliance deadlines.Â Â Finance Team and Vendor OversightÂ Oversee existing staff and providers formally assigned to the role, including the bookkeeper, billing specialist, payroll provider, outsourced finance vendors, and other accounting support.Â Â Provide direction, accountability, and feedback to finance/accounting staff.Â Â Progressively delegate recurring accounting and billing work while retaining controls, review, and accountability for results, as appropriate.Â Participate in onboarding, training, and performance reviews for other assigned finance-related positions.Â Â Ensure finance team members understand expectations, deadlines, reporting requirements, and quality standards.Â Â Hold vendors accountable for timely and accurate work.Â Â Serve as the internal subject matter expert for accounting software, billing systems, chart of accounts, reporting processes, and financial workflows. Identify practical improvements in QuickBooks, Stripe, Google Sheets, Asana, and related workflows. Define financial requirements and implement, test, and document changes with technical support as needed.Â Maintain controls, data quality, security, and approval boundaries, and own completion and accuracy even when technical colleagues build the solution.Â Â Financial Analysis and Business SupportÂ Analyze profitability by service, SKU, practice area, attorney, labor cost, marketing channel, and client/matter type when data is available.Â Â Support pricing reviews to ensure services produce adequate gross profit.Â Â Evaluate underperforming investments, expense categories, vendors, and initiatives.Â Â Track production labor return, utilization, realization, collection rate, and cost of acquisition where applicable.Â Â Help leadership understand Total Owner Benefit, owner distributions, working capital needs, and firm financial health.Â Â Support centralized KPI reporting and scorecard development.Â Who You Are We're looking for professionals who combine technical competence with genuine passion for our mission. The ideal candidate brings: Required QualificationsÂ Bachelorâs degree in Accounting or Finance Minimum of 5 years of progressive accounting or finance experience, preferably in a law firm, professional services firm, or other service-based business.Â Â Strong understanding of general accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, A/R, A/P, payroll, and month-end close.Â Â Experience managing or reviewing trust/IOLTA accounting and reconciliations.Â Â Experience with billing systems, client payment plans, collections, and accounts receivable management.Â Â Strong proficiency with accounting software, legal billing systems, Microsoft Excel, and financial reporting tools. Practical experience using AI tools and automation to improve accounting or finance workflows, with a working understanding of APIs, scripts, and how data moves between systems. Ability to identify improvement opportunities, define clear financial requirements, collaborate with technical colleagues on implementation, and validate the accuracy and reliability of results. Advanced coding skills are not required. Ability to prepare accurate financial reports and explain them clearly to non-financial leaders.Â Â Demonstrated ability to identify financial risks, implement controls, and resolve discrepancies.Â Â Strong organizational, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.Â Â High integrity, confidentiality, discretion, and professional judgment.Â Â Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced law firm environment. Â Â Preferred QualificationsÂ CPA, MBA, advanced finance/accounting credential, or equivalent experience.Â Â 8+ years of accounting, controller, or finance operations experience.Â Â Microsoft Excel Expert Certification preferred. Experience building lightweight scripts or integrations to improve finance workflows.Â Â Prior experience in a law firm or legal services environment.Â Â Experience with systems such as QuickBooks Online, Clio, MyCase, Time Matters, PracticePanther, Smokeball, Lawmatics, Infusionsoft/Keap, or similar platforms.Â Â Experience designing dashboards, centralized KPI reporting, balanced scorecards, or financial performance reports.Â Â Experience supervising bookkeepers, billing specialists, payroll providers, or outsourced accounting vendors.Â Â Advanced experience with complex unstructured data models and analysis, pricing analysis, SKU profitability, labor utilization, realization, collection rate analysis, and cost-of-acquisition reporting.Â Â Experience supporting strategic planning, cash flow planning, debt repayment planning, and owner distribution planning.Â What We Offer This position offers a monthly salary range of USD 3,000 - 3,500 gross, commensurate with experience and qualifications. â Week between Christmas and New Year's â office closed, fully paid â Your country's national public holidays off (paid) - your paid national holidays follow your own country's calendar â Three weeks of paid vacation annually â Comprehensive training program â we invest in bringing you up to speed on our systems, content processes, and best practices â Mentorship and collaboration â learn from experienced team members and contribute your expertise â Career advancement paths â we promote from within and create opportunities â Work from anywhere â this position is open to candidates based in Argentina. â Equipment support â stipend or provided equipment to set up your home office, available after 4 months on the job How to Apply To apply, please submit a resume and a cover letter, both of which must be in English. Your application won't be considered without a cover letter. Your cover letter should explain why you're uniquely qualified for this particular position, and why you would be a great fit for our law firm. Generic, copy/paste cover letters will be discarded. Upload your cover letter and resume, in PDF format, through the software program where you're viewing this announcement. Please do not call or email us about this opening. Please mention the word **WONDERFUL** and tag RMjAuOTguMTQwLjExOQ== when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuOTguMTQwLjExOQ==). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.title: Technical Customer Support
items.summary: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. We have been running since 2014, and we pioneered deliverability technology such as Inbox rotationâ¢ and deliverability AIâ¢. The Role We are hiring a technical customer support person with an owner's mentality. You will own support for QuickMail and Mailflow, our deliverability add-on. There is no first or second line. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. What Work Looks Like You own two things: customers get unstuck fast, and the product stays reliable. Every day Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Delighting customers Comfortable jumping on calls with customers, building rapport fast, and setting them up for success. Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. Share customer feedback with the team, ask happy customers for reviews and case studies, and watch NPS for testimonial candidates. Making support smarter with AI Improve the AI support agent. Review its answers, fix the docs it drew from when it is wrong, and contact the customer when its reply was off. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. Use the MCP connections we have in place (Helpscout, GitHub, Postmark, and others) to get an accurate picture of support and find the next thing worth improving. Keeping the product solid Gatekeep releases. New fixes and features land on staging every week. Test them, confirm when staging is ready to ship, and think through how existing and new users will be affected. Report bugs as GitHub issues with everything the developer needs: steps to reproduce, screenshots or a Loom, and any GraphQL or console errors. Captain red alerts. When a core feature breaks (emails not sending, login down), confirm it, alert the team on Slack or Telegram, update the status page every 30 minutes, keep affected customers informed, and drive the fix. Then run the retrospective so it does not happen twice. Running the week Lead the weekly team meeting in MonsterOps: issues written up, to-dos done, numbers updated. Keep rock status and KPIs current in MonsterOps. items.description: QuickMail is a cold email and LinkedIn outreach platform for markets you can't afford to burn. Our customers can't easily replace leads that land in spam, which is why deliverability matters more to us than anything else. You are the first and last person our customers talk to. Customers count on you to solve their problems and find the real cause when something breaks. You work closely with engineering, and you tell the founder what we need to know to make the product better: where the friction is and where the opportunities are. The role covers the help desk, system health checks, testing new releases before they ship, and leading the weekly team meeting. It takes excellent communication, solid technical understanding and sharp critical thinking. This is not a script-reading job. Most tickets involve deliverability, DNS records, LinkedIn automation or campaign setup. You dig into customer accounts in our Support Dashboard, reproduce the issue, then decide what to do and how to explain it to the customer. We are a remote team spread across time zones. Most routine tasks have a written guide with a checklist, so you know what done looks like. You are expected to refine and improve those processes. When something new comes up, you work out the most efficient way to handle it. If you want a lot of autonomy across many areas, real responsibility and a fast-paced environment, this role is for you. Every day Set the day's support priorities and work the Help Scout queue for QuickMail and Mailflow. Triage, resolve, and dig deeper when a ticket needs it. Check the support dashboard: job queue, event-stream latency, blacklist status, newly purchased domains. If something is off, investigate, diagnose, and drive it to resolution. Review fraud alerts and disable accounts that are scams or abusing the platform. Update the changelog and help articles based on what shipped and what customers asked. Write and maintain automated tests, built with AI, that try to break staging before customers do. items.summary: About DEUNA ð§¡ DEUNA is a rapidly growing startup revolutionizing global commerce with ATHIA, our AI-powered orchestration and payments platform that helps large enterprises boost approval rates, reduce costs, and unlock new revenue. Built by the team behind DEUNAâthe fastest-growing Commerce OS in Latin AmericaâATHIA combines payment intelligence, checkout optimization, and data orchestration in one powerful solution. With deep integrations across 300+ PSPs and alternative payment methods, and over 20% of Mexicoâs digital economy running through our platform, we simplify global payments through a single integration and centralized reconciliation. We are a rapidly growing startup expanding into the U.S. to meet the urgent needs of large retailers, marketplaces, airlines, and QSRs. Join us to shape the future of payments! ð Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us! About the Role As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will be the primary technical point of contact for our merchants after their initial go-live. You will help monitor merchant technical health, support incident management, answer ongoing technical questions, and guide merchants through future technical evolutions. For DEUNAâs premium and key accounts, the TAM plays a critical role in making sure merchants feel technically protected, proactively monitored, and confident operating on our platform. Your mission is to help ensure every merchant is operationally stable, technically satisfied, and continuously improving on DEUNA. Responsibilities Proactively monitor merchant technical health Monitor merchant performance, transaction behavior, errors, declines, latency, and anomalies. Identify potential risks before they become merchant-impacting issues. Raise internal flags when technical or operational risks are detected. Help maintain account-specific dashboards, alerts, and health views for key merchants. Be the main technical contact after go-live Act as the primary technical point of contact for merchant questions and doubts after go-live. Help merchants understand technical flows, configurations, integrations, and platform behavior. Coordinate internally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, and Account Management when merchant needs require cross-functional support. Support technical incident management Triage merchant-reported and internally detected issues. Escalate issues to the appropriate on-call, Engineering, Product, or Operations teams. Track resolution and ensure timely internal and external follow-up. Help ensure communication with merchants is clear, factual, and timely. Support post-incident follow-up, including impact explanation, corrective actions, and prevention measures when required. Drive merchant technical improvements Identify opportunities to improve merchant performance, stability, acceptance rate, routing behavior, fraud flows, provider configuration, or processing cost. Partner with Account Management to support merchant expansion and long-term account growth. Help merchants adopt new payment methods, providers, features, or technical capabilities after launch. Build merchant health visibility Build and deliver simple Merchant Health Reports periodically to Account Management and/or merchants. Maintain accurate technical documentation for merchant-specific configurations, customizations, providers, integrations, and known risks. Help prioritize and advocate for merchantsâ technical needs internally. Requirements 3+ years in Technical Account Management, Merchant Support, Solutions Engineering, Technical Customer Success, or similar roles. Strong technical understanding of online payment ecosystems, including APIs, SDKs, transaction flows, processors, acquirers, fraud tools, chargebacks, refunds, captures, and 3DS. Experience with incident management, post-launch technical operations, technical troubleshooting, and client-facing support. Ability to analyze logs, dashboards, error patterns, transaction behavior, and operational metrics. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Strong organization, ownership, urgency, and follow-up discipline. Fluent in Spanish and English. Experience working with LatAm merchants is a must. Startup environment experience is a plus. What Success Looks Like A successful TAM helps premium merchants feel that DEUNA is actively watching over their payment operation, not simply reacting when something breaks. The TAM should help ensure that: Merchant issues are detected and escalated quickly. Critical incidents are followed through with urgency and ownership. Merchants receive clear and timely technical communication. Account Management has strong technical support to retain and expand key accounts. Merchants continuously improve their technical performance and payment outcomes on DEUNA. \n \n What will you find when you join DEUNA? - A multicultural team distributed throughout LATAM - Dynamism, agility and constant innovation - Being part of a high-impact solution for an entire region - The best tools and technology to operate - Being part of the startup culture. - We are in full expansion! items.summary: We are seeking a Senior FP&A Analyst to lead end-to-end financial planning, reporting, and forecasting for operating expenses across the organization. In this role, you will own cost center analysis, drive forecast consolidation, manage systems integrity between TM1 and NetSuite, and serve as a strategic finance business partner to department leade
items.description: We are seeking a Senior FP&A Analyst to lead end-to-end financial planning, reporting, and forecasting for operating expenses across the organization. In this role, you will own cost center analysis, drive forecast consolidation, manage systems integrity between TM1 and NetSuite, and serve as a strategic finance business partner to department leaders across the company. The ideal candidate brings strong financial modeling expertise, hands-on experience with corporate planning tools, and the confidence to constructively challenge operational teams on budget assumptions while translating complex numbers into actionable business narratives. Responsibilities: Own the FP&A OpEx close—analyzing variances, preparing monthly management reporting packs (P&L, dashboards, board inputs), and partnering with Accounting on accruals and prepayments. Own planning, trend analysis, and variance commentary for non-people OpEx (software, marketing, T&E, professional services). Track cost efficiency metrics and ensure accurate TM1 mapping. Lead annual OpEx budget cycles and recurring reforecasts. Build dynamic, driver-based forecasting models and support Long-Range Planning (LRP) scenario modeling. Consolidate OpEx, workforce, and revenue forecasts into a single defensible group view in TM1. Support the FP&A Director in presenting to the CFO, ELT, and Board. Act as the strategic finance partner to department heads - translating numbers into actionable insights, constructively challenging spend assumptions, and flagging risks/opportunities. Ensure TM1 remains the single source of truth vs. NetSuite actuals. Drive reporting automation, refine Google Sheets dashboards, and streamline close/budget cycles. 5-7+ years in finance with 2–3+ years in FP&A. Experience owning end-to-end close/budget cycles and partnering directly with non-finance stakeholders. Tech, SaaS, or scale-up background strongly preferred. Advanced Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills. Hands-on experience with corporate planning tools (TM1/Cognos is a strong plus; Anaplan/Adaptive) and ERP systems (NetSuite preferred). Strong grasp of core accounting concepts (accruals, prepayments, opex vs. capex). Commercial mindset, structured thinking, strong communication skills, and the confidence to challenge budget assumptions constructively. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field (ACCA/CIMA/CFA or Master's is a plus). Fluent in English (Lithuanian is an advantage). About us PVcase is moving solar forward with an alternative to the traditional labor-intensive, time-consuming, error-prone solar project development process. With our sophisticated site selection, PV design, and yield estimation software, you can achieve maximum results in a fraction of the time — to succeed faster, build better, and accelerate the global transition to clean energy. PVcase ends clunky processes and corrupted data to clear the path to a net-zero economy. Whether you use a single product or plug into the entire platform, our end-to-end site selection, design, and yield assessment software makes you faster, precise, and highly productive at every stage of project development. PVcase is a leading choice for solar energy professionals — our platform serves over 1,800 customers in 75+ countries, powering the development of more than 4 TW of projects a year. Get ready to enjoy Flex benefit package, customizing perks to match your unique style. Enjoy unlimited remote work or join the vibrant offices in Vilnius, Kaunas, or Barcelona. Flexible working hours, harmonizing your personal and professional life. Half-day Summer Fridays. Full training and onboarding program for a seamless start. Exclusive work only with international markets. Considerable & steadily increasing salary, recognizing and rewarding your dedication. Frequent in-office and after-hours activities with team members. Participation in international training programs. Internal transparency with company results and salary system, promoting a culture of trust and collaboration. Additional paid vacation days, including birthdays, volunteering, and other occasions. Salary Range: Lithuania: 45,100 - 60,000 EUR gross/yearly. Spain: 37,200 - 50,000 EUR gross/yearly. Netherlands: 57,600 - 75,000 EUR gross/yearly. Immigration-related employment support, such as visa sponsorship or transfer, is not available for this position. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Establish dashboards for full visibility into the health and efficiency of the platform. Evangelize the right levels of logging to the development team and the importance of metrics. Familiar with designing and developing with the principles of reuse, componentization, and the proper level of abstraction Experience operating AWS, Azure, GCP or a combination Possess an understanding and familiarity of the many aspects of cloud-based platforms (preferably AWS) from development to deployment to operations Able to manage accurate and rapid project scoping and estimating Able to consume large amounts of information and quickly distilling it into usable knowledge Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Director of Customer Success
items.summary: DescriptionAnchor closed $40M in top-tier VC funding and grew 500% last year, transforming the $74B services payments market.
items.description: Description Anchor closed $40M in top-tier VC funding and grew 500% last year, transforming the $74B services payments market. Our platform automates billing and collections so businesses can focus on growth. At Anchor, we’re redefining the future of B2B Payments. Our innovative, end-to-end billing and collections platform eliminates the frustrations of manual processes, making financial workflows seamless, automated, and stress-free. We empower businesses to focus on their core strengths while we handle the complexities of billing and collections. Our Customer Support organization sits at the core of Anchor and is a key driver for our growth, ensuring every customer has an exceptional experience. As we continue to grow rapidly, we’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Director of Customer Success to build, grow, and lead our customer organization across the entire journey - from onboarding through activation and retention. Reporting directly to the COO of Anchor, the ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional ownership, a holistic business mindset, meticulous attention to detail, and a consultative, action-oriented approach that truly sets them apart. Responsibility Lead and scale Anchor’s Customer Success function across the full customer journey—from onboarding to long-term retention. Develop and execute a comprehensive CS strategy that aligns with customer goals and drives measurable value. Own and evolve onboarding, account management, and customer support processes that maximize adoption and satisfaction. Build deep, trusted relationships with customers—including executive stakeholders—and act as their strategic advisor. Define and track KPIs to measure customer health, satisfaction, and team effectiveness; drive data-informed improvements. Own systems and tooling for customer success (e.g., ticketing, reporting, support infrastructure). Build and maintain a robust knowledge base for internal and customer use. Collaborate closely with product, sales, R&D, and marketing to represent the voice of the customer and shape our roadmap. Develop customer success stories and use cases for both internal learning and external marketing. Hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing CS team that delivers excellence at scale. Requirements 2+ years of experience managing CS team leaders, plus 3+ years leading CS teams directly in a fast-paced, data-driven, B2B SaaS company- (Fintech experience is a strong plus.) Building and scaling CS processes from the ground up, along with CS strategies, operating models, and tools, across the full customer lifecycle. Highly detailed and structured professional, with experience designing and implementing scalable CS processes. Superb capabilities in managing even the most challenging customer relationships—able to turn difficult moments into positive, productive outcomes. A highly motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take initiative, prioritize effectively, and adapt quickly. Strong project management chops, you can juggle multiple priorities, communicate clearly, and drive outcomes. Analytical and metrics-driven; you thrive on dashboards, insights, and measurable impact. A true player-coach: you enjoy managing accounts yourself while scaling and supporting your team and processes. Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to turn data into actionable insights. Experience managing complex stakeholder relationships across multiple levels of an organization. Skilled in customer meetings, demos, workshops, QBRs, and executive briefings. Proficiency in Excel and CS platforms (e.g., HubSpot) is a must. Bachelor’s degree or MBA in accounting/finance. Or 2+ years of practical managerial experience in those fields- required. And finally: zero ego, we’re a team of builders who work hard, stay humble, and support each other. Extra Experience in management consulting, sales engineering, or post-sales technical support. items.title: Reporting Manager
items.summary: Who We Are Heritage is building the Modern Investment Office, supporting some of the most prominent families globally to achieve their capital enhancement and preservation goals.
items.description: Who We Are Heritage is building the Modern Investment Office , supporting some of the most prominent families globally to achieve their capital enhancement and preservation goals. Our vision is to help clients build enduring wealth across generations by combining institutional-grade investment sourcing with personalized portfolio construction, cutting-edge technology, and deep sector expertise. We aim to make sophisticated private market opportunities and modern wealth solutions more transparent, connected, and actionable. Our team comprises a diverse international group of individuals from leading organizations and with diverse backgrounds , including private equity, venture capital, banking, software development, law, and entrepreneurship. We are committed to attracting top-notch talent and providing opportunities for growth and development based on their individual strengths and interests. Your role as Reporting Manager We are looking for a Reporting Manager to join our strategic Central Reporting Team, a recent established team that is scaling rapidly alongside Heritage's strong growth. The Portfolio Monitoring team is core to our business and sits at the intersection of investment, technology and data. Acting as a central function across our European offices, it supports our Wealth Management business by ensuring that Relationship Managers have access to accurate, timely and consolidated portfolio information to deliver outstanding advisory and discretionary services to our UHNWI clients. You will work directly with front-office professionals, gaining exposure to portfolio construction, asset allocation and client investment strategies while becoming a key contributor to the quality of the information used in client decision-making on investments and wealth management. One of the team's most exciting missions is to rethink how portfolio monitoring is performed. Together with our Product and Technology teams, you will contribute to the designing, improving and scaling the Wealth Monitoring & Reporting Framework and the continuous enhancement of our proprietary new wealth management platform, a real tool for clarity and decision-making support, rather than simply a collection of numbers. items.summary: About Discovered LabsDiscovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR.
items.description: About Discovered Labs Discovered Labs is an SEO/AEO agency built by a Stanford rocket scientist turned AI researcher and a demand gen marketer with experience scaling B2B SaaS companies to 8-figures in ARR. We’re trusted by hyper-growth companies like Instantly, Granola, incident and other $10M+ ARR B2B SaaS companies who want more leads and customers from both Google and AI assistants like ChatGPT. We do this through a mixture of content marketing, technical optimisations and off-site brand amplification (PR, backlinks, Reddit marketing). View recent case studies at . High-level, our approach rests on three things: AI automation and workflows. We build marketing programs the way you’d build a product. Rather than burn hours a week on repetitive tasks, our in-house team of ML engineers builds workflows with custom tooling so we can focus on the high-impact work. Senior expertise. Everything is managed and elevated by a team of experts, so it’s done to a high standard and differentiated. We don’t let automation get in the way of quality. Full-stack. SEO and AEO rarely work as isolated tasks. We work across the entire funnel and multiple surfaces so we own the outcome and clients win. If you want to stand out, include a Loom showing a tool, system or deliverable you’ve built and are proud of. We’d love to see it. This role You analyse the data, work out why performance is moving and turn the result into a report the client can act on. You implement the fixes and improvements yourself with our internal tooling. “DS who owns data → analysis → decision → implementation end to end” Concretely, that means you: Analyse the data behind reports, strategy questions, client queries, technical issues and SWOTs — reconciling messy, incomplete sources into a clear picture of what's actually happening. QA via analysis - Is the rationale sound? Does the logic hold? Where's the unsupported claim? Run experiments. Design a falsifiable test, run it, and know when a result is noise rather than signal. Tie every finding to the client's business. You get to "so what, and why does this matter to their revenue," not just "here's what the data says." Own the report. Hand the client and the account strategist a decision-ready read the data, the diagnosis and the “so what?” never a raw data dump. Optimise for answer engines (AEO). Make client content the source LLMs and Google AI Overviews cite, using our internal methodology and tools, as one surface among many. Execute, not just recommend. You implement the findings yourself with our internal tooling. The analysis only counts once it's shipped. Improve the tactics and the systems. Turn a one-off finding into a repeatable process, and keep sharpening the tooling and methodology behind how the system works. Communicate it cleanly to clients , in writing and on calls, so your output needs no translation. This role is fully remote. Ideally your working hours overlap the GMT business day (we’re flexible within roughly ±4 hours). This is not for you if: You need heavy management, or you wait for perfect instructions before acting. If you spot a broken process, we expect you to fix it. Produce genius insights but don’t ship them. Insight with no execution is exactly the failure mode we screen for. The analyst who gets on the tools is the one we want. Lack experience and/or willingness to use advanced AI workflows. Prefer to spend weeks performing audits before implementation. B2B SaaS clients expect results fast and everything needs to tie to commercial impact. Not comfortable with data and analytics. We want someone who can diagnose the why behind performance and back it with evidence. What’s in it for you Benefits $30,000 -$50,000 annual salary depending on relevant skills and experience Fully remote position. (Ideally flexible within roughly ±4 hours GMT ) Room to grow. We’re small but growing, which means real opportunity, including a senior track with no people management required. Paid leave and autonomy to perform your role. The best in-house SEO/AEO tools i.e. ML/AI and data science tooling , built by top engineers, at your disposal. How you’ll spend your time A rough split; it flexes month to month with what each account needs. 40% — Implementing and shipping. Producing and shipping the week’s work across your accounts: technical fixes, on-page, content refreshes, internal linking, off-page and AEO, all verified at source before it goes out. 30% — Analysing, diagnosing and measuring. Getting into the numbers to understand cause and effect, designing and running experiments, and measuring what actually moved after a change. 15% — Reporting and client communication. Owning the client-facing report, being present on calls to walk through the diagnosis, staying close in day-to-day client Slack, and giving the account owner the read behind the story they lead. 15% — Building and evolving the methodology. Sharpening your own skills as search and AI assistants keep changing, and constantly improving the tooling, templates and process behind how the team works. Requirements This role owns the full loop end to end, analyse → explain → implement → report. You don't hand off execution: you analyse it, you build it, you ship it. High agency and a builder's instinct are the two traits we weight above everything, including domain knowledge. High agency covers execution and tempo; builder covers coding, AI workflows, and evolving the methodology. Strong analytical and quantitative background: you reconcile messy, incomplete data (GSC exports, rank trackers, partial client analytics not clean warehouse tables), design falsifiable experiments, and reason to a root cause with evidence, never inventing a cause where the data is silent. Demonstrated evidence of shipping a time your analysis changed what a business did, and you implemented at least part of it yourself. Insight without execution is exactly the wrong fit for this seat. You're AI-native and have built something with it: a side project, agent, scraper, or internal tool. You use AI tools daily as a workflow multiplier (briefs, clustering, audit summarisation, scraping) and still own the final, validated output. You build workflows, not just prompts and we take portfolio over claims. Experiment design and statistical rigour : you design a test, run it, and know when a result is noise. Systems thinking: you improve the tactic and improve the system colonbehind it, turning a one-off finding into a repeatable process. Commercial curiosity: you get to "so what?" unprompted, asking about the client's business model and KPIs, and land every finding as a business consequence revenue, pipeline, or cost not just a metric movement. Strong written and verbal English , with the ability to convey findings cleanly to non-technical stakeholders. Reports and QA rationale go straight to clients; the analysis only counts once a client understands it and acts on it. Nice-to-haves (not required) Experience with SEO/analytics tooling (GSC, GA4, Ahrefs, a crawler such as Screaming Frog). If you don’t have it, we’ll ramp you this is teachable. Client-facing experience, and commercial awareness. Familiarity with B2B SaaS. Culture fit You should ideally believe: Search has fundamentally changed. Google and backlinks still matter but are no longer the full picture — AI search is a new frontier and you’re excited about the shift. AI is a force multiplier, not a crutch. You’re actively using AI daily and building workflows, not just typing into a chat box. Speed and quality are both achievable. Everyone here operates at a fast pace, is reliable and takes extreme ownership. There are no passengers at Discovered Labs. You’ll thrive here if: you get energy from excellent work that makes clients successful, you see gaps in processes and fix them without being asked, and you move fast while proactively communicating. You won’t thrive here if: you need heavy management, you wait for perfect instructions, or you think SEO is still just about keywords and links. We look forward to seeing your application. items.description: Software Engineering About the team The Industry Software organization builds the B2B SaaS platforms that power Zillow's software and services for real estate professionals, including: - Home listing, lead delivery, and home shopper lifecycle workflows - Identity and access: account hierarchies, user identity, team roster/permissions management - Enterprise integrations: broker rosters, listing feeds, partner data pipelines - Monetization: purchasing, pricing, billing, entitlements, and internal tooling for sales, support, and operations We work in tight partnership with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Customer Support, and Finance to build an integrated, reliable, and scalable B2B ecosystem for our industry customers - and we aim to do it smart, humble, hardworking, and highly collaborative. About the role We're seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to own some of the most complex, strategically important initiatives in Industry Software - multi-team, cross-organizational programs that span multiple product areas, from strategy and scope through execution, launch, and post-launch learning. You'll act as a thought partner to senior and executive leaders, bridge Product, Engineering, and Design to create clarity from ambiguity, and build deep expertise across our domains (monetization, identity and access, enterprise integrations, real estate SaaS and lead delivery) while operating as a strong generalist who ramps up quickly elsewhere. You'll operate at both strategic and tactical levels: energized by building structure where little exists, balancing technical depth with strong stakeholder management, and setting direction while rolling up your sleeves to get high-quality work done on time. What You'll Do Strategy and planning : Define cross-org initiatives that align with Industry Software and broader Zillow B2B priorities; translate strategy into program charters, success metrics, and multi-release execution plans; shape scope and sequencing with Product, Engineering, and Design leaders. Execution and delivery : Own the program lifecycle end to end - planning, dependency mapping, execution, launch, and post-launch follow-through - and drive the operating rhythms (status reviews, dependency checkpoints, release readiness) that keep teams delivering reliably, without subsuming team-level agile ceremonies owned by EMs and PMs. Risk and metrics : Identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks early; drive mitigation and tradeoff decisions with leadership; use data to measure program health and guide iterative improvement. Stakeholder communication : Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Product, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations; communicate status, risks, and decisions in a crisp, executive-ready narrative up to VP/SVP level. Technical leadership : Build working knowledge of the systems, APIs, and data flows within your program scope; partner with Principal Engineers and architects to shape technical approach; ramp up quickly across domains like monetization, identity and access, enterprise integrations, and real estate SaaS/lead delivery. TPM craft : Define and refine planning, risk, and reporting best practices for Industry Software; mentor other TPMs as a force multiplier for program management excellence; use AI-native tools to increase program efficiency and decision speed. Who you are 8+ years in Technical Program Management (or equivalent), leading large-scale, multi-team, cross-org programs - including portfolio-level and multi-quarter planning - at mid-size or large companies. items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it. This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation. You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team. We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Database platform (approx. 60%) Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths. Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions. Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene. Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path. Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require. Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability. Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%) Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes. Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them. Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant. Team, incidents, and collaboration Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence. Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person. Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS Required — PostgreSQL depth 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL. Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning. Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services. Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables. Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies. Required — Infrastructure and ways of working Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS. Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling. Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation). Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes. Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists. Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued). Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load. Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows. Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional). MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . items.summary: Headquarters: Remote About the Team Netlify is a product-led growth company, and Revenue Operations owns the systems, data, and infrastructure that turn that growth into revenue. With a large volume of people discovering and signing up for Netlify every day, Marketing Operations is critical to understanding those users, connecting activity across
items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Remote About the Team Netlify is a product-led growth company, and Revenue Operations owns the systems, data, and infrastructure that turn that growth into revenue. With a large volume of people discovering and signing up for Netlify every day, Marketing Operations is critical to understanding those users, connecting activity across our systems, and creating scalable ways to engage them throughout their journey. As Senior Marketing Operations Manager, you’ll own the operational foundation behind that work. You’ll connect HubSpot, Salesforce, product data, and analytics, build the systems and lifecycle infrastructure that turn signals into action, and give Marketing and our GTM partners trusted visibility into performance. Reporting to the Senior Director of Revenue Operations, you’ll translate the Marketing Operations vision into a roadmap and independently drive it forward while partnering closely with Growth, RevOps, Data, Product, and other GTM teams. What You’ll Do Execute on the Marketing Operations roadmap, translating broader Marketing and GTM priorities into scalable systems, processes, and programs. Own our marketing automation platform end to end, including workflows, lifecycle stages, segmentation, forms, lists, email operations, data hygiene, deliverability, governance, and documentation. Build and maintain the connection between marketing automation, Salesforce, product data, and analytics so we can understand and engage users throughout the customer journey. Establish reliable attribution and measurement across marketing and product-led journeys, including UTM governance and connections between campaigns, signups, activation, conversion, and revenue. Build reporting and self-service dashboards that give Marketing and GTM partners a trusted view of performance and support weekly, monthly, and executive-level decision-making. Partner with Growth to operationalize lifecycle programs across email, in-product experiences, and sales-assist triggers, turning customer and product signals into scalable journeys from signup through activation and conversion. Build experimentation infrastructure that allows marketers to launch, measure, and learn from tests without requiring engineering support for every experiment. Own the operational health of the MarTech stack, including integrations, data flows, governance, vendor relationships, and periodic assessments of what we should keep, retire, consolidate, or integrate. Establish scalable practices for high-volume email operations, including audience management, domain and inbox health, deliverability, and safeguards that protect the customer experience. Turn large and sometimes ambiguous datasets into actionable recommendations, identifying points of friction or drop-off and partnering with Marketing, Growth, Product, Data, and RevOps on opportunities to improve conversion. Own the Marketing Operations portion of the broader Marketing budget and evaluate technology investments based on business value, scalability, and ROI. Explore emerging capabilities in AI-enabled marketing operations and AI visibility measurement, helping the team establish useful workflows and baselines as the space develops. What You’ll Bring 7+ years of experience in Marketing Operations or a closely related discipline, with experience operating independently in a complex B2B SaaS or product-led growth environment. Deep experience with marketing automation platforms and CRM systems such as HubSpot, Marketo, Eloqua, and Salesforce, including lifecycle stages, campaign architecture, attribution, lead or account routing, and data governance. Experience working with high-volume customer or prospect datasets and designing segmentation, lifecycle, and operational approaches that remain reliable at scale. Significant experience operating high-volume email programs, with a practical understanding of deliverability, domain and inbox reputation, audience management, warming strategies, and the risks that emerge at large sending volumes. Strong analytical skills and the ability to investigate complex datasets, identify meaningful patterns, question the quality of the underlying data, and turn findings into recommendations. Experience building or operating lifecycle, nurture, or in-product engagement programs tied to measurable activation or conversion outcomes. Systems thinking and experience designing integrations across marketing automation, CRM, product, analytics, and data systems. Experience building measurement and experimentation infrastructure that enables other teams to operate and learn independently. Strong GTM fluency and an understanding of how Marketing Operations, Growth, Sales, RevOps, Product, and Customer Success connect to customer experience and revenue. Comfort using AI-enabled tools and workflows to accelerate your work while applying judgment to validate outputs and determine where automation is (and isn’t) appropriate. Familiarity with product analytics tools such as Amplitude and experience with emerging AEO or AI-visibility tooling is helpful. Experience working with contractors, agencies, or distributed partners is helpful but not required. Familiarity with developer tools, web platforms, or another high-volume PLG business is useful, but we value relevant operating experience over category-specific expertise. This Role Is a Great Fit If You enjoy building the foundation, not just operating what someone else has already built. You’re energized by taking an imperfect system and creating something scalable, measurable, and trusted. You’re comfortable moving between architecture and execution. You can define how a system should work and then get into the details yourself when necessary to make it work. You thrive with significant autonomy. Given a goal and context, you investigate the problem, weigh tradeoffs, make a recommendation, and drive the work forward without needing a detailed playbook. You genuinely enjoy data. Large, messy datasets make you curious, and you’re willing to dig until you understand what is happening and what the business should do about it. You care deeply about operational quality. Data integrity, attribution, documentation, audience segmentation, and email deliverability aren’t afterthoughts—they’re part of building a trustworthy growth engine. You balance speed with judgment. You know when to move quickly, when a shortcut creates unacceptable downstream risk, and when to challenge an approach that won’t scale. You see AI as a way to amplify good judgment and increase leverage rather than a substitute for understanding the work. You communicate clearly in an async, distributed environment and can build alignment across Marketing, Growth, Product, Sales, RevOps, and Data without relying on organizational authority. Applying Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway! When applying please include: A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com . About Netlify Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable. We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you! At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $155,000 - $210,000 for most US-based locations. Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/netlify-senior-marketing-operations-manager
