items.title: Consultancy Opportunity: Coordinator, Global Platform for Action to End FGM/C
items.summary: Consultancy Opportunity: Coordinator, Global Platform for Action to End FGM/C Duration: 13 months, anticipated from 15 November 2026 to 15 December 2027 Estimated level of effort: Equivalent to three (3) days per week Location and availability: This is a remote consultancy open to applicants globally, with applications particularly encouraged from consultants based in Asia and Africa.
items.description: Consultancy Opportunity: Coordinator, Global Platform for Action to End FGM/C Duration: 13 months, anticipated from 15 November 2026 to 15 December 2027 Estimated level of effort: Equivalent to three (3) days per week Location and availability: This is a remote consultancy open to applicants globally, with applications particularly encouraged from consultants based in Asia and Africa. The Consultant must be able to coordinate across time zones and participate in agreed meetings with the Platform’s international membership. About the Global Platform: The Global Platform for Action to End FGM/C is a consortium of civil society organisations, champions, survivors, and grassroots representatives working together to accelerate the abandonment and prevention of female genital mutilation/cutting (FGM/C). Established following consultations initiated at the 2019 Women Deliver conference in Vancouver, the Global Platform brings together members across regions to exchange knowledge, strengthen collaboration, and advance collective advocacy. Its Global Call to Action to End FGM/C, launched in November 2019, calls for urgent, coordinated action to end FGM/C. The Global Platform works across intersecting movements, including those addressing sexual and gender-based violence, sexual and reproductive health and rights, and child, early, and forced marriage. Purpose of the Consultancy: The Global Platform seeks a consultant to provide coordination, governance, membership, and communications support. The assignment will help translate members’ collective commitments into an achievable programme of joint action and strengthen the Platform’s longer-term sustainability. The consultancy will focus on three priorities, in the following order: Strengthening governance and membership arrangements. Establishing consistent coordination and communications. Supporting resource mobilisation and longer-term sustainability. Advocacy activities, events, and other requests will be prioritised within the agreed workplan, level of effort, and available budget. Scope of Work and Expected Deliverables: 1. Inception and work planning In consultation with the Core Group and Equality Now , the Consultant will: Review existing governance documents, membership arrangements, communications channels, and relevant commitments. Prepare an inception workplan within the first month, setting out deliverables, milestones, dependencies, and a realistic allocation of the available consultancy time. Identify decisions, member contributions, and resources needed to complete the assignment. 2. Governance and membership The Consultant will: Facilitate consultation on, and prepare a final draft of, the Platform’s membership terms of reference, including the proposed two-tier membership model, for Core Group approval. Develop practical guidance on membership, decision-making, and the respective responsibilities of members and the Core Group. Establish an organised membership database using an agreed system, with appropriate access and information-handling arrangements. Develop a membership outreach and onboarding approach, prioritising grassroots and survivor-led organisations and organisations based in the Global Majority. Produce an accessible overview of the Platform, its purpose, and opportunities for participation. 3. Coordination and member engagement The Consultant will: Coordinate monthly Core Group meetings, including scheduling, preparation, and follow-up. Circulate agendas and relevant materials at least one (1) week before each meeting, subject to timely input from members. Circulate meeting records and an updated action tracker within five (5) working days after each meeting. Maintain a central record of agreed decisions, actions, responsibilities, and deadlines. Provide a central contact point for Platform enquiries and coordinate responses with the appropriate members. Facilitate member contributions and flag outstanding decisions or dependencies that may affect delivery. 4. Communications and shared resources The Consultant will: Develop and implement a proportionate communications schedule covering the internal listserv, public mailing list, and social media channels. Coordinate member contributions and prepare content for approval through agreed processes. Coordinate website content updates and provide agreed content and member input to the external website redesign consultant. Support the development of common messages and positioning for Core Group approval. Organise key documents and resources so that members can access and use them. 5. Strategic planning and sustainability The Consultant will: Facilitate the development of a three-year strategic workplan, including objectives, priority actions, indicative responsibilities, and resource requirements, for Core Group approval. Develop a practical tracker for commitments under the Movement-led Collective Vision on Ending FGM/C, drawing on updates provided by participating members. Map potential funding and partnership opportunities and recommend a prioritised approach to follow-up. Prepare a concise impact summary and a core set of materials to support partnership development and fundraising. Develop recommendations for sustaining the Platform’s coordination function beyond the consultancy period. The Consultant will support resource mobilisation but will not be responsible for guaranteeing funding or the performance of individual member organisations. 6. Joint advocacy and events Within the agreed workplan and available resources, the Consultant will: Provide secretariat support for the Platform’s engagement with the FGM/C Donor Working Group. Coordinate the preparation and dissemination of three shared advocacy materials during the consultancy period. Coordinate at least two webinars during the consultancy period, including agreed co-host arrangements, speaker coordination, and follow-up. Support the meaningful participation of grassroots activists and survivors in the planning and delivery of these activities. Support selected joint advocacy events were expressly included in the agreed workplan. Any additional events or travel will require prior agreement on scope, timing, funding, and any effect on other deliverables. Representation of the Platform will require an agreed mandate and approved messaging. 7. Progress reporting and handover The Consultant will: Submit a short quarterly progress report summarising completed deliverables, progress against the workplan, challenges, and decisions required. Coordinate agreed narrative inputs for donor reporting and maintain an activity expenditure tracker in collaboration with Equality Now . Financial approvals and formal donor submissions will remain with the authorised organisation. Submit a final report and handover package before the consultancy ends, including key documents, outstanding actions, and recommendations for continuity. Contracting, Coordination, and Duration Equality Now will contract and administer this independent consultancy, which is not an employee position, for 13 months, from 15 November 2026 to 15 December 2027, with an estimated level of effort equivalent to three (3) days per week. The Consultant will organise delivery independently, coordinating availability across time zones for agreed meetings and deadlines. Equality Now ’s designated focal point will consolidate feedback, coordinate approvals, and accept deliverables, working with the Ending Gender-based Violence team. The Global Platform’s Core Group will guide substantive priorities and approve outputs requiring collective agreement. Member requests will follow this coordination process. Performance will be assessed against agreed deliverables and milestones. Material changes to scope, timing, or level of effort require prior written agreement with Equality Now . The consultancy agreement will address confidentiality, intellectual property, information security, safeguarding, and payment. Any extension will require available funding and a separate written agreement; renewal is not guaranteed. Consultancy Fee and Payment: The total consultancy fee is USD 26,000, payable in thirteen monthly instalments of USD 2,000, subject to satisfactory delivery of the services and submission of an invoice and brief progress summary. The consultancy agreement will specify the invoicing periods and payment schedule, including the treatment of the first and final partial calendar months. Travel and other reimbursable expenses are separate from the consultancy fee and must be approved in writing before they are incurred, subject to available funding and the terms of the consultancy agreement. Consultant Qualifications and Experience: The Consultant should demonstrate: Relevant coordination experience: A track record of coordinating coalitions, networks, or multi-stakeholder initiatives, including facilitating meetings, maintaining action plans, and supporting delivery across organisations. Relevant subject knowledge: An understanding of FGM/C and its connections to gender equality, human rights, and sexual and reproductive health and rights. Inclusive facilitation and relationship-building: Experience working respectfully with diverse partners, including grassroots organisations and survivor-led movements, and enabling meaningful participation across regions and time zones. Governance and planning skills: The ability to translate consultation and collective priorities into practical governance arrangements, membership processes, and achievable strategic workplans. Strong communications skills: The ability to produce clear, accessible written materials, synthesise contributions from multiple stakeholders, and coordinate digital communications. Strong written and spoken English is required; additional languages are an advantage. Independent delivery: The ability to organise the assignment, exercise sound judgement, manage competing priorities, and deliver agreed outputs within the available time and budget. Experience supporting resource mobilisation, donor reporting, joint advocacy, or online events would be an advantage. Relevant professional, community-based, and lived experience will be valued. Applicants should demonstrate a commitment to feminist principles, safeguarding, and respectful engagement with survivors. HOW TO APPLY Please visit: and submit a resume/CV and cover letter. The applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the application period closes at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on 30 October, 2026. Due to the volume of applicants anticipated for this role, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview. Equality Now is strong because it is diverse. We actively seek a diverse applicant pool and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Equality Now offers a competitive compensation package, including base salary, savings, health and vacation benefits, and is an Equal Opportunity employer. Equality Now employees are selected on the basis of ability without regard to race, colour, religious beliefs, sex, gender identity and expression, language, political or other opinion, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, pregnancy, mental status, HIV status, age, marital status, or sexual orientation. We welcome all kinds of diversity. Candidates are selected on the basis of ability, in accordance with all country and location-specific law Salary: $26,000 Originally posted on Himalayas

As AI models and digital commerce platforms increasingly integrate local business data, search mapping workflows, and automated merchant tools, their accuracy relies entirely on authentic, real-world verification. The objective of this project is to autonomously evaluate merchant-facing features, audit local search representation, and deliver structured feedback to refine AI-driven commerce systems. Project Deliverables & Scope Operate autonomously to evaluate digital merchant tools and provide structured business data. Expected deliverables include: Feature Testing & UX Evaluation: Independently testing newly deployed platform features, digital storefront tools, or AI recommendations designed for local business management and customer engagement. Search & Profile Auditing: Reviewing AI-generated business summaries, search visibility responses, and mapping integrations to verify empirical accuracy against actual business operations. Structured Feedback Generation: Providing comprehensive, audit-ready feedback detailing platform usability, relevance of digital tools, and practical day-to-day utility for local merchants. Anomaly & Context Reporting: Identifying and documenting specific instances where models misinterpret business categories, service offerings, operational hours, or local market nuances. Required Expertise To successfully fulfill the deliverables of this project, Contractors must possess direct operational experience and verified digital storefront assets. items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY Storyblok is hiring a Salesforce Lead to own Salesforce architecture, execution, governance, data quality, integrations, and release discipline across our GTM workflows. This techno-functional owner moves from business process to system design, build coordination, release control, data quality, reporting impact, and user adoption, owning Sales Cloud and core CRM objects, Pardot / Account Engagement, DealHub CPQ integration, lead-to-cash and quote-to-cash workflows, routing, campaign and lifecycle data, permissions, integrations, and documentation. The role also leads future platform evaluation for Salesforce Data 360, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced, Adobe Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, and related CDP needs, and, if a platform is selected, leads implementation planning and execution with RevOps, Marketing Operations, Data, Finance, Legal, vendors, and external partners. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Salesforce architecture and GTM systems governance Own Salesforce platform architecture across GTM workflows, objects, fields, permissions, automations, integrations, and release control. Translate RevOps, Marketing Operations, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Data requirements into clean system design and controlled execution. Maintain governance for new fields, objects, flows, validation rules, permission sets, integrations, reporting dependencies, and documentation. Sales Cloud and core CRM ownership Own system design for leads, contacts, accounts, opportunities, activities, campaigns, lifecycle stages, routing, renewals, expansions, and customer handoffs. Support lead-to-cash workflows with clear ownership, required fields, source logic, stage rules, assignment logic, and adoption checks. Monitor CRM completeness, data freshness, duplicates, routing failures, and workflow friction that creates manual workarounds. Pardot, Account Engagement, and marketing workflow support Partner with Marketing Operations on Pardot or Account Engagement, campaign data, lifecycle stages, scoring inputs, consent, routing, attribution support, and funnel reporting. Maintain the Salesforce-side architecture for marketing-to-sales handoffs, campaign member data, source fields, conversion logic, and reporting quality. Keep current marketing workflows stable while future marketing cloud and CDP options are evaluated. Future Data 360, SFMC Advanced, Adobe, Oracle, and CDP evaluation Lead the requirements, scorecard, architecture review, vendor comparison, data governance review, and implementation readiness plan for future customer data and marketing cloud decisions. Evaluate Salesforce Data 360, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Advanced, Adobe Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, and related CDP needs against GTM use cases, data model, activation, consent, reporting, integration, cost, and operating complexity. If a platform is selected, lead implementation planning and execution with clear phases, owners, risks, testing, migration, enablement, and adoption metrics. DealHub CPQ integration, data quality, releases, and adoption Own Salesforce-side integration quality for DealHub CPQ, including quote data, approval sync, product lines, opportunity fields, order handoffs, and reporting impact. Run release management with intake, solution design, testing, regression checks, deployment, communication, documentation, and adoption tracking. Partner with Data on source-to-report logic so Salesforce, warehouse, Finance, and leadership reporting stay aligned. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 6+ years in the Salesforce ecosystem, including hands-on administration and solution / architecture ownership in a GTM or Revenue Operations context. Salesforce certifications strongly preferred (e.g., Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder; Sales Cloud Consultant or Application Architect a plus). Hands-on experience with Sales Cloud, core CRM objects, declarative automation (Flow), permissions, and release / change management across environments. Experience with Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement and marketing-to-sales workflows, and with CPQ tools (DealHub or comparable) across lead-to-cash and quote-to-cash. Experience integrating Salesforce with downstream systems (data warehouse, Finance, marketing, order management) and supporting reporting and data quality. Familiarity with CDP / marketing cloud platform evaluation (e.g., Salesforce Data 360, SFMC Advanced, Adobe, Oracle Responsys) is a plus. Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES Systems thinking: translates cross-functional business requirements into clean, scalable system design and governance. Technical CRM depth: strong command of Salesforce architecture, data model, automation, permissions, and integrations. Release and change discipline: structured intake, testing, regression, deployment, documentation, and adoption tracking. Data quality and governance orientation: drives completeness, freshness, deduplication, and field control. Stakeholder management: partners effectively across RevOps, Marketing Operations, Sales, CS, Finance, Data, Legal, and vendors. Vendor and platform evaluation: builds requirements, scorecards, and implementation readiness plans for major platform decisions. Clear communication: explains what is being built, the decision needed, and the business outcome to technical and non-technical audiences. Bias for reliability: reduces defects, manual workarounds, and ambiguity through documentation and controlled execution. U.S. Base Salary Range: $102,900 - $140,000 At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. For some roles Storyblok also offers a competitive commission structure. MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ). items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you. Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly. Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product. As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product. You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions. With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results. You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries. Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration. You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central. Twikey offers you: An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first. The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room. An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel! A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere. A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine. Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed! A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower. items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems , the company behind WPML , Toolset , and PTC , we’re looking for an experienced Head of Content and Editorial who knows what makes content great and can take ownership of content quality and performance. AI is a core part of how we work . AI can already produce content quickly and efficiently. What we need is someone with the experience, strong editorial judgment, and intuition to turn AI-generated content into high-quality, valuable content that resonates with our readers and delivers real business results. We’re looking for someone who has experience working with a small team of skilled writers, setting high editorial standards, and making content successful. You should know what good writing looks like, understand why certain content works, and be able to improve it. What You’ll Work On Content strategy and editorial direction – identify what content we should create, for whom, and why. Content quality and editing – review, improve, and refine content to make it clear, engaging, accurate, and valuable. AI-assisted content creation – use AI tools and workflows to produce high-quality content efficiently while maintaining strong editorial standards. Content performance – track results, understand what makes content successful, and use data to improve it. Content experiments – test new ideas, formats, and approaches, learn from failures, and build on what works. Collaboration with marketing and product teams – understand our products, customers, and business goals to make sure our content supports them. What We’re Looking For You’ve managed small teams of skilled writers and know how to improve and maintain high content quality. You have excellent editing and copywriting skills. You can easily spot what works in content and what needs improvement. You know how to use AI effectively to create and edit content. You’re comfortable working with metrics and taking responsibility for content performance. You use data to understand what works and what doesn't. You have strong editorial intuition built through years of experience. You’re comfortable trying new ideas, making decisions, and checking the results. You’re curious and want to understand our products, customers, and business. You’re hands-on and independent. You can take ownership of your work without detailed instructions. You have experience with technology, software, SaaS, or technical content. We are especially interested in people who have spent years working in high-quality editorial environments, where great writing, strong editorial judgment, and measurable results are essential. We’re not looking for someone whose main experience is managing large volumes of low-quality content. We want someone who knows how to make good content exceptional. Why Join Us OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007 . WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide . You’ll have real ownership of our editorial direction, work closely with our CEO, marketing, and product teams, and help shape how we create high-quality content with AI. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and see the impact of your work through real results. We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life. If you have years of editorial experience, love great writing, and are excited about shaping the future of content with AI, we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-head-of-content-and-editorial

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, United States; San Francisco, California, United States About Checkr Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic. We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company . About the Role Truework, recently acquired by Checkr, provides access to crucial employment, income information and asset information needed for mortgage loans, apartment rentals, background checks, and more. We are disrupting a $5B+ industry, dominated by legacy incumbents and outdated processes, with a better product and intense customer focus. Within Checkr, Truework operates independently, allowing rapid iteration while also being able to leverage the strengths and assets from our core business. Think of it like joining a startup within a startup! As a Strategic Account Executive on the Truework team, you’ll help scale our impact across large national and regional lenders, with a primary focus on acquiring new clients to Truework Verification services. As automated verification services become a more common practice for lenders in how they run their operation, you’ll lead the charge in building and executing a more repeatable playbook to drive new customers who will grow with us for years to come. By deeply understanding their unique company challenges and goals, you will pair them with solutions that will help them reach their business objectives and innovate within their organizations. This role is ideal for a proven sales professional who: has experience selling transformational solutions to customers, where you can quickly identify and pattern map where and how the Truework solution can drive impact in a customer’s operation has experience identifying and building relationships with decision makers, business and technology influencers and users, closing 6- and 7-figure pursuits who thrives in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment— ready to help close the gap between the legacy solutions and processes lending teams are leaning on and their plans and intentions to deliver competitive and streamlined processes for consumers You will be an important part of an elite, professional, and rapidly growing cross-functional team that succeeds through collaboration, grit, and learning. What you’ll do Deliver Sales Excellence: Consistently achieve pipeline and revenue targets by applying modern sales techniques and processes to efficiently manage top of funnel engagement tactics and deal strategy and close processes Think outside-the-box to cultivate awareness of the Truework vision. Plan and execute targeted campaigns for your territory working with the marketing and partner teams to scale your coverage and build pipeline Partner with and guide the efforts of our internal team to support your accounts in pre-sales activities and in the deployment to execute on agreed upon account goals, strategies and tactics for growth Leverage analytics, case studies, past performance, and market intelligence to create a territory plan and craft your own target account strategies. Manage Account Relationships: Have an understanding of the lender’s operation and an ability to identify the varying use cases where verification services can drive impact Exhibit deep and up-to-date knowledge of our product portfolio in order to communicate the benefits of new features and enhancements Show proficiency in navigating buy team personas, with intentional activities for executive bridging and champion building Exhibit Industry- & Customer-specific Business Acumen: Actively understand each customer’s strategic growth plans, technology footprint, and corresponding technology strategy, internal challenges, and competitive landscape. Review public information (e.g., new executive appointments, earnings statements, press releases) for the company and its competitors to stay updated on key industry trends and issues impacting the prospect. Be equipped to identify and discover centers of value for lenders, and conduct analysis to quantify ROI and impact of our solution on their operation Be a good teammate Represent both market trends and client needs to the Executive and the Product teams to ensure we are both serving current needs well and evolving our products and portfolio to identify future client needs Show unparalleled grit - constantly experiment, be willing to pivot, and have resiliency regardless of the obstacles faced What you bring 5+ years of full-cycle sales experience, selling transformative technology solutions Experience closing new business accounts and building pipeline using modern marketing tactics Experience selling to EVPs, CXOs and end-users (in the same sales cycle) in both individual and team sales environments Ability to navigate large organizations’ political landscape to maintain and expand relationships at all levels General knowledge in common sales practices like MEDDPICC, Command of the Message (Force Management), Challenger, Power Selling, or others Excellent written and verbal communication skills - able to simplify complex topics in a friendly and approachable manner, present executive-level business cases Ability to juggle and complete multiple priorities and projects (internally and externally) in a fast-paced environment You are smart, self-motivated, organized, disciplined, inquisitive, detail-oriented, and process-oriented; you have an ownership mentality within all aspects of your work You have a growth mindset that is always learning, growing, and actively seeking feedback You have a team-first mentality—you show up for your team and expect the same in return. You enjoy planning, adjusting, executing, winning, and celebrating as a team. An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes. Pay Transparency Disclosure We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website . On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (San Francisco, CA) $298,642 — $351,343 USD Pay Transparency Disclosure One of Checkr’s core values is Transparency. To live by that value, we’ve made the decision to disclose salary ranges in all of our job postings. We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see our website . On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (Remote) $229,724 — $351,343 USD What We Offer A fast-paced and collaborative environment Learning and development allowance Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage Up to $25K reimbursement for fertility, adoption, and parental planning services Flexible PTO policy Monthly wellness stipend At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. A relocation stipend may be available for those willing to relocate to a Checkr hub location. Equal Employment Opportunities at Checkr Checkr is committed to building the best product and company, which requires hiring talented and qualified individuals with a diverse set of perspectives and lived experiences. Checkr believes in hiring people of all backgrounds, including those whose histories are impacted by the justice system in accordance with local, state, and/or federal laws, including the San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance . Applicant Privacy Policy If you are a California resident or are located in Alberta or British Columbia, our Applicant Privacy Policy applies to our collection and processing of your personal information when you apply for a role with us or otherwise participate in our recruitment process. For applicants in Massachusetts: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. *Legitimate Checkr emails will always include our official domain name after the @ symbol (e.g., name@checkr.com or name@ext.checkr.com ). To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/checkr-strategic-account-executive

About Tailscale Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital. About the Role Tailscale is looking for an experienced Brand Designer to help bring our brand to life across every customer touchpoint. You'll create thoughtful, high-quality creative that helps people understand our products, builds trust with technical audiences, and supports some of our most important marketing initiatives. This role reports to the Team Lead and partners closely with Brand, Growth, Web, Content, Product Marketing, and Developer Relations. You'll own projects from concept through execution, contribute to the evolution of our design systems, and help us scale creative output without sacrificing quality. We're looking for someone who cares deeply about craft, thrives in collaborative environments but is able to work autonomously while requiring minimal direction, and enjoys solving complex communication problems through thoughtful design. Key Responsibilities Own brand design projects from creative brief through final delivery with limited guidance Design high-quality creative assets across web, campaigns, events, social media, presentations, product marketing, and internal communications Apply and thoughtfully extend Tailscale's visual identity across new formats and channels Create reusable templates, design systems, and creative processes that improve consistency and efficiency Partner closely with Growth, Web, Product Marketing, Content, and Developer Relations to deliver cohesive customer experiences Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders and thoughtfully incorporate feedback Balance multiple projects while consistently delivering polished, production-ready work Contribute ideas that improve the quality, scalability, and effectiveness of our creative work What We Are Looking For 3+ years of professional experience in brand, marketing, or visual design Strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional design foundations: color theory, accessibility, typography, layout, and storytelling Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud Experience designing for digital marketing, websites, campaigns, and brand systems Strong understanding of production-ready design across digital and print Excellent communication and presentation skills Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities with minimal oversight Experience collaborating cross-functionally with marketers, writers, developers, and other designers Strong attention to detail with a high bar for quality and consistency Comfortable giving and receiving constructive design feedback Actively seeks opportunities to refine processes, improve project organization, and make collaboration more effective through thoughtful recommendations. Curious by nature, with a desire to learn about the technical world of networking. Nice to Have Experience designing for B2B SaaS or developer-focused products Familiarity with design systems and component libraries Motion design or animation experience Illustration or icon design experience Basic understanding of HTML/CSS and web design constraints Experience supporting experimentation, conversion optimization, or growth marketing initiatives Experience working in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments Experience art-directing or mentoring junior designers As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set. US Pay Range $117,750 — $153,000 USD What We Offer An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life. A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles). Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family! Remote first company —most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description. Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation. Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration. Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities. Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world! A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own. Paid parental leave program . We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents). Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter. Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people. Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit https://tailscale.com/scam-awareness . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/tailscale-brand-designer-1

items.summary: Headquarters: Remote - US Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solution
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote - US Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work. Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless. That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses. We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it. As a Corporate Account Executive, you’ll work with a portfolio of SMB and Mid-Market customers across a wide range of verticals and industries. That means the best outcomes rarely come from running a standard playbook. We need someone who finds that energizing, someone curious enough to understand how a complex organization actually operates, disciplined enough to orchestrate complex,multi-threaded sales cycles, and resourceful enough to bring the right people in at the right moment. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning an initial opportunity into a strategic relationship, navigating increasingly complex deals, and finding new ways for Airtable to create value across an organization, you’ll thrive here. We hire Corporate AEs with growth in mind: you’ll get the exposure, coaching, and increasing deal complexity you need to ramp quickly toward becoming an Enterprise Account Executive. What you'll do Turn Airtable’s large self-service user base into new business, using existing adoption and proven use cases to uncover and develop high-potential opportunities. Build relationships with leaders across functions and industries, understanding what matters to them and finding opportunities to expand Airtable’s impact as their organizations grow. Own and prioritize your book of business, developing thoughtful account plans and finding your way from an initial champion to stakeholders across the organization. Lead complex sales cycles from first conversation through close, bringing in Customer Success, Solution Engineering, and other partners at the right moments to move opportunities forward. Become a trusted advisor to prospects: understand their business objectives and bring Airtable’s flexibility to life through compelling use cases that show how the platform can solve their problems and transform the way their teams work. Who you are You bring 1-3 years of quota-carrying closing experience at a technology company You’ve successfully closed deals with mid-market and larger organizations (50-3,000 FTEs), with a track record of hitting or exceeding your sales goals. You can run a structured sales process (e.g., Force Management) with rigor and self-awareness. You know where your deals stand, what needs to happen next, and which stakeholders to bring in at the right moments to move them forward. You’re a strong communicator and relationship builder. You build credibility with business leaders and executives, develop the trust needed to move opportunities forward, and create alignment across g stakeholders at each stage of the sales lifecycle. You’re an adaptable seller. You’re comfortable moving across industries, use cases, and buyer personas, and you know how to make your approach relevant to each. What we offer Compensation awarded to successful candidates will vary based on their work location, relevant skills and experience. The on-target earnings range for this role is $182,800 to $238,100 for all office and remote locations. Our total compensation package also includes the opportunity to receive benefits and may include incentive compensation. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit offerings, please check out Life at Airtable . Airtable is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and strive to create a workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any characteristic protected by applicable federal and state laws, regulations and ordinances. Learn more about your EEO rights as an applicant . VEVRAA-Federal Contractor If you have a medical condition, disability, or religious belief/practice which inhibits your ability to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please complete our Accommodations Request Form and let us know how we may assist you. Airtable is committed to participating in the interactive process and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants. Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Airtable’s collection and use of personal data relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here . For applicants that live in or have a link to Australia, please see this Privacy Collection Statement for details regarding Airtable's collection and use of personal data relating to the application and recruitment process. Stay Safe from Job Scams: All official Airtable communication will come from an @airtable.com email address. We will never ask you to share sensitive information or purchase equipment during the hiring process. If in doubt, contact us at hr@airtable.com . Learn more about avoiding job scams here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/airtable-account-executive-corporate

That programme took the brand to over a billion views a month and the 13th most-mentioned fashion brand on TikTok UK, and put thousands of creators on contract. We have now launched it as a business
items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Wyoming, United States URL: http://orchard.co About Orchard 'Orchard' began as the in-house creator programme behind 'In Print We Trust'. That programme took the brand to over a billion views a month and the 13th most-mentioned fashion brand on TikTok UK, and put thousands of creators on contract. We have now launched it as a business in its own right, selling guaranteed organic views with product placement to brands. This is how brands grow now. Celsius, Bloom, Cal AI and Polymarket became big because thousands of creators had the product in their videos at the same time. The business is at multi six-figures in its first month operating from inbound. You'll build the sales side from scratch: pipeline, pricing, contracts, the first hires. About the role What brands buy is simple: a number of views, at one CPM, guaranteed. You'll take the machine and find every way it can be sold. Some we can see: white-label it to agencies; sell it to labels as sound seeding; sell it to retailers and CPG brands as launch momentum; sell managed supply to creator platforms in the markets they can't cover. Some we can't see, and that's where you step in. Perhaps you've got a way in at an AI lab that buys creator footage by the thousand hours, or another channel we aren't even aware of yet. This is a high-ownership opportunity to build/run sales/growth. So you need to have built revenue from a standing start before, at an agency, a platform or your own company, and have hired and run people who sell. Requirements You MUST be DTC/ecommerce/Meta native. You are comfortable being first: no marketing team, no SDR, a product whose packaging you will change. You have extreme agency and can be scrappy/inventive. You've personally closed $100K+ sized deals with agencies, brands or platforms, and you've hired or managed people who sell. Experience selling to SaaS, ecommerce, DTC, retail and founder-led companies. You know the UK and US agency and creator world well enough to get 20 meetings from your own contacts in month one. items.description: Company Overview ActiveProspect is on a mission to make consent-based marketing the best channel for online customer acquisition. We provide marketers the products they need to acquire qualified customers at scale. Our platform is trusted by thousands of companies engaged in direct-to-consumer marketing, helping them save wasted spend, comply with ever-changing regulations, and manage a constantly evolving partner landscape. Our flagship product, TrustedForm, is used to certify over 1 billion opt-in digital customer leads every year and is the gold standard for documenting prior express written consent for TCPA compliance. Job Summary ActiveProspect is seeking an experienced Deal Desk / CPQ Consultant for a temporary, 3–4 month opportunity structured as a 1099 independent contractor. This individual will partner closely with Sales and cross-functional teams to identify and troubleshoot issues, validate system functionality, and ensure CPQ workflows align with business requirements. The ideal candidate combines hands-on CPQ expertise with practical Deal Desk experience and will play a key role in improving quoting accuracy and efficiency, streamlining deal execution, and supporting scalable sales operations. Responsibilities: Test and validate Zuora CPQ functionality, including quoting, pricing, approvals, and deal configurations. Identify issues, troubleshoot workflows, and recommend improvements. Partner with Sales and Deal Desk stakeholders to ensure CPQ processes align with business requirements. Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and document findings. Provide guidance on CPQ best practices and commercial workflows. Qualifications and Skills Hands-on CPQ and Deal Desk experience Strong commercial background, with experience working directly with Sales teams to understand deal structures, quoting, pricing, approvals and business needs Experience supporting CPQ testing, implementation, or optimization B2B SaaS experience strongly preferred, particularly with subscription-based pricing and recurring revenue Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with sales-facing teams Benefits and Perks Fully remote opportunity with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the U.S. Short-term, project-based engagement lasting approximately 3–4 months Collaborative and supportive team environment This is a 1099 independent contractor opportunity and does not include traditional employee benefits such as health insurance, paid time off, or retirement plan contributions. ActiveProspect is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

items.description: Company Description M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems. Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements. Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA. Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Senior Vice President of Market Research at M3 MR , an M3 company. About the Business Unit: M3 MR, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide. M3 MR maintains ISO 26362 and ISO 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors. Job Description The Senior Vice President of Marketing will lead and evolve M3 MR Group’s global marketing strategy to accelerate revenue growth, strengthen the Group’s position as a trusted healthcare market research and insights partner, and support continued expansion across regions, panels, solutions, and operating brands. items.summary: About the role We are hiring a contract B2B2C Marketing Lead to design and execute resource-efficient, high-converting digital campaigns that drive measurable resident enrollment in Summer’s city and state programs. We are seeking a resourceful, data-informed marketer whose primary mission is to turn complex, free benefits into clear digital campai
items.description: About the role We are hiring a contract B2B2C Marketing Lead to design and execute resource-efficient, high-converting digital campaigns that drive measurable resident enrollment in Summer’s city and state programs. We are seeking a resourceful, data-informed marketer whose primary mission is to turn complex, free benefits into clear digital campaigns that drive active resident sign-ups and usage. You will own the strategy for each launch, from initial announcements through sustained digital enrollment campaigns. You will test new channels and establish end-to-end campaign credibility—leveraging official government co-branding, clear privacy assurances, verified referral paths, and credible local messengers—while continuously optimizing for completed conversions. While you will collaborate closely with Summer’s internal teams and our government partners’ communications staff, your primary focus is driving measurable resident participation in these critical programs. What you’ll do Build a go-to-market plan for each city or state launch, including audience segments, channel mix (including organic social, paid social, and paid search), budget, timeline, and enrollment targets. Concept, launch, and optimize high-converting multi-channel campaigns (paid/organic social, search, creator partnerships, guerrilla or non-traditional digital channels) across diverse populations. Develop human first messaging for distinct resident groups for deployment in targeted channels. Design co-branded campaigns with government partners and manage their review and approval process. Plan launch moments with our communications team, including announcement events, press outreach, and content from elected officials. Source and manage local creators and influencers who can speak credibly to residents. Cultivate a set of spokespeople from our users and partners for marketing purposes Set up tracking and reporting that ties spend to enrollments by channel, message, and geography, and share clear results with Summer leadership and government partners. Run every public claim through Summer’s compliance review so that nothing reads as financial advice or overstates results. What we’re looking for 6+ years of growth, digital, or B2B2C/B2C marketing experience with a proven track record of driving high-volume participation in a government sponsored benefit program or similarly complex, trust-sensitive service. Adjacent experience such as health plan facilitated benefits, financial assistance, or nonprofit services is highly relevant. A track record of resourceful campaign concepts, testing non-traditional formats, and finding innovative ways to engage audiences. Proven ability to build distribution through trusted partner ecosystems (e.g., government entities, institutional networks, employers, and community partners) while strategically deploying paid media and influencer channels (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Youtube, Search) to test, optimize, and scale participation. Ability to track conversion pathways from first touch to completed enrollment and translate performance data into actionable campaign pivots. You know how to make complex subjects (like finance or student loans) feel simple, accessible, and exciting to everyday consumers. Hands-on experience briefing, negotiating, and running performance-driven creator campaigns. Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder approval processes and working alongside partner or client teams. Nice to have Fintech, consumer finance, or student loan experience, particularly navigating advertising guidelines in regulated consumer spaces. Prior agency or startup experience launching brand-new programs or products into new regional markets. Existing relationships with community organizations, higher education institutions, or public sector communications teams. Engagement details and how to apply Type: Contract Hours: 15-25 hours per week (depending on phase of project roll out) Length: 3-6 month initial term, with the option to extend as more cities and states launch Location: Remote, United States. Occasional travel to partner launches and events.

items.description: Coinspaid Solutions is a fintech company building blockchain payment infrastructure for the global economy. We design, implement, and scale payment systems that connect digital assets with real-world financial operations. Our solutions help businesses and financial institutions operate efficiently in the evolving digital asset landscape. For over 11 years, we’ve been developing products that bring crypto payments closer to mainstream adoption. Today, our team includes 350+ professionals working remotely across multiple countries. We combine the pace of fintech with a long-term approach to building products, teams, and careers. As a remote-first company, we give people flexibility in how they work while maintaining strong collaboration and shared ownership across teams. 🏆 In 2026, Coinspaid was recognized as Best Corporate Culture in the Blockchain Industry in Europe, reflecting our focus on ownership, trust, and collaboration. We are looking for a Head of Accounting to lead the company’s accounting function, ensure accurate financial records, timely financial reporting, and compliance with regulatory requirements. The primary focus of this role is to manage accounting operations, lead the teams, automate processes, and improve overall efficiency. Responsibilities: Oversee and manage accounting operations across multiple legal entities and jurisdictions. Ensure timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing. Prepare financial statements in accordance with IFRS and local accounting standards. Oversee tax accounting and ensure compliance with applicable regulations. Manage account reconciliations, bank balances, and settlements with counterparties. Coordinate with external auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory authorities. Develop and implement accounting policies, internal controls, and procedures. Drive optimization and automation of accounting processes. Lead the accounting team, delegate responsibilities, and monitor performance. Collaborate with Finance, Treasury, Legal, Compliance, and Operations teams. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field. 7+ years of accounting experience, including at least 2 years in a leadership role. Strong knowledge of IFRS and financial reporting principles. Experience working with international companies and multiple legal entities. Solid understanding of tax regulations and audit procedures. Experience with ERP systems and accounting process automation. English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate level or higher. Nice to have: Experience in FinTech, Payments, Banking, or Crypto. Experience accounting for cryptocurrency and payment transactions. Professional qualifications such as ACCA, CPA, or CIMA. Why should you choose Coinspaid? You’ll be joining a company that is actively shaping its space – with enough scale to matter and enough room to make an impact. At Coinspaid, people are expected to think, contribute, and take ownership – and are supported in doing so. We focus on flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth – without overcomplicating how benefits work. Flexible Benefits Benefit Bar – up to €230/month A flexible monthly budget you can use for what matters most to you – from sports and mental health to coworking, home office, or medical-related expenses. Work & Flexibility Fully remote work from almost anywhere Optional offices and relocation support Flexible, async-friendly environment Growth & Learning Budget for courses, certifications, and professional development Language learning support Cross-team learning and knowledge sharing Wellbeing & Support Medical insurance or reimbursement depending on location Access to mental health support Financial support for important life events Extras Merch shop with rewards system Team offsites and company events Sounds good? Well then, we can’t wait to see your resume! To learn more please visit: https://coinspaid.com/about-us/ & https://coinspaid.com/careers/

items.description: DevOps and Sysadmin Headquarters: ignitionit.com URL: https://ignitionit.com Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first TL;DR ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role. We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you. What the actual job??? Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.” You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there. In a typical week, you might: Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless. Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with. Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing. Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone. Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline." ⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job. About ignitionit.com We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile! What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way. We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here. If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance. The tech you'll work with (and grow into) Day one, you'll be living in: Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more) Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends) Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling ⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open. Who we hope you are The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you: Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both) Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem Have at least 5 years of IT support experience on the job. ⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who: Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine) Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application) Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously Regarding AI Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive. Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you. Compensation & logistics Base salary: Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market. For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk. Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones. Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet. How to apply The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how: Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works. If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items. From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment. If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different? Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you! To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ignition-inc-msp-mac-help-desk-guru-work-from-home

They come to cultivate it. Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.
