items.title: Travel Expert | Reviewer
items.summary: We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants.
items.description: We’re recruiting Travel professionals and experienced trip planners to review and improve realistic travel scenarios used to train AI travel assistants. Your job isn’t to “write itineraries.” It’s to think like a real trip planner and spot what makes a travel situation real, feasible, and decision-changing — then upgrade weak scenarios so they actually test the model. ‼️ AI is not allowed. If we spot AI use, we’ll block the application. ⚠️ This application form must be completed entirely in English. 🚨 READ ALL THE DESCRIPTION BELOW TO UNDERSTAND THE APPLICATION FORM. WHO CAN APPLY Travel professionals and experienced trip planners 3+ years of relevant travel planning experience (professional or high-volume personal) English level: Advanced / Fluent (required) WHAT YOU’LL DO IN THE APPLICATION (QUICK SCREENING TEST) You will review two pre-generated travel tasks . For each task, you’ll answer simple 1–5 ratings and give a short justification. Then, for the 2nd task , you’ll rewrite it to make it stronger . WHAT “STRONG” MEANS (SIMPLE DEFINITION) A strong task includes one decisive feasibility constraint that can flip the plan if ignored (missed train, missed check-in, closed attraction, wrong station, etc.). We call this a Knife : A Knife is a constraint that changes what itinerary is actually viable . Quick test: if you remove it, the “best plan” would meaningfully change. Examples of Knives in Travel Last train / last entry / check-in cutoff times Closures and holidays that change what’s possible Ambiguous locations (airport/station names that can be confused) Sequential dependencies (if A slips, B becomes impossible) Mobility constraints that change routing feasibility WHAT YOU WILL RATE (1–5) IN THE FORM You’ll give 3 ratings per task: Overall Quality (1–5) How clear and testable the task is (can you judge PASS/FAIL)? Knife / Hidden Context Strength (1–5) Is there a decisive feasibility constraint — or is the “hidden context” just extra color that doesn’t change the plan? Checklist Quality (1–5) Does the checklist truly test feasibility + the Knife with clear criteria? (Strong checklists include verification steps and forbid inventing logistics, written as PASS/FAIL — not “be helpful.”) You’ll also write a short justification (2–4 bullets) explaining your ratings. WHAT YOU WILL REWRITE (FOR THE 2ND TASK ONLY) You will rewrite these parts to make the task stronger: Scenario (3rd person) — more realistic + naturally sets up the feasibility risk Prompt (user message) — natural, human, does not reveal the Knife Hidden Context (1–3 bullets) — must include exactly 1 decisive Knife Checklist (4–6 items) — each item must be PASS/FAIL, covering: feasibility/verification (minimum unknowns to check) the Knife (the decision-flipping constraint) no invented logistics (no made-up schedules/hours/availability) branching plan (Plan A / Plan B) when feasibility depends on one missing answer safety only when there is real risk Checklist item example: PASS if it flags what must be verified (tickets/hours/cutoffs) before committing; FAIL if it confidently invents times or availability. Important: Don’t “leak” the Knife in the prompt (no “IMPORTANT”, no all-caps, no “the key detail is…”). IF SELECTED (PROJECT WORK) You’ll review batches of pre-generated travel scenarios: Rating realism and feasibility risk Identifying weak or missing constraints (Knives) Improving tasks so they better represent real travel moments where wrong advice causes missed connections, wasted money, or ruined plans COMPENSATION Payment will be US$ 30 per approved task, converted and paid in your local currency. Each task takes approximately 40 minutes, which corresponds to an effective rate of about US$ 45 per hour. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR You can recognize what’s realistic vs. generic in travel planning You understand what truly flips feasibility (cutoffs, closures, dependencies, ambiguous locations) You can upgrade a “fine” scenario into a strong feasibility test without making it artificial Originally posted on Himalayas

Collaborate closely with developers, copywriters, and strategists to ensure alignment between design, messaging, and implementation Apply UX thinking, including user flows, journey mapping, and usability best practices to improve overall experience Ensure designs meet accessibility standards (WCAG) and maintain consistency across all breakpoints and devices Continuously optimize design workflows by incorporating AI tools and emerging design practices Skills & Qualifications Required Advanced proficiency in Figma 5+ years of web design experience Strong understanding of typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy Expertise in responsive design principles Experience designing for conversion and user experience (UX) Proficiency in Canva Pro, Photoshop Hands-on experience with WordPress and Elementor (must-have) Experience building design systems and component libraries Strong visual storytelling and layout structuring skills Preferred 5+ years of experience in an agency environment, working on global B2B/B2C/SaaS websites Strong grasp of UX principles, user flows, and conversion-focused design Proven ability to design high-performing website layouts and landing pages Experience collaborating with developers (WordPress or front-end teams) Strong attention to detail with clean file organization and handoff practices Nice to Have Familiarity with AI design workflows Working knowledge of HTML/CSS Experience with Adobe Creative Suite Exposure to tools like Relume or Framer Motion design, Lottie animations, or video editing skills Who You Are You bring 5+ years of experience backed by a strong, high-quality graphics & web design portfolio You understand how design influences attention, trust, and user behavior You can independently take projects from brief to execution You think beyond visuals - focusing on performance, conversion, and user flow You’re comfortable managing multiple projects in a fast-paced agency setup You maintain high standards for structure, clarity, and developer handoff Comfortable working with partial overlap in EST time zone for collaboration and client communication Why Join Us Work on diverse, high-impact projects across industries Be part of a performance-driven, growth-focused team Opportunity to shape creative direction and influence outcomes Collaborative environment with a strong focus on quality and accountability

items.title: Accounting and Implementation Manager
items.summary: Work with a Top 20 CPA and advisory firm that Accounts for Anything. Aprio has 40 U.S. office locations, as well as international office locations and more than 3,200 team members that speak 60+ languages across the globe. By bringing together proven expertise, deep understanding, and strategic foresight for fast-growing industries, Aprio ensures clients are prepared for wherever life or business may take them. Discover a top-rated culture, vast growth opportunities and your next big career move with Aprio. Aprio is seeking an Aprio is seeking an Accounting and Implementation Manager to lead restaurant, franchise, and hospitality platform implementations, re-implementations, and optimization initiatives that connect accounting, operations, and technology. In this role, you will partner with clients and our accounting team to translate complex accounting and operational needs into practical configurations, integrations, workflows, controls, reporting structures, and training across platforms including Restaurant365 (R365), QuickBooks Online (QBO), Sage Intacct, and other industry-specific tools. You will serve as a trusted technology resource across the practice â driving implementation quality, enabling team capability, and building a repeatable, scalable delivery model. Lead month-end and year-end close, using technology and automation where appropriate to improve consistency, identify exceptions, and accelerate routine work. Prepare and review complete, accurate, and well-supported workpapers that clearly document account activity, reconciliations, conclusions, and the audit trail supporting financial reporting. Why work for Aprio: Whether you are just starting out, looking to advance into management or searching for your next leadership role, Aprio offers an opportunity to grow with a future-focused, innovative firm. Perks/Benefits we offer for full-time team members: - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance on the first day of employment - Flexible Spending Account and Dependent Care Account - 401k with Profit Sharing - 9+ holidays and discretionary time off structure - Parental Leave â coverage for both primary and secondary caregivers - Tuition Assistance Program and CPA support program with cash incentive upon completion - Discretionary incentive compensation based on firm, group and individual performance - Incentive compensation related to origination of new client sales - Top rated wellness program - Flexible working environment including remote and hybrid options Whatâs in it for you: - Working with an industry leader : Be part of a high-growth firm that is passionate for whatâs next. - An awesome culture: Thirty-one fundamental behaviors guide our culture every day ensuring we always deliver an exceptional team-member and client experience. items.title: Project and Quality Administrator Work From Home Dayshift
items.summary: We are seeking a Project and Quality Administrator (Quality Systems) to provide project administration and data coordination support across multiple active projects. The role will maintain accurate project records, coordinate quality documentation, monitor outstanding tasks, prepare reports, and support audit readiness while working closely with internal teams to ensure project information remains complete, accurate, and up to date. Provide project administration and data coordination support across multiple active projects. Gather, maintain, and update project information, quality records, and supporting documentation. Manage project data and assigned tasks using Deltek, Jira, CRM, and other project management systems. Prepare and distribute reports, dashboards, and project performance information using available data. Monitor outstanding documentation, actions, deadlines, and quality requirements, proactively following up with stakeholders. Maintain accurate, complete, and auditable records to support quality assurance processes and audit readiness. Identify missing or inaccurate information, resolve discrepancies, escalate issues, and support continuous improvement of project workflows. Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in data coordination, project administration, project coordination, quality systems administration, or a similar role. Hands-on experience with Deltek is essential. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft 365, including data management, reporting, and documentation. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate with stakeholders and follow up on outstanding information. Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in maintaining project records, reports, and system data. Strong organisational, time-management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, tasks, and deadlines independently. Experience with Jira, CRM, or document management systems is desirable; a relevant bachelor's degree and exposure to construction or project delivery environments are advantageous. items.summary: At Luscii, we are creating space for care by building digital health applications that help people manage their health. Together with healthcare professionals around the world, we build technology that helps users receive the right care in the right place. Millions of people rely on
items.description: At Luscii, we are creating space for care by building digital health applications that help people manage their health. Applications such as the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with healthcare professionals around the world, we build technology that helps users receive the right care in the right place. Millions of people rely on our products every month, and behind every reliable healthcare experience is a cloud platform that simply works. As engineer working on our apps, you will play a vital role in modernising the cloud platform that powers the platform, creating a more reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide. OMRON Connect is one of the largest digital health platforms in our ecosystem, connecting millions of users with their healthcare data through OMRON devices. Much of the platform has grown over many years and was partly built by external partners. Today, we're investing heavily in bringing that knowledge, ownership and technical excellence in-house. This is not about replacing everything overnight. It is about making thoughtful engineering decisions, modernising step by step, and building a cloud platform that gives our engineering teams the foundations, tooling and confidence they need to deliver safely and independently. Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of a platform serving several million monthly active users across the world. You will help shape our cloud and engineering standards, introduce modern practices where they genuinely add value, and make Infrastructure as Code, observability and safe continuous delivery the default rather than the exception. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Along the way, you will collaborate with engineers, influence technical direction and leave the platform in a significantly better state than you found it. Your role You will become one of the technical driving forces behind the cloud platforms that power our digital health applications. Working closely with fellow engineers, product teams and colleagues across countries, you will help shape and improve our cloud infrastructure, strengthen the developer experience and ensure reliability, security and scalability are built into the foundations of our technology. Your exact focus will evolve with the needs of our teams and the opportunities you identify to make a lasting impact. This is a role for someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems without chasing complexity for complexity's sake. You will help us balance innovation with pragmatism, modernising a live healthcare platform while maintaining the stability that patients and healthcare professionals depend on every day. What you will be doing, among others: Design, build and evolve our AWS platform using Terraform as the single source of truth, while driving the gradual modernisation of our cloud landscape; Build reusable infrastructure, deployment pipelines and platform tooling that enable engineering teams to ship independently and safely; Introduce pragmatic cloud-native and event-driven solutions where they genuinely improve scalability, reliability and maintainability; Make observability a default through standardised monitoring, logging, dashboards and alerting across the platform; Improve deployment practices with automated CI/CD, progressive delivery and reliable rollback strategies; Embed security, compliance and cost optimisation into the platform through automated guardrails and best practices; Coach fellow engineers, review infrastructure and application code, and raise the overall cloud engineering bar through collaboration and example. The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together. Why Luscii? Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH ; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better. Most important benefits Salary : Naturally, this depends on your background, experience, and relevant expertise. You may think of a maximum salary of approximately €86.000,- to €94.000,- per year for this position. Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii . Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. The ideal candidate… … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way. You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust. You have at least 6 years of experience building and operating large-scale cloud platforms, with deep hands-on AWS expertise and including the same amount of experience in senior-level ownership of modern cloud architectures; You have extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and treat infrastructure with the same rigour as application code; You have a strong understanding of cloud-native, serverless and event-driven architectures, and the judgement to apply them pragmatically; You know how to build reliable production systems with observability, automated deployments and safe release practices built in; You enjoy modernising legacy platforms through incremental improvements rather than big-bang rewrites, while bringing others along in the process; You have strong backend engineering experience, preferably with Node.js and TypeScript; You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities; English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language. Interested? Apply now! Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via What does the recruitment process look like? We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum. Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

items.title: Business Operations Manager
items.summary: About MonetizeMoreMonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally.
items.description: About MonetizeMore MonetizeMore is a global pioneer in ad technology, powering ad monetization for over 150,000 websites and apps globally. We combine proprietary technology with sophisticated optimization strategies to secure and maximize publisher revenue. We are a 100% remote, culture-first organization driven by four core values: Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen (Continuous Improvement), and Collaboration . We empower our global team with absolute location autonomy and flexible global schedules. We care about the impact you deliver, not the hours you log on. About the Role The company is seeking an experienced, systems-driven Business Operations Manager to transform informal workflows into owned, structured, and scalable operational systems. As the primary connective layer across departments, this role focuses on process kaizen, SOP governance, and end-to-end operational enablement—ensuring teams execute efficiently without reinventing processes. The Business Operations Manager will manage the central project management infrastructure and partner directly with Product and executive leadership. Key responsibilities include preparing cross-functional teams for product launches, streamlining enterprise client workflows, and establishing organization-wide standards for accountability and visibility. As a data- and AI-fluent operator, the candidate will design structured spreadsheet models, integrate AI tools to accelerate documentation, and continuously optimize reporting systems. Core Responsibilities 1. Process Kaizen & SOP Governance Run a continuous improvement cadence across the process landscape; killing, combining, or improving SOPs weekly. Own the process vault and ensure every process is signed off by its owner and governed for adoption, not just documented. 2. Project Management & Visibility Own and maintain BE's project management tracker; ensuring all projects, to-dos, and tickets are tracked, visible, and actioned. Drive adoption beyond BE, building the foundation for a company-wide model with long-term integration into BL L10s. 3. Product Rollout Support Support product release processes, structuring the operational side of launches so teams are enabled ahead of go-live. Work closely with the incoming Group PM to formalize this process as a repeatable model. 4. Cross-Departmental & Enterprise Client Enablement Act as an operational connective layer across business lines and enterprise client workflows; surfacing blockers, coordinating data and documentation needs, and keeping cross-functional commitments visible and actioned. 5. Data & Spreadsheet Management Own data pulls and spreadsheet-based reporting for BE initiatives; Building and maintaining structured, reliable models that others can use without re-deriving logic. Comfort with formulas, structured data, and dashboard hygiene is core to the role, not incidental. Who You Are The Experienced Operator: You have 4+ years of experience in a process, project management, or business operations role. Ad tech, SaaS, high-data-volume or WordPress ecosystem experience is a plus, as is experience working with Salesforce (SFDC). The Systems Builder: You default to structure, and you know the difference between owning a process and doing the work inside it. Given a messy or untracked workstream, your instinct is to define ownership, standardize steps, and build the scaffolding (trackers, SOPs, cadences) that lets other functions execute reliably. Data- and AI-Fluent: You're comfortable pulling, cleaning, and structuring data in spreadsheets without hand-holding, and you've used AI tools in your actual workflow to speed up documentation and process work. Comfortable with Ambiguity: You can walk into an undefined workstream, ask the right questions, and leave it with clear ownership and a repeatable process. Direct Communicator: You flag problems early and plainly. You don't let a stalled ticket or an unsigned SOP sit quietly. What We Offer True Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world with an flexible schedule that fits your lifestyle. Professional Development: Continuous opportunities for career growth, learning allowances, and direct impact on a fast growing company. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Chief Financial Officer
items.summary: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!
items.description: We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process! About the role The CFO’s mission is to continue building upon Grüns ' already strong finance and data function — evolving it into a best-in-class engine that empowers the entire organization to make faster, smarter decisions. Leading a team of three strong leaders, this role is about leading the strong teams below them to democratize financial intelligence across the Grüns organization: self-serve dashboards, on-demand reporting, and real-time visibility that puts decision-making power in the hands of every team member. The CFO is a relentless, collaborative business partner, never satisfied with where the business is on revenue scale or profitability, always pushing for the next point of EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and driving efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. They will ensure Grüns scales with confidence while meeting all external requirements seamlessly in the background. This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL. What success looks like: If we look ahead a year from now, the right person in this role would have: Leveraged what we’ve built so far, found areas for improvement, and fully operationalized a goal accountability framework that keeps business initiatives tied to financial outcomes, ensuring the leadership team is consistently tracking toward revenue and profitability targets. Driven meaningful EBITDA margin improvement across all functions and improved LTV:CAC efficiency to fuel continued revenue growth. Delivered self-serve dashboards, templatized reporting, and real-time P&L visibility across functions so every team has the data access they need without relying on ad-hoc requests. Business decisions are democratized and exponentially quicker. Created the conditions for a high-performing, motivated team empowering vs. micromanaging, actively developing leaders, and driving strong results and performance without burnout. Built the systems and processes to meet all external reporting and compliance requirements seamlessly, keeping the team focused on growth. We're looking for someone with: Relentless Growth Mindset: Always asking what it takes to get to the next level, whether that's another point of margin, better efficiency, or a faster path to revenue growth - a genuine internal drive to make the business the best it can be. Finding new opportunities across the business and proposing these opportunities to the CEO and functional leads. Integrity and Business-First Thinking: Prioritizes the truth over “looking good”. Navigates competing stakeholder interests honestly and thoroughly rather than taking the path of least resistance. Empowering Leadership: Leads by giving people the tools, clarity, and confidence to make great decisions vs. controlling the work directly. Actively develops their functional leaders, makes their team better than they were before. Drives sustainable high performance. Paper Wall Pusher: Treats perceived constraints as hypotheses, not facts. When told something takes six weeks or "this is how it's done," they ask why and push for faster, smarter, or different. Actively hunts for process bloat and inherited ways of working to find improvements. AI-Native Operator: Uses AI natively in their own workflow and actively builds AI fluency into the team's operating model. Sees AI as a core lever for scaling the function's impact without scaling headcount. Direct, but kind: Direct and honest in every conversation, saying what needs to be said, even when it's uncomfortable. Deeply committed to the business and the people in it. Experience: 10+ years leadership experience in a high-growth, profitable businesses; some level of physical inventory experience (CPG, retail, e-commerce, or similar) is a must Experience leading the functions in scope - finance, accounting, data, and BizOps functions Experience within a high-growth company that is adapting to public company practices Compensation & Benefits: At Grüns , we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package — grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary is $350,000 + incentive compensation, paired with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. A bit about us... At Grüns , we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you. Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all. So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious. What we care about... Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation. Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners. Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most. Compensation & Perks: For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth. Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns subscriptions, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Liquidity Operations Analyst
items.summary: Work with the bestWe are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms.
items.description: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network What will you be working on? Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability. Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms. Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner. Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables. Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes. Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models. Who will you be working with? Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution. Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency. Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations. What challenges will you face? Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements. Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment. Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously. Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well. items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote - United States About Vercel: Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. items.description: We believe that mental health is just as important as physical health. We recognize that mental health issues can be complex and multifaceted, and we are dedicated to treating the whole person, not just the symptoms. We aim to create a world where mental health is no longer stigmatized or marginalized, but rather is embraced as an integral part of one’s overall well-being. We believe that by providing quality care that is both evidence-based and compassionate, we can empower individuals to take charge of their mental health and achieve their full potential. We are passionate about making a positive impact on the lives of those struggling with mental health issues and we strive to be a force for positive change in the field of mental healthcare. Rula is a remote-first company. We currently hire in most U.S. states, with the exception of Hawaii. About the Role We are seeking a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to help build and scale a best-in-class communications program at Rula. You’ll lead the development and execution of multi-channel lifecycle strategies (email, SMS + push) to help make mental healthcare work for everyone. . You’ll work independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams to create an intelligent, personalized lifecycle program, refine our reporting and analytics capabilities, and expand our test-and-learn program to continuously improve patient and provider engagement. This role may work in both our B2B and D2C parts of the organization, improving the speed and quality of patient access to mental healthcare, and ensuring providers in our network are set up for success to provide that care. We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, is a fierce collaborator, has a bias for action, and brings exceptional organization, customer focus, and attention to detail to everything they do. If you’re excited about using data-driven strategies to make a meaningful impact in mental healthcare, we’d love to hear from you! Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in a lifecycle or retention marketing role, with a proven track record of creating and executing effective lifecycle strategies, driving program growth and meaningful business results through multi-channel campaigns. Both D2C and B2B experience is welcome, with a slight bias towards D2C experience. Hands-on experience with enterprise-level ESPs (Iterable and Hubspot preferred), including the ability to set up, automate, and optimize campaigns, journeys, experiments, dynamic content, and segmentation. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, run A/B tests, and make data-driven decisions to improve campaign performance. Excellent project management skills, capable of managing multiple campaigns and initiatives simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail. Preferred Qualifications While having the preferred qualifications enhances your candidacy, having all of them is not mandatory. We encourage all interested applicants to apply, even those who may not meet every preferred requirement. Exceptional communication skills, able to convey complex strategies clearly and collaborate effectively across teams like Product, Engineering, Operations, Support, and others. Self-starter with excellent organizational skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Experience working in a healthcare, mental health, or marketplace environment. 1+ years experience at a high-growth start-up. Experience with more complex lifecycle programming like HTML or SQL. Experience using BI tools (preferably Looker and Amplitude). We’re serious about your well-being! As part of our team, full-time employees receive: 100% remote work environment: Working hours to support a healthy work-life balance, ensuring you can meet both professional and personal commitments (must be based in United States, currently not hiring in Hawaii) Attractive pay and benefits : Full transparency of pay ranges regardless of where you live in the United States Comprehensive health benefits : Medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and FSA/HSA 401(k) plan access : Start saving for your future Generous time-off policies : Including 2 company-wide shutdown weeks each year for self-care (for most employees) Paid parental leave : Available for all parents, including birthing, non-birthing, adopting, and fostering Employee Assistance Program (EAP) : Supporting your mental and physical health Quarterly department stipend : Fun team-building activities or in-person gatherings Community and employee resource groups : Participate in groups that celebrate employee identity and lived experiences, fostering a sense of community and belonging for all Home office stipend: New hire home office stipend & $50 monthly stipend to help cover internet or cell phone expenses Wellness at Rula program: Year-round wellness initiatives and a $50/month wellness stipend Our team We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion are fundamental to our mission of making mental healthcare work for everyone. We are dedicated to having a culture of inclusion that will support our employees in feeling safe, seen, heard, and valued.

items.title: Risk Operations Analyst - SSO
items.summary: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
items.description: Who we are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Strategic Supportability Operations (SSO) sits within Risk Operations and User Policy Operations. Our team is focused on protecting and advancing Stripe 's business, brand, and mission by deploying industry-leading supportability solutions that instill user and partner trust in Stripe , while enabling progressive and sustainable business growth. Unlike other Risk Operations teams, SSO handles the most complex, high-stakes, and ambiguous user business cases—ones that require deep investigation, custom risk analysis, and creative problem-solving at the intersection of user experience, compliance, financial partner requirements, and Stripe 's growth ambitions. What you’ll do As a Risk Operations Analyst on the Strategic Supportability Operations team, you will investigate and assess complex, gray-area user business cases that require deep risk judgment and tailored solutions. You will go beyond standard procedures to understand the full risk profile of users, develop custom recommendations, and collaborate across internal teams to drive cohesive, well-reasoned decisions. You will also play a key role in identifying patterns across individual cases to improve our processes, policies, and detection systems at scale—bridging tactical case work with strategic, systemic impact across Risk Operations. Responsibilities Investigate complex, high-risk, and gray-area user business cases, applying deep risk knowledge to make sound, non-binary judgments Navigate ambiguity confidently—develop custom, evidence-based solutions where standard frameworks do not fully apply Identify and escalate systemic trends across cases, proposing scalable solutions to cross-functional stakeholders Collaborate across Risk Operations, User Support, Risk Partnerships, Legal, Compliance, and Product to develop holistic risk mitigation strategies Engage directly with users—in both positive and sensitive conversations—always maintaining a Users First mindset while balancing regulatory and financial partner requirements Communicate complex risk findings clearly to internal partners, financial partners, and Stripe leadership Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of SSO processes, decision frameworks, and tooling Build and maintain documentation, procedures, and playbooks to support team scalability and knowledge management Identify gaps in current systems, policies, and strategies and recommend enhancements through a collaborative approach with stakeholders Who you are We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements 5+ years of experience in risk management, compliance, fraud, financial operations, or a closely related field in a fast-moving environment Demonstrated ability to navigate gray-area and non-binary decision-making in complex risk environments Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, with the ability to synthesize multiple data sources into a coherent risk narrative Experience collaborating cross-functionally on complex problems and driving alignment across teams with competing priorities Ability to engage directly with users—including in difficult or sensitive conversations—with empathy, clarity, and professionalism Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to articulate complex risk findings to varied audiences Comfort with ambiguity and fast-paced, constantly evolving environments Track record of identifying systemic problems from individual case patterns and driving process improvements Deep empathy for entrepreneurs and businesses, and genuine motivation to solve problems that empower them The ability and desire to challenge the status quo as a creative thinker who considers problems from a user perspective while being pragmatic and solutions-oriented Preferred requirements Familiarity with compliance or financial partnership relationship management Experience with risk assessment and mitigation strategies in a fintech or payments environment Working knowledge of data analysis and AI tools to quantify risk & inform decisions Background in regulatory compliance within financial services Experience developing scalable operational frameworks or playbooks in an ambiguous, high-stakes environment Knowledge of payment processing systems and associated risks Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: Vice President, Public Relations (Health)
items.summary: WHO WE ARE The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years.
items.description: WHO WE ARE The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month. Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for, and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result. Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment. We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us. THE ROLE We are seeking an accomplished and strategic leader to join the team as a Vice President, Health. This role requires a seasoned professional with deep expertise in the healthcare industries, outstanding communication skills, and a proven track record in client management and team leadership. As the Vice President, you will spearhead PR initiatives for our clients, lead thought leadership, drive business growth, and deliver impactful results that enhance their reputation and visibility in the market. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Leadership: Provide visionary leadership and strategic direction for the health and lifestyle industries, guiding team members to achieve excellence and drive results. Client Management: Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with healthcare clients, serving as the primary point of contact and ensuring delivery of high-quality PR services. Strategy Development: Develop comprehensive PR strategies tailored to each client's objectives and target audience, leveraging industry knowledge and market insights. Campaign Execution: Oversee the implementation of PR campaigns, including media relations, thought leadership initiatives, crisis communications, and executive visibility programs. Team Management: Lead, mentor, and empower a team of PR professionals specializing in health and lifestyle services, fostering a collaborative and supportive work environment. Media Relations: Build and maintain relationships with key health and lifestyle contacts, securing impactful placements in top-tier outlets and healthcare publications. Thought Leadership: Position clients as industry thought leaders through strategic content development, speaking opportunities, and participation in relevant industry events and conferences. Crisis Communications: Develop and implement crisis communication plans to safeguard clients' reputation and mitigate reputational risks in the event of crises or negative publicity. Performance Analysis: Monitor and analyze campaign performance metrics, providing insights and recommendations for optimization and continuous improvement. WHAT YOU'LL OWN IN YEAR ONE Own the practice's account management rhythm with structured weekly business reviews, account health scoring, and proactive risk identification across the existing client book Bring practice-level retention into the top quartile of the firm through tight service delivery, fast time-to-value on new accounts, and structured save-the-account interventions where necessary Develop and execute 5+ recurring expansion plays within the existing client base, building toward 1.5–2% monthly MRR expansion as a sustained rate Lead and develop the existing healthcare team, direct senior coaching, selective recruiting, and accountability for delivery quality Build a productized healthcare service offering that leverages the Interviewed platform: competitive intelligence, regulatory media monitoring, KOL targeting, payer narrative tracking Win new healthcare clients in partnership with our new business team, with focus on biotech, pharma, medical devices, hospital and health systems, digital health, and consumer wellness Represent the practice externally, industry events, healthcare-specific publications, thought leadership in the healthcare communications space QUALIFICATIONS Minimum of 15 years of experience in public relations, with a focus on the healthcare and lifestyle industries. Proven track record of successfully managing PR campaigns for healthcare clients, with measurable results in media placements and client satisfaction. Strong leadership and management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team to achieve excellence. Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to craft compelling narratives and communicate complex healthcare and lifestyle concepts effectively. Strategic thinker with a deep understanding of the healthcare industry. Extensive network of media contacts and industry connections within the healthcare and lifestyle sectors Results-oriented with a passion for delivering high-quality work and exceeding client expectations. WHO YOU ARE 15+ years in healthcare communications or healthcare PR, with senior leadership experience leading teams and owning practice-level outcomes Demonstrated specialty depth in at least three of: FDA and regulatory communications, biotech and pharma, medical devices, hospital and health systems, payer relations, clinical trial communications, digital health, healthcare policy A documented track record of measurable client retention and expansion you can describe in numbers Comfortable carrying gross revenue retention, net revenue retention, and expansion as primary KPIs, not just media impressions and placements Strong network of healthcare media contacts across business, trade, clinical, and consumer publications Strategic operator, equally fluent in client strategy, team development, and operational rigor Comfortable with AI-driven workflows and a data-disciplined approach to earned media WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT INTERDEPENDENCE 🏡 100% Remote, Forever - Work from anywhere in the world while you enjoy the flexibility of your fully remote workplace. Skip the annoying commute, create a workspace that works for you, and collaborate with teammates across the country, all without sacrificing connection or career growth. 🩺 Comprehensive Health Benefits - Choose from three Anthem Blue Cross PPO medical plans, plus dental and vision coverage to support your health and well-being. 💰 Retirement Savings - Save for the future with our 401(k) program, including a company match that is increasing further to 3% in 2027 . 🌴 Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid vacation, sick time, 11 company holidays, a floating holiday, and Summer Fridays to recharge and spend more time doing what you love. 👶 Paid Parental Leave - We support growing families with paid parental leave, giving new parents dedicated time to recover, bond with their baby, and return to work with confidence. 📈 Career Growth - As one of the nation's fastest-growing strategic integrated marketing and communications firms, we're committed to helping ambitious people like you grow. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, lead from every level, and build a career with meaningful real impact. 🌟 Supportive, Collaborative Culture - We set high standards, celebrate big wins, and work together to achieve exceptional results. You'll join a team that's collaborative, entrepreneurial, and committed to helping one another succeed. HOW TO APPLY Submit your resume, a brief cover letter, and one additional document we genuinely want to read: a one-page write-up of your most significant healthcare client retention or expansion outcome. Tell us what the situation was, what you did, and the numbers you moved. The write-up will be weighted more heavily than the resume. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.summary: the opportunity We are looking for a Technical Marketing & MRD Specialist on Smart Sensors & Edge AI to investigate, structure and document the market requirements for next-generation smart sensor applications powered by our Analog Edge AI low-power ASIC.
items.description: the opportunity We are looking for a Technical Marketing & MRD Specialist on Smart Sensors & Edge AI to investigate, structure and document the market requirements for next-generation smart sensor applications powered by our Analog Edge AI low-power ASIC. You bring a solid engineering background that enables you to understand our technology at a deep technical level and translate what you learn into precise, measurable requirements. You combine strong analytical and writing skills with a genuine understanding of technology markets. In this role, you translate market needs, customer problems and application requirements into a structured MRD that guides GEMESYS’s strategy, product, technology and business development activities. You work closely with our management, engineers and business developers to answer critical questions such as: Which smart sensor markets have the strongest need for local or edge AI, meaning on-device learning, inference, event or anomaly detection, or data compression? What problems are customers currently unable to solve efficiently? What sensor capabilities, AI functions and performance levels are required? Which applications benefit most from on-device learning and inference? What are the requirements around power consumption, latency and bandwidth? Which technical requirements are driven by customers, and which by competitors or industry standards? Which product requirements should GEMESYS prioritize for its Edge AI technology? The goal is an MRD that engineering can design against: every requirement quantified, prioritized per segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases. your role Market & Application Research Build a deep understanding of our analog AI hardware, its capabilities and limitations, together with our team. Research the global smart sensor and Edge AI landscape and identify relevant market segments, applications and customer groups. Analyze emerging applications for intelligent and autonomous sensors. Investigate industry trends, technology adoption and customer requirements. Identify high-value use cases where local or edge AI processing provides tangible benefits. Identify opportunities where GEMESYS’s Analog Edge AI architecture creates differentiated value, also beyond sensors. Research competing technologies and alternative solutions, with the support of our engineers. Customer & Stakeholder Requirements Identify and structure customer pain points and unmet needs. Translate qualitative customer requirements into measurable product requirements. Define functional and non-functional requirements for smart sensor systems. Classify these requirements into categories, so that the engineering teams can make trade-offs. Source and conduct customer, expert and partner interviews through your own network, and run the market validation independently. Share your findings with management, and join selected customer and investor meetings where they add value. Market Requirements Document You own the development of a comprehensive MRD, including: Market overview, segmentation and competitive landscape Target applications and use cases Customer personas and stakeholders, where relevant Customer pain points and unmet needs Market and technology trends and their future projections Alternative technology approaches Market and product specification requirements for our Analog Edge AI ASIC: power, energy modes, bandwidth, area, process nodes, target ASP and further parameters, prioritized per segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases Product opportunity areas Recommendations for product and technology development Regulatory and industry considerations Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with GEMESYS’s technical teams to understand the capabilities and limitations of the underlying analog AI hardware. Lead our in-house market analysis team and resources efficiently, so that they support your work and build their own skill set. Translate technical capabilities into customer and application value propositions. Facilitate discussions between technical, commercial and management stakeholders. Challenge our existing assumptions with customer and market evidence. Ensure that product requirements are traceable to actual market needs. Guide future product roadmap decisions. Deliverables You are responsible for producing a professional MRD. Every requirement specified in it is prioritized for each segment and traceable to specific client discussions and use cases. what you bring Experience in technical marketing, product marketing or application engineering for semiconductors, sensors or embedded systems. Solid understanding of sensor signal chains, low-power electronics and embedded AI, deep enough to discuss architecture trade-offs with chip designers. Extensive experience developing Market Requirements Documents, Product Requirements Documents, market studies or comparable strategic or technical documentation. An established network in smart sensors, Edge AI or semiconductors that gives you direct access to potential customers, domain experts and industry partners, without relying on GEMESYS contacts. Proven ability to independently source, schedule and conduct customer and expert interviews, and to run market validation end to end. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear market and customer requirements. Experience researching technology markets and competitive landscapes. Excellent strategic, analytical and structured thinking skills. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. Ability to independently conduct research, identify information gaps and develop well-supported conclusions. items.description: Smartland Energy is looking for a strong communicator who can take complicated information and make it clear and easy to understand. This could be a great fit for someone with experience in journalism, public relations, communications, or a similar field. You’ll help Smartland Energy communicate with the communities where we work. Our projects include data centers and energy infrastructure, and local residents may have questions about things like water, electricity, land use, construction, and how a project could affect their community. Your job is to help us answer those questions clearly, accurately, and respectfully. What you'll do Write FAQs, emails, website updates, social media posts, fact sheets, and other community materials Research topics and work with our team to make sure information is accurate Help respond to questions and concerns from local residents Turn technical information into language that is easy for the public to understand Help prepare communications for community meetings and public outreach Coordinate announcements across email, social media, websites, and print Keep our messaging clear and consistent Track basic results such as email opens, meeting attendance, questions, and community feedback Keep confidential company information private What we're looking for Background in journalism, PR, communications, English, Mass Communication, Development Communication, Humanities, or a related field Excellent written English Ability to research a topic before writing about it Ability to explain complicated subjects in simple, natural language Good judgment when communicating information that may still be changing or uncertain Comfortable communicating with people who may be concerned, frustrated, or skeptical Able to work independently and communicate closely with management Organized and dependable Nice to have Experience with any of the following is helpful, but not required: Energy or utilities Infrastructure or construction Government or community relations NGO or public-interest communications Crisis communications US or international clients Managing communications across several channels Loc: International Salary: $560 bi-weekly Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Customer Support Headquarters: Chicago, Illinois, United States URL: https://careers.mheducation.com Overview Build the Future McGraw Hill’s Higher Education team delivers powerful platforms, highly personalized course materials, and effective learning supplements to help students achieve their goals at every stage of their academic and professional careers. How can you make an impact? This remote Inside, Customer Success Representative will support college-level faculty and administrators by providing guidance, training, and resources to help them successfully use our solutions. The role focuses on improving educational outcomes, student engagement, affordability, access, and equity while building strong customer relationships that drive loyalty and retention. The CSR will partner closely with Sales and other Customer Success team members to manage customer pipelines and track progress. This role will also focus on increasing digital product usage and supporting opportunities for customer growth. This is a remote role open to candidates residing ideally in the Eastern or Central Time Zone. Candidates should be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. There is a requirement for 5-10% travel throughout the year. What would you be doing? Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of McGraw Hill Higher Education’s digital products, including Connect and SIMnet, as well as foundational learning science and instructional design concepts. Utilize Salesforce and Gainsight to manage sales pipelines, track customer stages, measure pipeline velocity, and analyze customer data. Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to assess customer needs, develop implementation plans, and support retention and new business opportunities. Oversee implementation processes for new and returning customers, ensuring they are positioned to achieve improved outcomes and a positive experience. Conduct one-on-one and group Zoom meetings to provide consultative guidance, training, and support tailored to customer needs and goals. Provide timely follow-up and resolve customer issues through troubleshooting, research, and collaboration with internal teams, including Sales, Product, Implementation, and Technical Support. Participate in team meetings, strategy sessions, and professional development while sharing customer feedback and ideas to help improve products and services. We’re looking for someone with: Bachelor’s Degree. 1-2 years experience in customer success or similar role related to software implementation (higher education experience highly preferred). Exceptional communication and presentation skills to effectively train and support customers with varying levels of technical acumen and confidence. Ability to excel in a remote setting. This is primarily a work-from-home position that requires a high level of communication, organization, and attention to detail. Positive attitude, purpose-driven spirit, and growth mindset for embracing challenges. Instructional design, teaching and/or coaching experience also a plus. Experience using Salesforce and Gainsight is preferred. Why work for us? The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. As the leading education partner for millions of educators, learners and professionals, we are expanding the possibilities of content and technology to make learning better in a connected world. Play your part and experience a sense of fulfilment that will inspire you to even greater heights. The pay range for this position is between $60,000 - $70,000 annually. However, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. An annual bonus plan may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. Click here to learn more about our benefit offerings. McGraw Hill recruiters always use a “@mheducation.com” or "@careers.mheducation.com” email addresses and/or from our Applicant Tracking System, iCIMS. Any variation of this email domain should be considered suspicious. Additionally, McGraw Hill recruiters and authorized representatives will never request sensitive information in email. 51415 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mcgraw-hill-llc-customer-success-representative-inside

items.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.

items.title: Lead Creative
items.summary: Superside is looking for a Lead Creative with a passion for AI to shape creative excellence across branding, landing pages, ads, social, print, and presentations. You’ll guide a global team of top-tier creatives, combining strategic leadership with hands-on craft to deliver human-centered, high-impact work for leading brands worldwide. This role sits at the intersection of creativity and innovation, elevating creative quality while helping evolve our capabilities through the thoughtful use of AI tools. You’ll act as both a mentor and a maker, fostering collaboration, empathy, and clarity across every project. You bring curiosity, composure, and humility to your leadership, helping others grow while delivering consistently outstanding creative work.
